Here the original A holes are $z_1,z_2,w$, so $c$ is odd and positive; D is
nonempty. Its completed matching again has exactly the opposite-parity holes
$r,w$. This choice needs **no even crossing port**.

In either case N10 gives a Hamilton $r$--$v$ path containing $M_A\cup D$.
Delete D, attach all real crossedges, and attach both short bridges $z_jy_j$.
For $\delta=0$ the bridge at $r=z_1$ attaches to the initial path endpoint;
its degree becomes two, as required because it is not the global root.
For $\delta=1$ the global root retains degree one. All other degree and forest
requirements of Section 2 follow from distinct B attachments.

For $\delta=1$, the original B holes have counts $(1,3)$. The matching T consumes
all crossing ports and covers both internally matched $y_j$. After conflict
compression its holes are the original B holes together with $Y$, hence $(1,5)$.
For $\delta=0$, the original B holes have counts $(2,3)$ and include $u$.
The tagged closure consumes $u$, while the two conflict compressions expose $Y$.
Thus the new holes are $(H_B\setminus\{u\})\cup Y$, again $(1,5)$.
T15 avoiding $Y$ applies, and Section 2 completes the path.

##### 4. The $(2,0)$ row reduces to T15 under EP0

Suppose EP0 supplies $r,q,D,P,s$, and set $t=\bar s\in W\subset B$.
The odd crossing-port surplus is $2+\delta$, so such ports exist.
For $\delta=1$, $c$ is odd and at least three, and D has size $(c+1)/2$.
For $\delta=0$, $c$ is even and at least two, and D has size $c/2$.
In both cases D is nonempty, avoids $r,q$, and $M_A\cup D$ has holes $r,q$.

Delete D and the short new edge $qs$ from P. Attach all real crossing edges;
attach both bridges $z_jy_j$ as in Section 3; and attach the short bridge $st$.
The vertex $s$ is outside $X_A\cup\{z_1,z_2\}$, so this extra deletion does not
interact with D or a preexisting bridge at $s$.

If $q\ne v$, it loses one of its two new path edges and gains its real crossing
edge, so its degree remains two. If $q=v$, deletion isolates the path endpoint,
and its real crossing edge gives it degree one. If $s\ne u$, it is internally
covered by $M_A$, loses one new edge, and gains $st$, so it retains degree two.
If $s=u$ (only possible for $\delta=1$), it loses its unique path edge and gains
$ut$, retaining degree one. These include all endpoint boundaries.

The new B endpoint $t$ is an original odd hole, distinct from $X_B$ and from $Y$.
It is distinct from $Y$ because a coincidence would give an edge between a
nonroot even hole and a member of W. Attachments therefore remain distinct,
and Section 2's tagged closure and conflict compression apply.

For $\delta=1$, original B hole counts are $(1,4)$. The transfer consumes the
odd hole $t$ and the conflicts expose $Y$: the final hole set is
$(H_B\setminus\{t\})\cup Y$, with counts $(1,5)$.
For $\delta=0$, original B hole counts are $(2,4)$; the closure also consumes $u$.
The final hole set is $(H_B\setminus\{u,t\})\cup Y$, again $(1,5)$.
T15 avoids precisely $Y$, and expansion completes the required global path.

##### 5. What finite probes establish, and what they do not

The independent geometry work in [COVERED_EIGHT_GEOMETRY_CENSUS.md](#proof-covered-eight-geometry-census) reports that
each residual has a $(2,0)$ or $(2,1)$ cut. That complete geometric classification
is an external input to any future global use of this draft; this file does not
recertify it. In particular there are 50 normalized geometries, represented by
seven target-preserving permutation orbits, whose splitting cuts are all $(2,0)$.

The diagnostic script [eight_hole_covered_next_probe.py](research/six_directions/eight_hole_covered_next_probe.py) constructs actual short
matchings on the covered vertices of the following seven representatives. For each
of their three $(2,0)$ cuts separately, it finds a 28-edge matching such that

$$E(Q_5)\cap\bigl((X_A\cap O)\times S\bigr)=\varnothing.$$

Every such output is verified directly as a matching with the exact eight holes.
There are 21 such positive witnesses, fully recorded in the JSON. Consequently
EP0 fails for arbitrary fixed cuts; it cannot be universally asserted in that form.

There is a useful weaker selection fact across cuts. In each representative,
simultaneously delete every short edge that would create an eligible $q$--$s$
adjacency in any of its three cuts. The resulting graph of covered vertices has
the isolated even vertices listed in the last column. Each such vertex is covered
in any realizing matching, so a realizing matching must contain a deleted edge.
That edge gives an eligible adjacency at at least one of the three cuts.

| $v$ | $Z$ | $W$ | $(2,0)$ coordinates | isolated even vertices after all deletions |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3,5,9 | 14,31,47,62 | 1,2,3 | 15,30,46,63 |
| 7 | 3,5,6 | 8,16,32,56 | 0,1,2 | 24,40,48 |
| 7 | 3,5,15 | 8,25,41,56 | 1,2,3 | 9,24,40,57 |
| 7 | 3,15,23 | 25,26,56,59 | 2,3,4 | 24,27,57,58 |
| 7 | 15,23,39 | 56,59,61,62 | 3,4,5 | 57,58,60,63 |
| 31 | 15,23,27 | 1,2,32,35 | 2,3,4 | 3,33,34 |
| 31 | 15,23,63 | 32,35,37,38 | 3,4,5 | 33,34,36,39 |

Coordinates are numbered from zero. The script explicitly verifies the full
neighbor set of each listed Hall subset is empty in the deletion graph.
This proves the adjacency fact for all realizing matchings of each listed
geometry, and cube symmetries give it for their images. It is not a sample-based
Hamilton assertion. It still does not prove that the N10 path can contain that
eligible edge. That optional-edge prescription is the present barrier.

The parent agent separately verified all 21 positive matching witnesses and all
seven Hall certificates using the solver-free checker
[verify_eight_exposure_obstructions.py](research/six_directions/verify_eight_exposure_obstructions.py); its result is recorded in
[eight_exposure_obstructions_verification.json](research/six_directions/eight_exposure_obstructions_verification.json). This independent finite check
does not constitute semantic acceptance of the transfer draft or of either core.

The Q4 analogue of T15 must not be imported without qualification: prior diagnostic
files [q4_six_hole_two_avoided.cpp](research/six_directions/q4_six_hole_two_avoided.cpp) and [q4_six_two_avoided_results.json](research/six_directions/q4_six_two_avoided_results.json) report actual
negative instances for some pairs of prescribed avoided majority holes. The Q5
statement T15 remains a separate conjectural core in this document.

##### 6. Remaining exact research obligations

T15 is a standalone unproved complete-graph-matching extension theorem. EP0 is a
genuine extra path-edge condition. A global route through these reductions requires
a proved choice of cut satisfying $(2,1)$ or satisfying $(2,0)$ together with EP0;
mere availability of a $(2,0)$ cut is insufficient. The seven-orbit exceptional
incidence check supplies an eligible edge in some cut, but not EP0.

No conclusion here closes R8-covered. Closing T15 alone would nevertheless close
all $(2,1)$-cut inputs, regardless of the other cut rows, via the full quantified
transfer in Section 3. Independent proof-checker review of this draft is still needed.


</details>


<details id="proof-forced-cherry-rank-reduction" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>FORCED_CHERRY_RANK_REDUCTION.md — Rank reduction when an included hole forces a cherry</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/FORCED_CHERRY_RANK_REDUCTION.md)。SHA-256：`30bbdd91a3a02d3a5a7d821fe3b8cea9c4e6a970a180f035580e057900c4b1fe`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[TWELVE_STAR_B_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_STAR_B_REVIEW.json)。

#### Rank reduction when an included hole forces a cherry

2026-11-01. A structural lemma for future marked multiple-omission inputs;
not an accepted new P6 branch.

Suppose an included free vertex $h$ has exactly two available short
neighbors $p,q$ after the specified omissions. Every short-complement
forest must contain $ph,hq$, hence its endpoint matching contains $pq$.
In the actual application $p,q$ are covered vertices; this assumption
must be checked, not inferred from the degree count alone.

If the required matching $F$ contains $pq$, the three edges $ph,hq,pq$
form an isolated triangle in every cycle extension: all three vertices
already have degree two. If other retained vertices exist, the desired
spanning cycle is impossible. This is an explicit obstruction.

If $pq\notin F$, put $a=F(p)$ and $b=F(q)$. The four endpoints are
distinct. Replace the two required edges $pa,qb$ by $ab$, giving a
perfect matching $F'$ on $K\setminus\{p,q\}$. For each admissible forest
with endpoint matching $P$, remove $pq$ to obtain $P'$ on that same set.
Then $F+P$ is one alternating cycle if and only if $F'+P'$ is one
alternating cycle: the path $a-p-q-b$ is suppressed or expanded.

Thus full rank $2^{(|K|-2)/2-1}$ for these shortened endpoint pairings
is a sufficient certificate for every required matching avoiding $pq$.
It need not be possible to attain the larger rank for the original
$|K|$ endpoints. A reduced-rank certificate plus the forced triangle
would yield an exact local classification.

For Q5 one-versus-seven holes with three majority holes omitted, a
minority free hole whose three neighbors are precisely the omissions
has this form if the other two neighbors are covered. In a Q6 transfer,
the original internal matching is short and cannot contain the
same-parity edge $pq$. The compressed matching may contain it, however;
one must still prove that the completion and transfer can avoid creating
it. A rank certificate alone does not discharge that transfer obligation.


</details>

#### Fourteen-hole residual: cached-positive candidate reuse and exact greedy subset

2026-11-02. Producer-only computational/proof preparation by `/root/higher_forced_cherry_review`. **No new local input or actual application is independently accepted by this document.** The old source/registry files and the frozen FOURTEEN_REUSE package remain unchanged. This is not full fourteen holes; the source reduction still depends on complete twelve-hole Q6, which is not asserted here.

##### Exact source and candidate result

The six frozen `FOURTEEN_REUSE_remaining_h14_v{1,7,31}_{covered,free}.bin` files contain48211 original-label13-byte records (Z6 followed by W7), with free root0 and the named odd target. This second stage uses only cached producer-positive local inputs not selected into the already accepted registry:121 of the232 positive [TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_summary.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_summary.json) rows, and282 of the293 positive [TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_summary.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_summary.json) rows. These403 candidates yield74050 normalized marked keys. Producer full_rank flags identify candidates only, not proofs.

##### Actual source/cut predicate

For every original record, try all six target-facing cuts and every legal source subset of the actual type. With k=7, even consumption has s=a+1-b, minority6-a and majority7-b+s, with sources among A Z holes and b>=1. Odd consumption has s=b-a-1, minority7-b and majority6-a+s, with sources among A W holes excluding root mirror and a free target. The code explicitly checks source counts/pool and rejects any mirror which is an original hole/root.

Delete only the outer coordinate, then transform actual minority, majority and marked mirror omissions together. A minority anchor is used when present, otherwise an omission anchor. For each cached canonical row every corresponding source anchor and every coordinate permutation is included. A hit is tied to a named exact cache row/prefix, not just to a type or unmarked hole count.

The scan examines1434085 legal source projections in about0.934 seconds. It retains one witness per **source record/candidate orbit** rather than stopping at the first orbit. Exactly278524 such distinct hits occur, across161 of the403 candidate rows. Thus the complete candidate union is defined by source-index sets, not by adding overlapping orbit counts.

Each per-status `FOURTEEN_CACHED_all_hits_h14_v{v}_{status}.bin` record has28 little-endian bytes: original13-byte-source index uint32; family uint8 (30=NEW cache,31=EXTRA cache); cut uint8; exact local ID uint16; original-label source mask uint64; actual projected minority, majority and omission masks (three uint32). The target and free/covered status come from the filename.

##### Greedy sufficient registry: only twenty new local obligations

Greedy selection repeatedly chooses the candidate row with largest uncovered source-record gain, breaking ties by its numerical code (NEW index, EXTRA1000+index). This is a convenient deterministic selection, **not a minimum-cardinality theorem**. The selected twenty rows have exactly the same source-record union as all403 candidates. A chosen selected witness is stored per covered source record; all other source records are copied unchanged in original order to the six `FOURTEEN_CACHED_remaining_h14_v{v}_{status}.bin` files. The greedy script checks complete residual-byte equality with the earlier exhaustive candidate scan outputs.

The exact ordered chosen codes are:

```

1118,1069,1246,1006,1251,1252,1288,161,1205,318
```

An EXTRA code1000+i denotes prefix `TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_orbit_iii`; a NEW code i denotes prefix `TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_orbit_iii`, with three decimal digits. The explicit geometries, indices and original certificate prefixes are in [FOURTEEN_CACHED_greedy_registry.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_CACHED_greedy_registry.json). Ten selected rows are T26, eight T17 and two T28.

Only these20 new positive local certificate statements are needed to promote the candidate union. The remaining141 active candidates and other inactive candidates are not mathematical premises. Their actual finite hit sets only supplied a target union for choosing a sufficient subset.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

|T17 unforced|8|24|2048|17|16384|33554432|
|T28 unforced|2|22|1024|18|2048|2097152|
|Total|20|—|—|—|38912|77594624|

All selected witnesses already exist in the old producer cache. The new manifest pins each selected config/metadata/forest/pair/column/matrix/pivot/combination file without editing any of them. A fresh local checker must independently verify all38912 forests and columns, derive their actual endpoint pairings, rebuild all77594624 connectivity bits, and verify exact GF(2) ranks. Producer ranks are not that check.

##### Conditional local proof and global transfer

Once verified, the local positive proof is the accepted generic forest-rank argument: legal short forests have degree0 at marked omissions,2 at included holes,1 at covered terminals and no cycles; their endpoint matching rows span the complete matching-connectivity row space when a valid submatrix reaches the generic GF(2) upper bound. Every arbitrary complete-graph matching column is nonzero by cyclically joining its oriented matching edges. Hence some selected forest connects each arbitrary required matching; expansion gives the exact local cycle with short new edges. Common required/forest edges form improper labeled two-edge components and cannot survive connectivity. Required edges may be long or same-parity.

All selected applications use the following k7 rows:

- T26: even(a,b)=(4,3) or odd(2,5), two sources, completed A holes3:3;
- T17: even(5,3) or odd(2,6), three sources, completed A holes3:3;
- T28: even(4,2) or odd(1,5), three sources, completed A holes2:2.

These lie inside even the original accepted uniform transfer's b<=3 / a<=2 ranges. Original M is short, nonroot holes independent, source exclusions preserve root/target, and mirrors are originally internally covered. The completed A endpoint theorem allows arbitrary artificial completion edges and a covered/free prescribed target. Forest compression and simultaneous pendant-mate suppression yield the actual B matching with exactly the looked-up marked set. The new candidate local inputs, if independently accepted, are universal on arbitrary complete-graph matchings, so they apply to every such actual compressed L. Expansion removes completion placeholders and restores every original matching edge with short new physical edges.

No forced local pair classification is used in this cache stage. No root-in-obstruction workaround, unreviewed A opening, MAmax or new rank search is imported. The cut/source witnesses are geometric; local paths/completions may depend on actual M. Thus the every-realizing-M quantifier has the correct conditional route once the independent local/application gates pass.

##### Reproduction and gates

```
python FOURTEEN_CACHED_prepare.py
g++ -std=c++17 -O3 FOURTEEN_CACHED_scan.cpp -o FOURTEEN_CACHED_scan.exe
./FOURTEEN_CACHED_scan.exe
python FOURTEEN_CACHED_greedy.py
python FOURTEEN_CACHED_freeze.py
```

Fresh acceptance requires: first-stage FOURTEEN_REUSE actual application;20 new local certificates; complete actual candidate/selected witness replay with common marked transforms; exact selected-union residual complements and source hash alignment. The greedy optimality and completeness of an ambient geometry classification are not required. No full14 or full P6 statement follows from this producer package.

<details id="proof-fourteen-final25-proof" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>FOURTEEN_FINAL25_PROOF.md — Fourteen-hole final two root-star orbits</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_FINAL25_PROOF.md)。SHA-256：`815f5698bc199d37f9781a2c7667f236a8374a98c3e83d96d880c3123c94c3fa`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[FOURTEEN_FINAL25_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_FINAL25_REVIEW.json)。

#### Fourteen-hole final two root-star orbits

Status: frozen producer proof and positive finite evidence, pending fresh independent review. This package proves an extension statement for two exact geometry orbits if its positive certificates are accepted. It does not by itself assemble the full fourteen-hole theorem or P6. The source reduction to the last 25 geometries is a separate dependency, [FOURTEEN_MID_SELECTED_PROOF.md](#proof-fourteen-mid-selected-proof) and its final independent review.

Throughout $Q_6$ has vertices $0,\ldots,63$. Set
$$Z=\{39,43,45,51,53,57\},\quad J_5=\{1,2,4,8,16\},\quad T=\{7,11,13,19,21,25\}.$$
The two representatives have prescribed free root $u=0$ and prescribed covered target $v=31$, and uncovered sets $\{0\}\cup Z\cup W_i$, where
$$W_0=J_5\cup\{14,32\},\qquad W_1=J_5\cup\{32,62\}.$$
For **every** short matching $M$ with either uncovered set, the claim is that $M$ is contained in a Hamilton path from 0 to 31. Each original matching has 25 edges. The proof includes original matchings where target 31 crosses the chosen split; it does not assume target-internal behavior from a maximal extension.

##### Exact local B premises

The only new B inputs are five exact marked rows in [FOURTEEN_FINAL25_B_summary.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_FINAL25_B_summary.json): indices 0,1,7 for orbit 0 and indices 100,101 for orbit 1. Each has 22 covered endpoints and one forced complement pair $pq$. Deleting that pair leaves 20 endpoints and a certified square rank-512 matrix. There are 2560 forests and 1310720 connectivity bits altogether. Orbit-0 forest records have 34 bytes; orbit-1 forest records have 36 bytes. Full endpoint pairings have 22 bytes, reduced pairings and columns 20 bytes, and reduced matrix rows 64 bytes.

The mathematical import is the accepted single-cherry complete-matching criterion in [HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_TRANSFER.md](#proof-higher-forced-cherry-transfer) / [HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json), using the complete-graph GF2 connectivity rank $2^{20/2-1}=512$. For any one of these exact inputs, full reduced rank implies that **every complete matching** $F$ on the original 22 endpoints with $pq\notin F$ can be joined to a certified short forest into one cycle. The arbitrary complete matching need not be short or bipartite. If $pq\in F$, the labelled common pair makes a separate cycle, proving the converse. The positive forests and reduced rank are new finite premises, not imported merely because another marked input has the same cardinalities.

The local forest at an internal hole has degree two; at covered endpoints degree one; at omitted holes degree zero. The recorded forced cherry is the unique internal hole with the two indicated remaining cube neighbors. Its short two-edge path forces $pq$ in every endpoint pairing. The certificate can be verified solely from short edges, path components, recorded pairings, every matrix bit, and GF2 elimination. No search exhaustiveness or deficient rank is needed.

##### The two A maximal domains

Split along bit 32: $A=\{0,\ldots,31\}$, $B=A+32$, and write $\bar x=x\oplus32$. Put $E=\{x\in A\setminus\{0\}:\operatorname{parity}(x)=0\}$, so $|E|=15$. In orbit 0 the originally covered A odd vertices are
$$O_0=\{7,11,13,19,21,22,25,26,28,31\};$$
in orbit 1 they are all eleven odd vertices of weight at least three, denoted $O_1$. Write $j=1$ in orbit 0 and $j=0$ in orbit 1, so $|O_i|=11-j$, and the original A holes other than 0 are
$$W_A=J_5\cup\{14\}\quad(i=0),\qquad W_A=J_5\quad(i=1).$$

Let $L$ be the actual internal-A submatching of $M$. It covers every vertex of $T$, since their mirrors form $Z$. In orbit 1 it also covers even vertex 30, since $\bar{30}=62$ is an original B hole. Extend $L$ by adding short edges in the graph induced by $E\cup O_i$ until it is inclusion-maximal, giving $L^*$. This extension still covers $T$, and in orbit 1 still covers 30. Every actual $L$ therefore has an extension in the stated finite domain. No extra assumption about other unmatched vertices is imposed.

For every such maximal matching, the supplied A record gives $q,t,w,b$, a positive opening forest $P$ under one common coordinate permutation, and a simultaneous exact B input. The following are the finite positive properties:

- $q$ is an even vertex unmatched by $L^*$; $t\in T$; $w,b$ are distinct units in $J_5$.
- $P$ is a short path forest on $A\setminus\{0,31\}$, degree two at $q,b$ and degree one elsewhere. It has 16 edges, 14 components, and contains the opening edge $qt$.
- If 31 is matched in $L^*$, replace its edge $31h^*$ by $wh^*$; otherwise leave $L^*$ unchanged. Denote the result by $L^{*\prime}$. The labelled union $P+L^{*\prime}$ is acyclic. A common edge is a two-cycle and must fail the component test.
- The simultaneous marked B input, including its forced pair, has one common coordinate map to one of the five new certified inputs.

Only the old case00 and case03 **positive forest** files are used. Their rank 8031 is not a theorem premise; the proof does not require them to enumerate every possible opening forest. The 805006 positive A records are the completeness evidence for the required maximal domain.

##### Monotone lift, including the actual target-cross cases

Let $31h$ be the original target matching edge. If it is internal A, remove it and insert the auxiliary edge $wh$ internally in A. If it crosses, then $h=63$; replace it by the auxiliary crossing edge $w63$. These auxiliary edges are allowed to be long. Both have opposite-parity endpoints and will be deleted in the final path construction. Let $L'$ be the resulting internal-A matching. Its covered vertex domain is
$$G'_A=(E\cup O_i)\setminus\{31\}\cup\{w\}.$$
Let $X'$ be this domain's vertices unmatched by $L'$. Their incident original or virtual cross edges are retained as ports.

The submatching inclusion $L'\subseteq L^{*\prime}$ holds in all three cases:

1. If the actual target edge is internal, it is an edge of $L\subseteq L^*$, so the maximal matching uses the same mate $h$. Both modifications replace $31h$ by $wh$.
2. If the actual target edge crosses and 31 is unmatched in $L^*$, then $L'=L$ and $L^{*\prime}=L^*$.
3. If the actual target edge crosses but the maximal extension adds $31h^*$, then $L'=L$; removing the newly added $31h^*$ and adding $wh^*$ keeps every edge of $L$. Thus $L^{*\prime}$ contains $L'$ and the new $wh^*$ may be used as a completion edge.

In particular one must not replace the actual cross edge by the maximal target edge. The actual cross edge becomes $w63$ throughout cases 2 and 3. Vertex 63 is not a unit mirror, not $\bar t$ (because $31\notin T$), and not a mirror of a source in $W_A$. No prescribed boundary port collides with it. In orbit 1 the originally required internal coverage of vertex 30 survives the modification: an actual internal edge at 30 remains, or is changed only from $31\,30$ to $w\,30$; a maximal extension cannot steal an already matched actual 30.

Put $S=W_A\setminus\{w,b\}$, with $|S|=3+j$. In the acyclic graph $P+L^{*\prime}$ all vertices have degree one or two. Let $m^*=|L^*|$. Its endpoint set is
$$Q^*=(X^{*\prime}\setminus\{q\})\cup S,$$
where $X^{*\prime}$ is the set of unmatched vertices in $G'_A$ under $L^{*\prime}$. There are $15-m^*$ even and $11-j-m^*$ odd vertices in $X^{*\prime}$. Removing even $q$ and adding the $3+j$ odd sources gives $14-m^*$ endpoints of each parity. The graph has $14-m^*\ge3$ path components, as $m^*\le11$.

There exists an opposite-parity matching $D^*$ of these endpoints joining all paths into one cycle. To see this directly, the number of even-even paths equals the number of odd-odd paths. Alternate such paths in a ring and insert the mixed-endpoint paths into ring connections. If all paths are mixed, orient and join them directly in a ring. Complete opposite-parity endpoint edges are permitted in this auxiliary construction.

Set
$$D=D^*\cup(L^{*\prime}\setminus L').$$
This is a matching, since endpoints of $D^*$ are unmatched by $L^{*\prime}$ and the added edges are mutually disjoint. Its domain is precisely $(X'\setminus\{q\})\cup S$, with $|D|=14-|L|$. The graph
$$P+L'+D=P+L^{*\prime}+D^*$$
is the same single cycle on all 30 vertices of $A\setminus\{0,31\}$. The vertex $t\in T$ is matched by the actual $L$, so $D$ avoids $t$; it also avoids $q$. The short edge $qt$ is therefore disjoint from $D$. In the third case the auxiliary edge $wh^*$ in $L^{*\prime}\setminus L'$ belongs to $D$ and is deleted in the next step; it is never mistaken for an original matching edge.

##### Actual B suppression, local safety and final Hamilton path

Delete all edges of $D$ and the opening edge $qt$ from the A cycle. Keep the original/virtual matching cross edges at every vertex of $X'$ (including $q$). Add the short bridges $s\bar s$ for all $s\in S$ and $t\bar t$. This makes disjoint paths inducing a complete pairing of the resulting B boundary vertices. Vertex $q$ opens its actual cross port; $t$ opens to the original B hole $\bar t$; the sources $S$ were original A holes. All these endpoints are distinct. In actual-target-cross cases the port at $w$ is the virtual edge $w63$; in the target-internal case the auxiliary edge $wh$ remains inside the A paths.

Combine this induced pairing with the original internal-B matching edges. Exactly the vertices $Y=\bar S$ have degree two. Their original B mates exist because $S\cap T=\varnothing$ and their mirrors are not the minority B holes. Every vertex of $Y$ has the same parity, and each original short matching edge incident to $Y$ leaves $Y$. A cycle in the combined graph would require every vertex on it to have degree two, hence to lie in $Y$, which is impossible. Suppression of the degree-two vertices therefore produces a valid complete matching $F_B$ on the 22 vertices outside the new local hole set
$$H_B=M_B^{\mathrm{actual}}\cup(Z\setminus\{\bar t\})\cup Y,$$
where $M_B^{\mathrm{actual}}=\{32\}$ in orbit 0 and $\{32,62\}$ in orbit 1. Original B minority holes remain holes, and the original majority hole $\bar t$ is filled by the extra bridge.

Under the B identification $x\mapsto x\oplus32$, the exact marked input is
$$M_B=\{0\}\ (i=0),\quad M_B=\{0,30\}\ (i=1),$$
$$J_B=(T\setminus\{t\})\cup S,\quad U_B=S,\quad R_B=\{\{w,b\}\}.$$
Its common map is explicitly supplied in [FOURTEEN_FINAL25_checked_options.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_FINAL25_checked_options.json). In orbit 0 it is type 1:9 with four omitted holes; in orbit 1 it is type 2:8 with three omitted holes. Both have 22 covered endpoints. The hole 0 has exactly the two remaining unit neighbors $w,b$, forcing their complement pair.

The actual compressed matching avoids the forced pair. The vertices $\bar w,\bar b$ were originally covered internally in B, since their original cross neighbors $w,b$ were A holes. They are outside $Y$, and their original short internal-B edges have opposite-parity other endpoints also outside $Y$. None is an induced cross boundary endpoint; in particular the virtual cross edge, when present, ends at 63, which is distinct from these unit mirrors. Thus the original short matching edges incident to $\bar w,\bar b$ survive unchanged in $F_B$. Their same-parity endpoints cannot be matched to one another. This proves $\bar w\bar b\notin F_B$ for **every** original matching, including all virtual-cross cases. No unverified mixed-parity obstruction rule is used.

The new local full-rank criterion now gives a short B forest whose union with $F_B$ is a single cycle. Expand the suppressed Y paths and all induced A paths. The result is a single 62-vertex cycle on $Q_6\setminus\{0,31\}$ that contains every edge of the modified original matching, including the actual auxiliary edge $wh$ (internal or virtual crossing). Delete that auxiliary edge. Attach the short edge $0w$ at $w$ and restore the original target matching edge $h31$ at the other end. This gives a Hamilton path from 0 to 31 containing every original edge of $M$.

All 805006 records are positive. Domain completeness can be counted independently of the producer DFS: choose the unmatched odd subset $U\subseteq O_i\setminus T$, match every vertex of $O_i\setminus U$ injectively to an even cube neighbor, and require the used-even set to contain $N(U)$ and, in orbit 1, also 30. The producer replay checks do not constitute independent acceptance.

A records use the established 32-byte format: sorted original edge pairs in bytes 0..21 padded with 255; size byte 22; $q,t,w,b$ bytes 23..26; opening case byte 27; little-endian forest index bytes 28..29; A permutation index byte 30; target-internal-in-the-maximal-matching flag byte 31. $$\text{local cycle through arbitrary }F\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
F+R\text{ has no labelled cycle}.$$

For clarity, the accepted generic proof's simultaneous safety argument is
fully discharged here. For a realizing original matching let $c$ be the
actual crossing count, $D$ its A completion, and $d=|D|$. Let $J_B$ be

#### Nine actual Q5 inputs: single/double cherries and one full positive class

##### Claim

Use exactly the nine marked rows below, with original61-profile indices.
Write $H=M\cup J$, $K=Q_5\setminus H$, and $U\subset J$ for the marked

|20|0|1,2,4,7,11,13,19,21,25,26,31|1,2,4,13,26|0:(8,16)|256|
|27|0,3|1,4,8,14,21,22,25,26,28,31|1,4,8,14|0:(2,16)|256|
|28|0,3|4,8,13,14,16,21,22,25,28,31|4,8,16,25|0:(1,2)|256|
|29|0|1,2,4,7,11,13,14,19,21,25,31|1,2,4,14,25|0:(8,16)|256|

|54|0,3,5|8,11,13,14,22,25,26,28,31|8,11,13|none; unconditional|512|

##### Status and assumptions

PROVABLE AS STATED relative to the primary generic rank theorem and the
specified positive finite certificates, pending FRESH independent local
verification. The producer author check is not independent acceptance.
This is neither unrestricted T39/T2_10/T1_11 nor a full fourteen-hole theorem.

Import the generic complete-graph matching-connectivity bound
$\operatorname{rank}_{\mathrm{GF}(2)}H_t\le2^{t/2-1}$ for every even
$t\ge2$, Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof Corollary3.5, with the primary statement
recorded in [A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md](#proof-a10-orbit3-universal-primary-source). The already accepted
[HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_TRANSFER.md](#proof-higher-forced-cherry-transfer) Section5 gives a compatible multi-pair
rank criterion; the full proof for these exact data is written below.
No Q6 theorem or failed search is an assumption of the local proof.

##### Notation and strategy

A legal short complement forest $S$ has degree0 at $U$, degree2 at
$H\setminus U$, degree1 at $K$, and no cycle. Its path-endpoint matching
is $P(S)$. All nine rows have $|K|=20$. For a forced row let $r=|R|$,
$K^-=K\setminus V(R)$, and $P^-=P(S)\setminus R$.
We prove analytic necessity, verify reduced positive rank, and use row-space
spanning for the universal arbitrary matching. Finite generator exhaustion
and original full-matrix search ranks are not premises.

##### 1. Forced paths and necessary obstruction

For every listed cherry $h:(p,q)$, the only short neighbors of $h$ outside
$U$ are exactly $p,q$, and both are in $K$. Every permissible cycle must
contain $p-h-q$. A covered terminal has one required $F$ edge and one
complement edge, so the entire complement path is exactly $p-h-q$ and
$P(S)$ contains the matching pair $pq$. These cherry terminal pairs are
pairwise disjoint within each row.

Deleting the nonempty $F$ from a connected cycle gives a legal short
forest. If $F+R$ has a labelled cycle, all vertices of that cycle already
have their two alternating edges, so it persists as a proper component of
$F+P(S)$. The nonempty residual terminal set $K^-$ lies outside it.
Thus a connected endpoint union is impossible. This proves necessity.
For one pair it is exactly $pq\notin F$. For two pairs absence of the
individual $R$ edges is NOT sufficient: cross-pairing their four endpoints
can itself form an alternating4-cycle. The theorem uses full acyclicity.

##### 2. Reduced positive rank proves sufficiency

Suppose $F+R$ is acyclic. Its components are paths, with degree2 on
$V(R)$ and degree1 on $K^-$. Compress them to an arbitrary perfect
matching $F^-$ on $K^-$. For every selected $P(S)=R\cup P^-$,
component-preserving suppression gives

$$F+P(S)\text{ connected}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
F^-+P^-\text{ connected}.$$

The supplied legal forests give a reduced connectivity restriction of
rank128 at16 endpoints for rows13/14, and rank256 at18 endpoints for the
six single-cherry rows. These meet exactly the generic respective upper
bounds $2^{16/2-1}$ and $2^{18/2-1}$. Their complete rows consequently
span the full matching-connectivity row space. Every arbitrary $F^-$
column is nonzero: orient its required pairs and cyclically link consecutive
ends to obtain another perfect matching forming one alternating cycle.
If all selected rows vanished on $F^-$, all rows would vanish, contradiction.
Hence some selected forest connects with this arbitrary required matching.

Undo suppression and expand every endpoint path. This gives a simple
cycle on exactly $Q_5\setminus U$ containing all $F$, with every other
physical edge short. A common required/forest physical edge would be a
length-one complement path and shared endpoint pair, hence an isolated
labelled two-edge component, incompatible with connectedness on20 terminals.

For row54 there is no forced pair. Its512 legal forests and512 arbitrary
matching columns have full binary rank512 at20 endpoints, the complete
matrix upper bound. The same nonzero-column/spanning argument applies
directly, establishing the unconditional local theorem. No deficient rank
or absence of a forced hole is used as a positive/negative certificate.

##### 3. Finite certificate boundary

New forced prefixes are `FOURTEEN_FORCED_orbit_XXX`. Row54 uses its unchanged
frozen source prefix `FOURTEEN_NEW_TYPES_orbit_054`.

| Rows | Count per row | Forest bytes | Full pairing bytes | Reduced pairing/column bytes | Matrix row bytes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|13,14|128|36|20|16|16|
|19,27,28|256|36|20|18|32|
|20,29,30|256|34|20|18|32|
|54|512|38|20|20|64|

For forced rows suffixes are `_forests.bin`, `_full_pairs.bin`, `_pairs.bin`,
`_columns.bin`, `_matrix.bin`, `_pivots.bin`, `_combos.bin`, `_config.txt`,
and `.json`. Full pairings contain $R$; reduced pairings delete exactly
its covered endpoints. The square reduced matrices have low-bit-first
entries. For row54 `_pairs.bin` is already the full20-terminal pairing.
The total is2304 forests/columns and688128 connectivity bits.

The producer extracts independent columns of an existing positive full-row
matrix and suppresses $F+R$ in those columns. Extraction metadata explains
provenance but need not be trusted: the reduced forests, derived pairs,
arbitrary columns and binary matrices stand on their own. Fresh audit
must verify every short edge, exact support/degree, omission, acyclicity,
physical cherry, full pairing, reduced deletion, valid column, connectivity
bit and exact reduced rank. The producer author checker recomputes these
properties and matrix ranks but does not supply independent acceptance.

##### Dependency map and boundary

Primary generic rank plus independently verified finite positive data imply

in [FOURTEEN_FORCED_APPLICATION.md](#proof-fourteen-forced-application); it must prove acyclicity of the ACTUAL
compressed matching plus all pairs of $R$, not merely avoid each pair.
The other52 profile rows, including the single-cherry row15 of deficient

#### Fourteen-hole exact positive neighbor-deficiency exclusions

2026-11-02. ARIS proof-writer. PROVABLE AS STATED from the finite witness obligations below; independent checking pending.

##### Claim and scope

Of the 12,546 original-label configurations in the six frozen
`FOURTEEN_CACHED_remaining_h14_v{1,7,31}_{covered,free}.bin` files,
8,623 cannot be the hole set of a short matching in Q6. The exact complement
has 3,923 covered-target configurations and no free-target configurations.
This is an exclusion of unrealizable input geometries, not a negative
Hamilton-path result. The completeness of the starting domain depends on
the accepted FOURTEEN_CACHED and FOURTEEN_REUSE applications, the full
twelve-hole predecessor, and their explicit imports.

##### Direct mathematical proof

A source record lists six distinct even nonroot holes Z followed by seven
distinct odd holes W; root u=0 and H={0} union Z union W. Let E and O be
the covered even and odd vertices. Each has 25 vertices. A short matching
with exactly H uncovered would give a bijection from E to O along cube
edges. Each witness supplies a nonempty S subset E and T equal to the
entire neighborhood of S inside O, with |T|<|S|. The distinct partners of
all vertices in S would belong to T, an impossible injection. Therefore
that input admits no original matching.

This proof uses only explicit neighborhoods and cardinalities. Neither
optimality of the producer matching search nor any negative solver verdict
is a premise. No realizability claim is made for the retained inputs.

##### Finite obligations and exact partition

Each witness is 22 bytes in little-endian format `<BBIQQ`: target v,
free-target flag, source record index (uint32), S mask and T mask (uint64).
Inputs are 13-byte records (sorted Z6 then W7). An independent checker
must validate all source records and their status, source hashes, unique
witness indices, S subset E, exact T=N(S) intersect O and |T|<|S|. Deleting
exactly witnessed indices in source order must reproduce every corresponding
`FOURTEEN_HALL_remaining_v{v}_{status}.bin` byte for byte.

| 7 free | 18 | 18 | 0 |
| 31 covered | 5810 | 3915 | 1895 |
| 31 free | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Total | 12546 | 8623 | 3923 |

##### Free-target assembly consequence

Once the source and finite exclusion gates are accepted, the entire
fourteen-hole free-target branch closes. For a matching of 25 short edges,
the fourteen holes consist of seven vertices of each parity. Normalize a
free endpoint to 0 by a cube automorphism; coordinate permutations send
the opposite-parity free target to 1,7 or31 according to its distance.
The accepted nearbalanced predecessor reduction, using complete twelve
holes for adjacent-hole augmentation, covers all cases outside its exact
residual. Its fourteen-hole free residual has 232,042 records. The accepted
reuse application leaves 318 free records; the cached application leaves

The free branch assembly must independently check that the source reduction

#### Fourteen-hole residual structure and one new maximal-A sufficient route

2026-11-02. Proof-writer/producer `/root/fourteen_reuse_review`. **All new structural computations, reduction and finite application below require fresh independent review.** This work does not self-accept its results and does not modify any frozen source or main state.

##### Exact structure of the3,923 Hall-retained covered records

The source streams are `FOURTEEN_HALL_remaining_v{1,7,31}_covered.bin`,13-byte sorted Z6/W7 records. Their3,923 geometries are invariant under the coordinate-permutation stabilizer fixing root0 and target v. Exhausting that actual group yields88 exact disjoint orbits:

The JSON supplies all marked sets, every covered-graph allowed/forced edge, one explicit25-edge perfect matching, actual target-mate possibilities, and cut structures. Unlike the earlier Hall exclusions, every retained representative has a positive original matching. Its orbit images give positive matchings for every record.

For each representative we orient covered-graph nonmatching edges E->O and matching edges O->E. An edge outside the chosen perfect matching occurs in some perfect matching exactly when it lies on a directed alternating cycle; equivalently its endpoints are mutually reachable. A chosen matching edge is forced exactly when it lies on no such cycle. This is exact because the symmetric difference of two perfect matchings is a disjoint union of alternating cycles; conversely flipping one directed alternating cycle gives another perfect matching.

There are575 records with no forced edge,3,036 with one and312 with two. In every forced case, every forced edge has a covered endpoint of degree one. The JSON includes this elementary positive certificate: all five other cube neighbors of the stated leaf are original holes. Thus every original matching must use that unique covered neighbor. Exactness of the complete classification uses the alternating-cycle argument; the new necessary-edge evidence needs no unsuccessful matching search.

The root-neighborhood histogram is explicit in the JSON. In particular the575 records with no forced edge consist of455 v31 records with all six root neighbors holes and120 v31 records with five root neighbors holes. Every v1/v7 record has at least one degree-one-forced original edge.

##### Two explored routes and their boundaries

A root-in-obstruction extension is valid under an additional internal-edge certificate. If a local single forced pair is root-q and q has an original forced short edge q-h internally in B, then that edge is unchanged by suppression: q has Y parity, h has opposite parity and hence is outside Y; neither endpoint is an attachment port. Therefore actual L contains q-h and cannot contain root-q. For several disjoint same-parity forced pairs, the component of L+R through root-q exits V(R) at h and cannot be cyclic; other obstruction cycles are avoided by the usual completion-pair construction. The automatic deletion-gap inequality is unchanged because root is not an original port.

We exhaustively tested this sufficient geometric route using every accepted explicit forced class and the new six single/two double candidate classes from [FOURTEEN_FORCED_candidate_classes.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_FORCED_candidate_classes.json). Every original forced edge was justified by its degree-one endpoint. It yields zero additional hits on these3,923 records. This is a failure of this conservative route, not a negative path result. The new local candidates remain conditional on their separate local acceptance gate.

For the maximal-A route,22 orbits/888 records have at least one usable accepted marked B option before solving the A finite premise. Intersecting with the separately produced `FOURTEEN_FORCED_remaining_v*_covered.bin` leaves only three orbits/180 records, indices79,85,87 in the structure table. This intersection avoids redoing previously covered work. The fullA finite run below closes the middle orbit as a producer sufficient construction; the other two remain open under this route.

##### New60-record representative and exact theorem

Take root u=0,target v=31 and

Z={39,43,45,51,60,63}, W={1,2,4,8,14,16,32}.

Its stabilizer orbit fixing u,v has60 records, all in the new FORCED residual. We claim conditionally on the finite certificate gate below that **every realizing original25-short-edge matching M** has a Hamilton0--31 path containing M with only short new edges. No original matching is chosen favorably.

Cut by bit32, with A=Q5 at bit32 zero. All Z lie in B. A holes are0 and J={1,2,4,8,14,16}; B holes are Z union {32}. Because63 is a hole, covered target31 must be internally A-matched. Write L=M restricted to A. Its graph G has

E={3,5,6,9,10,12,15,17,18,20,23,24,27,29,30},
O={7,11,13,19,21,22,25,26,28,31}.

Every t in T={7,11,13,19,28,31}=mirror(Z) is internally L-covered: crossing at t would require its B mirror, which is a hole. Extend L by adding short G edges to any inclusion-maximal matching Lstar. This preserves all original edges and coverage of T. The target mate h=L(31)=Lstar(31) is unchanged. There are at most10 Lstar edges, so at least five even G vertices remain unmatched.

The finite certificate supplies for every such maximal Lstar:

- an unmatched even q, a t in T minus {31} adjacent to q;
- distinct unit holes w,b in {1,2,4,8,16};
- a short forest P on A minus {0,31}, degree two at q,b and degree one everywhere else, containing q-t;

All duplicates between required and forest edges are labeled two-edge cycles and are rejected. The finite test does not replace this premise by a deficient universal rank.

Let Xstar be the unmatched vertices of G. With S=J minus {w,b}, |S|=4, the endpoints of P+Lstarprime are exactly (Xstar minus {q}) union S. The original unmatched surplus is five even vertices; removing q leaves surplus four, and S adds four odd endpoints. Thus the endpoint counts are balanced. There are at least eight endpoints, hence at least four path components. Pair the endpoints across opposite parities to join the paths cyclically: alternate the even-even and odd-odd paths (whose numbers agree), insert even-odd paths, and orient/concatenate cyclically; if all paths are even-odd simply concatenate them consistently. This gives a matching Dstar joining distinct components into one thirty-cycle C_A=P+Lstarprime+Dstar.

For actual Lprime=L minus31-h plus w-h, put D=Dstar union (Lstarprime minus Lprime). This is a matching because the second set is contained in Lstarprime and Dstar avoids its covered vertices. The cycle is also P+Lprime+D. Its deletion endpoints are exactly the original A crossing ports minus q, together with S. A maximal extension is therefore sufficient for every original L contained in it. The additional original odd hole14 is explicitly in S and is covered by Dstar, never by Lstar; it is not silently treated as an original matching endpoint.

Delete D and the short edge q-t from C_A. The edge q-t is disjoint from D: q is Lstar-unmatched and excluded from Dstar endpoints, while t is originally internally L-covered and hence covered by Lprime. Attach all actual M crossings, the four short bridges from S and the short bridge t--mirror(t). The consumed B vertex mirror(t) was a Z hole. The actual compressed B matching has minority hole {32}, majority holes (Z minus {mirror(t)}) union Y (nine vertices), and omissions exactly Y (four vertices). This is an exact marked T19 input, not an unmarked type assertion. Every finite option is transported simultaneously to one of the accepted [TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_REVIEW.json) rows79,178,361,363,373.

The selected obstruction pair has at least one endpoint in {mirror(w),mirror(b)}. Consequently the actual compressed matching cannot contain that same-parity obstruction pair. Apply its accepted local iff theorem to obtain a cycle on B minus Y, retaining the arbitrary compressed matching with short new edges.

Expand every compressed path and suppressed original edge. This yields one sixty-two-cycle on Q6 minus0,31 containing the modified matching F=M minus31-h plus w-h. Remove w-h, prepend the short0-w edge, and append the original short h-31 edge. The resulting Hamilton0--31 path retains every original edge, including h-31; all completion edges and compression placeholders have disappeared. The only new physical edges are short.

The full domain is every inclusion-maximal G matching covering T, not merely maximum matchings. Free records additionally have full hole-set independence in this conditional reduced domain; the producer checks it rather than silently assuming it. No original matching or matching-realizability exclusion is sampled.

For every source geometry with a valid selected witness, every realizing original short matching has a Hamilton root--target extension with only short new edges, **relative to the named accepted local/transfer inputs**. This assertion needs fresh review of the new actual application and its exact record sets. Source normalization/reduction is separately conditional on full twelve holes, even though the scan itself is a finite computation on fixed files.

##### Accepted registry boundary

[FOURTEEN_REUSE_prepare.py](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_REUSE_prepare.py) requires final PASS for every gate before writing its new registry. Old frozen files are only read. The four old accepted lookup files are hash-compared against [HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_REVIEW.json) and reused without modification:

- old55 T26, old T15 cores/marked split plus15 rank inputs, old10 unforced T17, old7 T63 rank inputs;
- analytic complete T44, accepted T63 marked2/4-hole and1/2-omission split, and the accepted T15 short augmentation to T44;
- exactly55 accepted T37 local inputs;
- exactly111 accepted new unforced T28/T19/T84/T105 inputs;
- exactly11 EXTRA_TYPES accepted inputs (10 T26,1 unforced T17);
- all seven old forced T17,27 accepted forced T28/T19,15 accepted extra forced T17, and10 accepted STAR_B forced T17 inputs.

The additional explicit families contain236 local rows (55+111+11+7+27+15+10), generating44085 normalized synchronous marked keys,5820 forced. The catalog records each canonical geometry, exact local ID, forced pair, originating final review and review hash. This is not the producer's larger232 or293 reserve registry. The old lookup files contribute their separately accepted scopes. No unreviewed MAmax, mixed-opening, root-mirror author candidate, star A theorem, or new GNS application is used.

Minority/majority/omission sets and any forced endpoints are transformed together under coordinate permutations and translations. Normalize an actual geometry using one minority anchor if present, otherwise one omission. For each canonical source, all possible minority anchors (or omission anchors for empty minority) are generated before all120 coordinate permutations. Required matching edges are arbitrary complete-graph edges in every imported local theorem; they may be long or same-parity after compression.

Family numbers1..7 refer to the old accepted interfaces;10=T37,11=111 unforced,12=EXTRA11,20=old forced7,21=forced27,22=forced15,23=STAR_B10. Exact definitions and source review hashes are in [FOURTEEN_REUSE_catalog.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_REUSE_catalog.json).

##### Uniform fourteen-hole source transfer

Fix any realizing original short M, target-facing cut A and complementary face B. Put a=|Z intersect A|, b=|W intersect A|, and delta=1 if root0 belongs to A.

In even consumption require b>=1 and s=a+1-b>=0. Choose S of size s from Z intersect A. In odd consumption put s=b-a-1>=1 and choose S from W intersect A excluding a free target and the root mirror. In either case Y is the set of selected source mirrors. The code checks the exact source pool, count and original-mirror nonhole condition.

The final B matching has actual marked shape:

- even: minority k-a-1=6-a, majority k-b+s=7-b+s, omissions Y of size s;
- odd: minority k-b=7-b, majority k-a-1+s=6-a+s, omissions Y of size s.

Here majority is simply the branch's designated local parity class; every accepted imported shape has that exact orientation and count. Actual sets, not just those counts, are looked up.

For even consumption choose local root u and pair X_A union S when delta=1; when delta=0 choose r in S and pair X_A union(S minus r). For odd consumption choose root u and pair X_A union S when delta=1; when delta=0 choose a free even port r and pair (X_A minus r) union S. The latter port exists by surplus b-a=s+1. The port identity |X_A intersect E|-|X_A intersect O|=b-a-delta makes every completion set even. All completion vertices are free for M_A and exclude the local root and any free target.

The completed matching has balanced b:b holes in even consumption and (a+1):(a+1) holes in odd consumption. The accepted FULL Q5 arbitrary-matching endpoint theorem applies for every feasible balanced count, not merely the old small b/a ranges. Artificial completion edges may be arbitrary. The local root remains free/even, target remains odd and may be free or covered. Feasibility follows from the actual matching, not an unproved hole-count extrapolation. Zero crossings use the declared five-direction endpoint input.

Delete completion edges D from the A Hamilton path, attach actual crossings and selected bridges, add the tagged root--target edge, and compress the resulting forest. With root in A and positive crossings, every used source count is at least2 and parity forces D nonempty; the tagged A cycle is cut. With root in B, attachments are distinct B leaves, including its tag leaf. The covered target-port boundary is allowed: deletion can isolate target v in A, but crossing and tag restore degree two. A free target cannot lie in D.

Each y in Y is originally internally B-covered: its free A mirror excludes crossing coverage, nonroot independence excludes another original hole, and legal sources exclude the root. Its distinct original short mate has parity opposite Y, outside Y/ports/free root. Only those pendant conflicts occur, so simultaneous suppression cannot make a conflict cycle. The actual L is a perfect matching on B minus H_*, H_*=(H intersect B minus root) union Y. This proves the marked counts and sets used by the scanner. Applying an accepted universal local cycle on exactly B minus Y, expanding all paths and deleting the tag gives the specified Hamilton path, preserving every original edge and only short new physical edges.

The argument is the accepted general source transfer with the already accepted full balanced Q5 input. It does not import an unproved thirteen/fourteen-hole endpoint theorem or full twelve-hole closure into the *local* construction. The latter is a separate conditional predecessor gate only for reducing arbitrary original fourteen-hole geometries to this source domain.

##### Forced-classification hypothesis discharge

Each forced registry row supplies a single actual pair pq of covered B vertices with parity Y, and local cycle existence iff that pair is absent from arbitrary L. Its source count is3 or4, within the accepted generic forced-cherry theorem's s>=3 scope. The scanner transports pq with the same automorphism as the marked sets and rejects root-in-obstruction witnesses. Root0 is in B exactly when the target's cut bit is1; its projection then is0, so the actual forced mask must omit bit0 in that case.

Consequently the generic root-not-OB theorem applies to every actual original matching: an unchanged internal pair cannot produce the same-parity obstruction; suppressed source mates have the opposite parity; if both obstruction endpoints are ports, prescribe their actual A crossing-partner pair inside D and keep the automatic spare deletion gap. This excludes pq from the **actual compressed L**, not just original M_B. The unknown target mate is never chosen favorably. Root-in-pair records are not accepted through this forced route even if a different proof might solve them.

The new root-mirror-omitted author transfer and A mixed-opening ideas are not used. STAR_B10 is used solely as its accepted local forced classification and combined with the already accepted generic root-not-OB transfer in this different14-hole application.

Reproduction:

It tries all six target-facing cuts and every legal source subset whose exact shape can enter the accepted registry. On success it keeps the first valid witness; rejected records exhaust all eligible choices. No claim about optimal witness tie-breaking or all per-orbit hit sets is made.

The target/status come from the filename. Source indices refer to the original thirteen-byte input, not a filtered array. Selected witnesses occupy about288 MiB. The six new thirteen-byte residual files occupy about0.60 MiB total and retain exact original labels and source order.

The producer replay independently reads all witnesses and source records again, checks indices/order/alignment, reconstructs source legality and actual marked masks, replays exact family membership and forced-root exclusion, and compares every missing source record to the next residual record byte-for-byte. All9436232 positive witnesses and48211 residual records pass. This uses shared producer predicate helpers and is explicitly **producer sanity, not independent application acceptance**. #### Expanded B inputs close two more fourteen-hole root-star orbits

2026-11-02. ARIS proof-writer candidate; independent review pending.

##### Exact claim and source

From the exact2,527 covered-target residual accepted by
FOURTEEN_MAXIMAL_A_REVIEW, two disjoint60-record orbits are covered here.
The new remaining counts are240/702/1,465 for targets1/7/31, totaling2,407.
The free-target branch remains accepted. Full14 and P6 remain OPEN.

Both representatives have u=0,v=31, W={1,2,4,8,14,16,32}, all six Z in
the bit32 face B. Their projected sets T=Z xor32 are:

- orbit79: {7,11,13,19,21,31};
- orbit87: {7,11,13,22,26,31}.

The record orbits use every permutation of the first five coordinates,
fixing0,31 and the outer coordinate. Every actual transport, original source
index and exact remaining stream is supplied in FOURTEEN_STAR_EXPANDED_transport.json.

##### Universal maximal-A reduction

Let A be the bit32-zero face, J={1,2,4,8,16,14}, E the15 nonzero even
vertices of A, and O the10 odd vertices outside J. The original internal
matching L=M_A lies in G=Q5[E union O]. Every t in T is internally matched
in A because its mirror is an original B hole. In particular v=31 is
internally matched. Extend L by adding short edges in G to an
inclusion-maximal matching Lstar, still covering T. This preserves all
original edges. It suffices to supply a compatible construction for every
such Lstar, with later-added edges treated as completion edges.

For each Lstar, the finite certificate chooses an unmatched even q,
t in T minus{31} adjacent to q, and distinct unit vertices w,b. Set
S=J minus{w,b}; it has four odd source holes, including14. Replace the
Lstar edge31-hstar by w-hstar to form Lstarprime. The selected short forest
P on A minus{0,31} has degree2 at q,b and degree1 at every other retained
vertex, contains q-t, and P+Lstarprime is acyclic as a labeled graph.
Its free endpoints form equal nonempty even/odd sets (at least8 in total).
An opposite-parity matching Dstar joins its path components into a30-cycle
CA. This is the same balanced-endpoint gluing lemma used in the accepted
maximal-A reduction: orient even-odd paths, and alternate even-even and
odd-odd paths; the endpoint count guarantees the required pairing.

Let h be the actual original mate of31, and Lprime=L minus31-h plus w-h.
Since31 was already matched in L, h=hstar, so Lprime subset Lstarprime.
Use D=Dstar union(Lstarprime minus Lprime). Every added edge has endpoints
originally unmatched internally in A, and therefore represents a completion
edge rather than an original requirement. D is a matching on the actual
A cross ports except q, together with the four sources S. In particular14
remains a source, never an edge endpoint of Lstar. The same CA retains every
edge of Lprime and every edge of D. These assertions are universal for
all original submatchings, not just maximal ones.

Delete D and the opening q-t from CA. Attach the actual original crossing
edges (including the crossing at q), the four bridges s--(s xor32), and
the opening bridge t--(t xor32). The latter consumes one original B hole.
Compress the transferred A paths. At each source mirror Y, the original
internal short edge has a mate outside Y; simultaneous pendant-mate
suppression yields the B required matching. Its marked holes are
minority{0}, majority(T minus{t}) union S, omissions S, in projected B labels.
This is a1:9 four-omission input. All translations and permutations apply
simultaneously to these sets and the forced pair below.

The two retained neighbors of the included minority hole0 are exactly
w,b: S removes three of the five unit neighbors and the nonunit14.
Thus the local forced pair is R={w,b}. Both original B vertices corresponding
to w,b are internally matched by original short edges, since their A mirrors
are original holes. They are neither cross ports nor source mirrors.
Their original mates have the opposite parity from Y, so suppression leaves
those short edges unchanged. Therefore the actual compressed matching
cannot contain the same-parity pair R. The accepted single-cherry
classification applies once the new marked local rank inputs are audited.

Expand the B avoiding-S cycle and all suppressed paths. This produces a
62-cycle on Q6 minus{u,v} containing F=M minus(vh) plus(wh). Delete its
auxiliary edge wh, prepend the short edge u-w and append h-v, restoring
the original matching edge hv. The result is a Hamilton u-v path containing
every edge of the original M. The construction and its boundary conditions
are the generic argument independently checked for orbit85; the two new
T sets change only the finite A and B premises checked here.

##### Ten new positive B inputs

All200 ordered choices t,w,b in the two representatives were used only
to search for useful local inputs. The actual A certificates use ten
canonical B classes, indices0,1,7,8,17,24,25,26,30,35 in
FOURTEEN_STAR_B_EXPAND_profile.json. Only these ten are premises.

Each has22 covered vertices. Every selected short forest contains the
forced cherry through0 joining its two retained unit neighbors. Deleting
that fixed endpoint pair gives20 reduced terminals. The supplied512 by512
matrix has full GF2 rank512. For any F not containing the forced pair,
contracting its two incident edges across that pair gives a perfect matching
on20 terminals. The generic connectivity-rank theorem supplies a compatible
forest, and expanding restores the local cycle. If F contains the pair,
the forced cherry makes an isolated triangle, so no spanning cycle exists.

The reduced prefixes are FOURTEEN_STAR_B_REDUCED_orbit_iii. Each has512
forests of34 bytes, full endpoint pairs22 bytes, reduced pairs/columns20
bytes and matrix/pivot/combination rows64 bytes. Metadata pins source column
indices. Independent checking must reconstruct forests, full/reduced pairs,
every2,621,440 connectivity bit and all ten ranks. Candidate ranks for the
other32 classes are not imported.

##### Complete positive A premises and actual partition

The A graph G has15 even and10 odd vertices. The complete maximal T-covered
domains have285,153 and289,791 elements respectively, total574,944:

The two *_A_full_{79,87}_certificates.bin files use the previous32-byte

Independent verification must establish a complete maximal domain (for
example independent enumeration or independent counting plus uniqueness),

transport into one of the ten audited classes, and the exact120 source
