#### General Q4 inputs obtained by short-edge augmentation

Date: 2026-11-01. These consequences use the already certified N14_4,
A4_4,N10_4,K4_4 from [Q4_CORE_AND_A4_SPLIT.md](#proof-q4-core-and-a4-split), not Q5 A4 or full P6.

##### Geometric fact

Any two distinct vertices of the same parity in Q4 have at least six
distinct neighbors: their distance is two or four, giving respectively
two or zero common neighbors among their four neighbors each. Therefore
at most two opposite-parity vertices are nonadjacent to both. Consequently
any two free vertices of one parity and three free vertices of the other
parity contain a short edge between the two sets.

##### GQ4-avoid

Let F be any matching of K(Q4) whose holes have counts m and m+2 in the
two parity classes. For any prescribed hole v in the larger class, F
extends to a circle through exactly Q4 minus v, with only short new edges.

For m=0 use N14_4. For m=1 use A4_4. For m>=2 choose two holes in the
smaller class and three holes in the larger class excluding v; the latter
are available because m+1>=3. The geometric fact supplies a short edge
between these free sets. Add it to F, preserving v as free and decreasing
m by one. Repeat to a base case. The base-case circle contains all added
edges, which were short, so it is also the required extension of F.

##### GQ4-path

Let F be any matching of K(Q4) with equally many holes in both parity
classes. For any free root r and any opposite-parity vertex y, F extends
to a Hamilton r--y path with only short new edges.

If each class has one hole, use N10_4; if each has two, use K4_4. If each
has m>=3 holes, choose two holes of r's parity distinct from r and three
holes of the other parity. Add a short edge given by the geometric fact.
This preserves r as free and reduces m by one. The target y is allowed
to become covered: N10_4/K4_4 do not require it to remain free. Iterate
to a base case, whose path preserves the original matching. All added
matching edges were short, as required.

##### GQ4-cycle

Every matching of K(Q4) with balanced hole counts extends to a Hamilton
circle with only short new edges. If there are no holes, use Fink's
perfect-matching theorem. Otherwise use GQ4-path from a free root to a
short neighbor and add their short edge to close the spanning path.

These general Q4 lemmas are available for the next five-dimensional
auxiliary problems arising from the eight-hole Q6 layer. They do not
themselves establish any whole eight-hole or higher P6 level.


</details>


<details id="proof-q4-perfect-endpoint-abundance" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md — Q4 完美匹配的 Hamilton 路径端点丰度</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md)。SHA-256：`aea312b744c6c6902128007c8a08853b32980eeae5c7ecb83429b3b52feb57a8`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json), [Q4_NEIGHBOR_ABUNDANCE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q4_NEIGHBOR_ABUNDANCE_REVIEW.json), [T15_NEW_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/T15_NEW_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [T44_SAMEFACE_ZERO_CROSSING_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/T44_SAMEFACE_ZERO_CROSSING_REVIEW.json)。

#### Q4 完美匹配的 Hamilton 路径端点丰度

日期：2026-11-01。状态：有限证书和逆像穷尽核验 PASS；Q5 T15、P6 不由此关闭。
完整 Q5 A4 及 A6/K6 的先前已证状态不变。

##### 定理

设 $P$ 为完全图 $K(Q_4)$ 上的任意完美匹配，允许长边和同奇偶边。
固定根 $0$，令 $G(P)$ 为所有满足下述条件的奇顶点 $y$ 的集合：存在 Hamilton $0$--$y$ 路径，
包含 $P$ 的每条边，且每条不属于 $P$ 的路径边都是短边。

则

$$|G(P)|\ge4,\qquad G(P)\cap\{7,11,13,14\}\ne\varnothing.$$

两条下界都能取等。平移所有顶点可得任意根 $r$ 的版本：至少四个异奇偶可行端点，
且至少一个与根距离 3 的可行端点。

所有大小恰为 4 的端点集精确如下，每种发生于 105 个完美匹配：

| 精确可行奇端点集 $G(P)$ | 个数 |
| --- | ---: |
| $\{1,2,4,7\}$ | 105 |
| $\{1,2,8,11\}$ | 105 |
| $\{1,4,8,13\}$ | 105 |
| $\{2,4,8,14\}$ | 105 |

例如 $P=\{01,23,45,67,89,(10)(11),(12)(13),(14)(15)\}$（全部位 1 方向短边）
恰有端点 $\{2,4,8,14\}$。因此不存在把“四”改成“五”或把“一个距离 3 端点”改成“两个”的普遍结论。

##### 路径与避两孔圈的精确等价

若 $P(0)=y$，任何包含 $P$ 的路径在两个端点处都必须使用边 $0y$，它会成为两个顶点的独立分量，
所以不可能是 16 顶点 Hamilton 路径。

现在设 $P(0)=a\ne y$，记 $P(y)=b$。四点 $0,y,a,b$ 不同，定义

$$T=P-\{0a,yb\}+\{ab\}.$$

这是恰有孔 $0,y$ 的七边匹配。存在目标 Hamilton $0$--$y$ 路径，
**当且仅当**存在避开 $0,y$、包含 $T$ 且新增边短的 14 圈。

证明：路径的端点边必为 $0a,yb$。删去两个端点得到覆盖其余 14 点的 $a$--$b$ 路径，
加上 $ab$ 得到圈。其余边保留 $P-\{0a,yb\}$，新增的辅助边 $ab$ 已列为 $T$ 的必含边。
14 点路径的两个端点不会已经相邻，否则长度只能为一条边，所以不会产生重边。
反向从圈删除其必含边 $ab$，在两个端点分别接回 $a0,by$，即得到所需路径。
两方向都保留原匹配的所有边，所有非匹配边仍短。

##### 已认证的两张完整圈表及本次复核

两个基础孔型为 $\{0,1\}$ 和 $\{0,7\}$，分别对应距离 1 和距离 3。
每张表包含 $13!!=135135$ 个匹配；正记录给出显式 14 圈，负记录圈区为全 255。
已有完整审计见 [CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW.md](CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW.md)。

本次独立 checker 直接读取两张二进制表，不导入旧生成器、checker 或保存的例外 JSON，重新验证：

| 孔型 | 匹配记录 | 正圈 | 负例 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| $0,1$ | 135135 | 135084 | 51 |
| $0,7$ | 135135 | 135082 | 53 |

匹配均通过 mate 对合和孔支持检查；独立的匹配秩没有重复且覆盖完整区间。
每个正圈检查确切支持集、所有匹配边以及新增边短。
对每个负例，枚举所有与原匹配边不重合的短完美匹配：任何所需圈都必须由原七边匹配与这样一个
短完美匹配组成。checker 直接计算每个所得 2-factor 的连通分量，全部都超过一个，故严格证明不可行。
结果 JSON 保存全部 104 个负例及其补匹配的分量计数分布；没有信任失败的 Hamilton 搜索。

任意奇 $y$ 的重量为 1 或 3；选取把 1 或 7 映到 $y$ 的坐标置换，将相应完整负例表传送到孔 $0,y$。
固定任何一个这样的置换都足够，因为它在全部匹配上给出双射。输出保存了八个置换。

##### 只枚举负例逆像足以证明全称命题

给定一个不可行 $T$，对它每条边 $ab$ 及两个方向，构造

$$P=T-\{ab\}+\{0a,yb\}.$$

这些恰好是所有满足 $P(0)\ne y$ 且在 $y$ 不可行的完美匹配。
任意这样的 $P$ 经正向公式必得到一个负表记录，再选其辅助边 $ab$ 就能被逆构造找回；
反之，每个逆构造的 $P$ 在该 $y$ 不可行，由上面的等价直接得到。

四个距离 1 端点、四个距离 3 端点，共生成
$4(51+53)\cdot7\cdot2=5824$ 个带端点标签的逆像，去重后得到 **4708** 个完美匹配。
对每个候选再次遍历八个奇端点，计算正向 $T$ 并查负表，与逆生成端点集合核对，
另外加入 $P(0)$ 为奇点时的必坏端点。所得精确分布为：

| 坏奇端点数 | 4708 个候选中的完美匹配数 |
| --- | ---: |
| 1 | 2072 |
| 2 | 2180 |
| 3 | 36 |
| 4 | 420 |

候选之外的每个完美匹配，除可能的奇点 $P(0)$ 外，其余七个或八个奇端点全部可行。
因此没有扫描其余约两百万个正匹配，也没有遗漏任意一个可能有两个以上坏端点的输入。
上表最大坏数为 4，证明第一个下界。

候选内的可行距离 3 端点数分布为 $\{1:420,2:276,3:2212,4:1800\}$；
候选外至少有三个可行距离 3 端点。因此所有完美匹配至少有一个距离 3 可行端点，证明第二个下界。
不存在四个重量 3 奇端点全部不可行的完美匹配。

这里“最小端点集”如指最小**基数**，精确为开头的四种大小 4 集合；
如指在全部可能端点集中按包含关系极小，则共有 22 种（4 个大小 4、12 个大小 5、6 个大小 6），
完整列表也保存在结果 JSON 中，避免混淆这两个含义。

##### 可复现文件和使用边界

独立实现：[q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.py](q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.py)。
执行命令：

```powershell
D:\anaconda\python.exe research\six_directions\q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.py
```

结果：[q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.json](q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.json)，
包含 4708 个候选的全部匹配边与精确坏端点集合、两表哈希、checker 哈希及上述计数。
整个结论只使用 Q4 的有限证书，不调用 Q5 或 P6。
在拼接中可直接使用“任意完美匹配至少一个距离 3 可行端点”；要推出 Q5 T15 的具体分支，
仍须单独核对顶点映射、端点交集及原边保持等拼接条件。


</details>


<details id="proof-q4-rich-gluing" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q4_RICH_GLUING.md — Opposite forbidden parities force intersecting optional-edge unions</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q4_RICH_GLUING.md)。SHA-256：`69ac96bc618aeffdf4c3d1d1094d80d783a9ac6d5c7bd55a6120d377a5dd4b19`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_REVIEW.json), [Q4_RICH_GLUING_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q4_RICH_GLUING_REVIEW.json), [TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json), [TEN_HOLE_FREE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_FREE_REVIEW.json)。

#### Opposite forbidden parities force intersecting optional-edge unions

Date: 2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer draft; independent audit pending.
This is a four-dimensional gluing input, not the full Q5 T15 theorem.

##### Exact claim

On one labeled Q4, let L have exactly two same-parity holes, one specified
as forbidden vertex a. Let R have either two same-parity holes including
its forbidden vertex b, or four holes with parity counts 1:3 and b in
the majority class. Assume a and b have opposite parities.
Both matchings are arbitrary matchings of K(Q4), not necessarily short.

There is a short edge e outside BOTH matchings and extending 15-cycles
C_L on Q4-a and C_R on Q4-b, each containing its matching and e, and
having all new edges short.

Equivalently, their optional-new-edge unions intersect. The two cycles
may be chosen independently after choosing the common edge. No simultaneous
prescription of a whole optional-edge union in a single cycle is asserted.

##### Dependencies and normalization

Translate a to 0, so b is odd. Coordinate permutations reduce the other
hole of L to 3 or 15. The same two-hole normalization applies to R when
it has two holes. Four-hole R with a short edge between its minority hole
and a nonforbidden majority hole reduces by adding that edge to a two-hole
instance, still avoiding b.

For remaining four-hole R, translate the minority hole to 0. Its two
nonforbidden majority holes have weight three, so permute them to 7,11.
The remaining forbidden majority hole has representatives 1,4,13. This
classification was checked on all marked geometries in
[A6_FINITE_INPUTS_REVIEW.md](#review-a6-finite-inputs-review); it uses no Q5 theorem.

##### Positive certificates, not exact spectrum assumptions

The files [q4_n14_rich_3.bin](research/six_directions/q4_n14_rich_3.bin), [q4_n14_rich_15.bin](research/six_directions/q4_n14_rich_15.bin) list every matching
with the corresponding two holes 0,p, avoiding 0. Each has 135135 records.
The files [q4_a4_rich_1.bin](research/six_directions/q4_a4_rich_1.bin), `_4.bin`, `_13.bin` list every matching
with holes 0,7,11,v, avoiding v. Each has 10395 records.
Each record stores the sixteen mate bytes (255 denotes a hole), a one-byte
cycle count, and that many explicit 15-vertex cycles. Define the stored
union U to be the union of all their edges outside the required matching.
It is a subset of the true optional-edge union.

[verify_q4_rich_spectrum_gluing.py](research/six_directions/verify_q4_rich_spectrum_gluing.py) verifies matching rank coverage,
each cycle's exact vertices, every required edge and every new short edge.
It checks all 301455 records and 1634808 positive cycles. Every stored
union has at least 15 edges. Call a stored union high if it has at least
18 edges, and low otherwise. The low records are exactly:

- holes 0,3: 6 records, each with stored union size 16;
- holes 0,15: 36 records, each with stored union size 15;
- four-hole representative v=4: 20 records;
- four-hole representatives v=1,13: no low records.

These statements concern stored, witnessed unions. An exact upper bound
on the true spectrum is not required. The producer may have explored all
cycles on a low record, but this proof never relies on that exhaustiveness.

If either matching has a high witnessed union and the other has a union
of size at least 15, intersection follows from 18+15>32, since Q4 has
32 edges. It remains to compare the finite low candidates.

##### Complete coverage of low candidates

Expand the two-hole low records under all coordinate permutations. This
gives 72 distinct candidate matchings with forbidden vertex 0. For the
second face, also translate by each odd vertex; there are 576 distinct
two-hole candidates with odd forbidden vertex. If different transported
certificates describe the same matching and forbidden vertex, take the
union of their stored unions. This is still a witnessed subset of the
true optional-edge union, so is valid for improving the bound.

For a four-hole R admitting an added short edge f, set P=R+f. If P is high,
R is high as well: every witnessed new edge for P is a new edge for R.
If P is low, R is obtained by deleting f from one of the transported
two-hole low candidates. The same witnessed cycles show the union
U(P) union {f} is available for R. Enumerate removal of every SHORT
required edge from every such low P. This includes each potentially low
adjacent-reducible R; it may also include R that has another high completion,
which is harmless. Repeated R candidates can again merge their unions.

For nonadjacent four-hole R, transport the 20 low representative records
under all 384 Q4 automorphisms and retain odd forbidden vertices. Combine
these candidates with those obtained by edge removal. After merging
and discarding unions already of size at least 18, 4128 four-hole
candidates remain. All have witnessed unions of size at least 15.

No matching outside these lists can lack a high certificate: the two-hole
tables, the four-hole residual tables, and the adjacent augmentation
exhaust all input possibilities. In particular the procedure never assumes
that a low table entry has a mathematically small exact spectrum.

##### Finite intersection and conclusion

The verifier compares every one of the 72 first-face low candidates
with all 576 second-face two-hole candidates and all 4128 second-face
four-hole candidates. In every pair the witnessed unions intersect;
the minimum intersection size is three in each comparison. Thus the
low-low cases hold as well. This proves the exact claim.

##### Five-dimensional consequences

Consider a matching F of K(Q5) with two prescribed omitted holes of the
same GLOBAL parity. Split into Q4 faces A,B separating the omitted holes.
Suppose either each face has exactly two holes of that parity (the
T44_5 split case), or one face has two holes of that parity and the other
has 1:3 holes with that parity the majority (the T15 split case).

The crossing count c is even. If c>0, pair A ports into D and use the
appropriate Q4 avoided cycle on A. Delete D, attach original crossings,
and compress paths onto B ports. The B matching has exactly its original
holes; its avoided-cycle theorem supplies the second cycle, and expansion
gives one 30-vertex circle omitting the two prescribed holes.

If c=0, the faces' required matchings are independent. On identifying
the two faces by short bridges, their omitted vertices have opposite
LOCAL parities because their GLOBAL parities agree. The present theorem
supplies corresponding optional edges in the two avoided cycles. Delete
those edges and add the two short bridges joining corresponding endpoints.
The result is a single 30-vertex circle. Required edges are never removed,
and the new bridges are short. This closes the zero-crossing case as well.

Thus these two geometric split conditions suffice for ALL original
matchings, regardless of crossing count. Other T44_5/T15 geometries and
full Q6 P6 are not asserted here.


</details>


<details id="proof-q4-t15-classification" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION.md — Q4 T15：精确分类（含可核验正证书与解析负证书）</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION.md)。SHA-256：`bab8d4cecffa46f3f8fb55046a381cfa0303878671f7b273f6ae011630c68adc`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.json), [A10_ORBIT2_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A10_ORBIT2_REVIEW.json), [A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW.json), [A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW.json), [A8_ORBIT5_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A8_ORBIT5_FULL_REVIEW.json), [A8_ORBITS2_3_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A8_ORBITS2_3_REVIEW.json), [EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json), [Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW.json), [Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json), [T15_NEW_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/T15_NEW_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [T15_SINGLE_AVOIDED_FACE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/T15_SINGLE_AVOIDED_FACE_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Q4 T15：精确分类（含可核验正证书与解析负证书）

日期：2026-11-01。状态：Q4 分类已独立核验；Q5 T15、P6 仍未关闭。
完整 Q5 A4 及 A6/K6 已由先前独立证明包关闭并审计，本任务不改变这些结论。

##### 定义与定理

把 $V(Q_4)$ 写为 $\{0,\ldots,15\}$，短边指端点异或为 $1,2,4,8$ 的边。
$K(Q_4)$ 是该顶点集上的完全图；原匹配中的边可以是长边。

设 $F$ 是 $K(Q_4)$ 上的匹配，其孔集恰为 $\{a\}\cup H$，其中 $a$ 为偶顶点、
$H$ 为五个奇顶点。指定两个不同的避点 $v,w\in H$。记 $N(a)$ 为 $a$ 的四个短邻点。

**精确分类。** 存在一个顶点集恰为 $V(Q_4)\setminus\{v,w\}$、包含 $F$ 全部边、
且所有新增边均为短边的简单 14 圈，当且仅当下面的障碍不存在：

$$
\{v,w\}\subseteq N(a),\qquad
N(a)\setminus\{v,w\}=\{p,q\},\qquad pq\in F. \tag{OB}
$$

由异或平移，同一定理也适用于奇偶互换的孔型。这里首先认证的是一偶孔、五奇孔的版本。
这不是断言所有 T15 输入均可扩张：条件 (OB) 确实给出负例。

##### 障碍的必要性：被迫的三角形

假设 (OB) 成立。$a$ 是孔，因此圈在 $a$ 处的两条边均为新增短边。
两个避点 $v,w$ 不在圈上，故圈在 $a$ 处只能使用 $ap,aq$。
又 $pq\in F$，圈必须保留 $pq$。三个顶点 $a,p,q$ 已各有两条圈边，形成一个完整的三角形分量。
它不能同时属于一个连通的简单 14 圈，矛盾。
这证明每个被标为负例的输入数学上不可行，不依赖搜索失败或搜索实现的完备性。

##### 充分性第一步：有可用邻孔时增广到 T44_4

若存在 $b\in H\setminus\{v,w\}$ 与 $a$ 短邻接，则增添短边 $ab$。
由于两端都是 $F$ 的孔，$F'=F\cup\{ab\}$ 仍是匹配，其孔集为 $H\setminus\{b\}$，
恰为四个同奇偶顶点，并包含两个指定避点 $v,w$。

应用已证的 T44（即 Q4 的 T44_4）：四个同奇偶孔的任意匹配都可以扩张成一个避开指定两个孔的
14 圈，所有新增边为短边。所得圈包含 $F'$，因此包含 $F$；边 $ab$ 相对原 $F$ 也是短边。
这完整证明该分支。

这个分支不可能含 (OB)：若两个避点都是 $a$ 的邻点，而一个剩余邻点 $b$ 是孔，
则剩余两个邻点不能由 $F$ 配成一条边。

本次独立 checker 没有只引用旧审核结论，而是重新验证 T44 的全部 30 个文件、
311850 个正圈证书以及两奇偶类共 840 个有标记孔几何的覆盖。
T44 的证书参数及先前表述见 [Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_TRANSFER.md](Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_TRANSFER.md)。
本证明使用其有限 Q4 结论，不调用同一文件中的 Q5 推论，也不另行导入 Fink 定理。

##### 充分性第二步：无可用邻孔时的四个轨道

平移 $a$ 到 $0$。三个可用奇孔 $H\setminus\{v,w\}$ 都不是 $0$ 的邻点，
因而都是重量 3 顶点。四个重量 3 顶点为 $7,11,13,14$；坐标置换可把三个可用孔取成
$7,11,13$，即把唯一未选的重量 3 顶点取成 $14$。

此时两个避点必须来自 $\{1,2,4,8,14\}$。保持 $\{7,11,13\}$ 的坐标置换固定坐标位 1，
任意置换位 $2,4,8$。所以避点的无序对恰有四类：

| 避点代表 | 固定可用孔后的轨道大小 | 所有 $a=0$ 残余几何中的大小 | 匹配数 | 正证书 | 解析负例 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| $(1,2)$ | 3 | 12 | 945 | 840 | 105 |
| $(2,4)$ | 3 | 12 | 945 | 840 | 105 |
| $(1,14)$ | 1 | 4 | 945 | 945 | 0 |
| $(2,14)$ | 3 | 12 | 945 | 945 | 0 |

每个输入有十个被覆盖顶点，所有匹配共有 $9!!=945$ 个。
四个文件 `q4_six_two_avoided_v_w.bin` 各有 945 个长度 30 字节的记录：前 16 字节是 mate 数组，
值 255 表示孔；后 14 字节是圈顶点序列，全部为 255 表示负记录。

全新 checker 独立生成无序边集表示的完整匹配集合，然后逐记录核验孔、无自环对合及唯一性，
从集合删除该匹配，最终集合必须为空。对每条正记录检查：恰好 14 个不同顶点、恰好避开 $v,w$、
保留全部匹配边，且每条不属于匹配的圈边均为短边。无需信任产生圈的 DFS。

对每条负记录，checker 直接验证 (OB)，然后使用上面的三角形证明。
前两类的负记录恰为含剩余邻点边 $pq$ 的所有匹配；固定 $pq$ 后其余八个顶点有 $7!!=105$ 个匹配。
后两类有避点 $14\notin N(0)$，全部 945 个输入都有正圈证书。
四类共验证 3780 条记录，其中 3570 个正证书、210 个解析不可行证书。
这同时证明了残余分支充分性与精确性。

##### 全部有标记孔几何的独立覆盖

对固定 $a=0$，共有 $\binom85\binom52=560$ 个几何，其中 520 个属于增广分支，
40 个属于上述四个互不重叠的坐标置换轨道，轨道大小为 $12,12,4,12$。
checker 进一步遍历所有八个偶顶点 $a$，直接检验全部 $8\cdot560=4480$ 个有标记孔几何：
4160 个通过增广，320 个通过四轨道覆盖。

归一化使用图自同构 $x\mapsto\pi(x\mathbin\oplus a)$；它保留短边、匹配及圈，
把原避点对精确映到证书的避点对。没有把避点与可用孔混同，也没有丢失原匹配的任意长边。

综上，两个分支覆盖全部输入，正记录提供充分性，(OB) 提供负例的必要且充分刻画。

##### 复现与边界

独立 checker：[q4_t15_classification_independent_check.py](q4_t15_classification_independent_check.py)。
在工作区运行：

```powershell
D:\anaconda\python.exe research\six_directions\q4_t15_classification_independent_check.py
```

输出 [q4_t15_classification_independent_check.json](q4_t15_classification_independent_check.json)，
记录所有输入证书和 checker 的 SHA-256。独立审核见
[Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW.md](Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW.md) 及其 JSON。
本定理仅是 Q4 层内的精确工具。向 Q5 拼接时必须另证压缩匹配不落入 (OB)，或另行修复；
不能从这里推出 Q5 T15 或完整 P6。完整 Q5 A4 已由先前独立证明包证明，本任务没有重新证明它，
也不改变它及 A6/K6 的已关闭状态；当前结论记账见 [A6_AND_EIGHT_FREE_CLOSED.md](A6_AND_EIGHT_FREE_CLOSED.md)。


</details>


<details id="proof-q4-two-avoided-transfer" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_TRANSFER.md — Two avoided vertices in Q4 and minority-isolating A4 cuts</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_TRANSFER.md)。SHA-256：`717f1f538eaf22d8dbb40699358516c5921d2cc24df63a4fe3420bb5f80b2f48`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[A6_CLOSURE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A6_CLOSURE_REVIEW.json), [A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.json), [EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json), [Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_REVIEW.json), [Q5_T63_COMPLETE_SPLIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_T63_COMPLETE_SPLIT_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Two avoided vertices in Q4 and minority-isolating A4 cuts

Date: 2026-11-01. Status: finite certificates and reductions; independent
review pending at initial writing. Q5 A4 and full P6 remain unproved.

##### T44: four same-parity holes, two prescribed avoided holes

Let $L$ be an arbitrary matching of $K(Q_4)$ with four holes, all of the same
parity. For any two prescribed holes $x,y$, there is a cycle through exactly
$V(Q_4)\setminus\{x,y\}$, containing every edge of $L$, with only short new
edges. Thus this is a 14-vertex cycle, including the other two holes.

Translate $x$ to 0. The other holes then are even. Permute coordinates to
take $y$ to 3 or 15, covering its possible distances two and four. For each
choice, the remaining two holes are any unordered pair of the remaining six
even vertices, giving 15 configurations. Each of the 30 configurations has
$11!!=10395$ perfect matchings of its 12 covered vertices.

The files `q4_two_avoided_p_b_t.bin` contain all these matchings and a
14-cycle for each. Every 30-byte record contains a 16-byte mate array
(255 denotes holes), followed by the 14 cycle vertices. The independent
checker [verify_q4_two_avoided_certificates.py](research/six_directions/verify_q4_two_avoided_certificates.py) verifies the matching, the
cycle and its required/new edges, and complete bijective matching-rank
coverage as defined in [Q4_CORE_AND_A4_SPLIT.md](#proof-q4-core-and-a4-split). All 311850 records pass.
No Hamilton-search completeness or negative result is relied on. This proves
T44 by explicit exhaustive positive certificates and the stated symmetries.

##### S1D: minority-isolating cuts

Consider a Q5 A4 matching $F$ with minority hole $a$ and majority holes
$b,t,v$, where $v$ is forbidden. Suppose a coordinate cut has all three
majority holes in side $A$ and $a$ in side $B$. Let $w$ be the short neighbor
of $a$ across this cut. Assume $w\notin\{b,t,v\}$, and suppose either

1. $w$ is covered by an internal edge of $F_A$; or
2. $w$ is a crossing endpoint and the crossing matching has at least three
   edges.

Then the full Q5 A4 conclusion holds for $F$.

Let $C$ be the crossing matching, with endpoint sets $X_A,X_B$ and size $c$.
Since side $B$ has exactly one hole, $2|F_B|+c=15$, so $c$ is odd and positive.
Choose a perfect matching $D$ on $X_B\cup\{a\}$; an additional choice in
case 2 is specified below. Then $F_B\cup D$ is a perfect matching of $K(B)$.
By Fink's perfect-matching extension theorem it has a Hamilton circle with
only short new edges. Delete the nonempty matching $D$ to obtain disjoint
nontrivial paths with endpoints $X_B\cup\{a\}$. Attach the original edges of
$C$ at $X_B$, and attach the new short bridge $aw$ at $a$.

###### Case 1: internal partner at the bridge endpoint

The resulting paths have distinct endpoints $X_A\cup\{w\}$, and interiors
partition $B$. Compress them to a matching $R$ on this endpoint set. Its
unique overlap in covered vertices with $F_A$ is $w$. Write $k=F_A(w)$
and $d=R(w)$. The matching

$$L=(F_A\setminus\{wk\})\cup(R\setminus\{wd\})\cup\{kd\}$$

has precisely the four holes $b,t,v,w$, all of the same parity because
$w$ is opposite to the minority hole $a$. All listed edges are disjoint:
$k$ is internal to $F_A$, $d\in X_A$, and none is a hole. Apply T44 to
avoid $v,w$ and obtain a cycle on $A\setminus\{v,w\}$. Expand $kd$ into
the original edge $kw$ followed by the transferred $w$--$d$ path. Expand
every other edge of $R$. This restores $w$, all of $B$, all original edges
of $F$, and gives a single circle through $Q_5\setminus\{v\}$.

###### Case 2: a crossing partner at the bridge endpoint

Let $x\in X_B$ be the original partner of $w$. Choose $D$ to contain $ax$;
pair the remaining $c-1$ ports arbitrarily. Because $c\ge3$, $D$ has at
least two edges. In the B circle with $D$ removed, the vertices $a,x$ lie
in different path components: deleting $ax$ alone leaves an $a$--$x$
path containing every other edge of $D$, so deleting one more of those
edges separates $a$ from $x$.

After attaching $aw$ and the original $xw$, those two different paths join
at $w$ into a single path. No cycle is created. All resulting paths have
distinct endpoints $X_A\setminus\{w\}$ and disjoint interiors partitioning
$B\cup\{w\}$. Compress them to a matching $R$ on $X_A\setminus\{w\}$.
Now $L=F_A\cup R$ has the four same-parity holes $b,t,v,w$. Apply T44 avoiding
$v,w$ and expand $R$. The expanded circle restores $w$ and $B$, preserves
$F$, and uses only short new edges. This proves case 2 and S1D.

The excluded crossing case $c=1$ cannot be inserted into this proof: then
$D=\{ax\}$ and the two attachments close a separate B-side circle. A
different argument would be needed; no conclusion is asserted for it here.

##### G2D: two coordinates shared by all majority holes suffice

Normalize $a=0$. If $b,t,v$ have at least two common 1-coordinates, then
every matching with these holes satisfies Q5 A4.

Choose two such coordinates $i,j$. For each, the minority-isolating cut has
an odd positive crossing count. The bridge endpoint $w_i=2^i$ (respectively
$w_j=2^j$) is not a hole, because the majority holes have both coordinates
equal to one. Thus each endpoint is either internally matched in its
majority side, or is a crossing endpoint. S1D solves the input unless both
cuts have exactly one crossing edge and that edge meets the respective
$w_i,w_j$.

Suppose both cuts have this exceptional form. Write the unique crossing
edges as $e_i,e_j$. If they are the same edge, it must be $w_iw_j$, connecting
cells 10 and 01 in the $(i,j)$ split. No matching edge then leaves cell 00.
That 8-vertex cell has exactly one hole, $a$, so it cannot match its seven
other vertices internally. This is a contradiction.

If $e_i\ne e_j$, then $e_i$ cannot cross coordinate $j$, whose unique
crossing edge is $e_j$. Consequently $e_i$ runs from cell 10 to cell 00;
the same reasoning makes $e_j$ run from cell 01 to cell 00. No matching
edge leaves cell 11. That cell has exactly the three holes $b,t,v$, so it
cannot match its five other vertices internally. This is again a
contradiction. Therefore at least one cut satisfies S1D, proving G2D.

##### Scope together with G4D

In the 770 normalized residual Q5 hole configurations ($a=0$, unordered
nonadjacent $b,t$, distinct odd forbidden $v$), G4D from
[Q4_CORE_AND_A4_SPLIT.md](#proof-q4-core-and-a4-split) covers 255 and G2D covers 120, with intersection
30. Their union therefore covers all matchings in 345 configurations;
425 configurations remain outside these two geometry-only sufficient
conditions. S4D and S1D can additionally handle individual matchings in
that remaining domain when their crossing conditions hold.

These counts are neither matching counts nor a minimal orbit classification.
The full Q5 A4 statement, and hence the unconditional full six-hole P6
reduction, remains open. All other remaining P6 hole levels also remain open.


</details>


<details id="proof-q5-a10-full-closure" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q5_A10_FULL_CLOSURE.md — Full Q5 A10: assembly from augmentation and three marked orbits</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q5_A10_FULL_CLOSURE.md)。SHA-256：`fa7ce44e329c32d07ab4915ab1565206e03f8eee430c5fbe6f6d7d3d1506a365`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json), [HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REVIEW.json), [Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Full Q5 A10: assembly from augmentation and three marked orbits

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate; final independent acceptance pending.

##### Claim

For every matching $F$ of $K(Q_5)$ with four holes of one parity and six
of the other, and every specified majority hole $v$, there is a simple
cycle on exactly $Q_5\setminus\{v\}$ containing every edge of $F$.
Every edge of the cycle outside $F$ is a cube edge. Required edges of
$F$ may be long or join vertices of equal parity.

##### Status and dependencies

The proof below is a complete assembly conditional on acceptance of
the final-orbit GF(2) certificate package. The original theorem is not
weakened. Its dependencies are full A8, the accepted exact A10 geometry
classification, the first two accepted A10 orbit theorems, and the new
last-orbit forest/rank theorem. Independent review must discharge that
last dependency and inspect the assembly before marking full A10 true.

##### Proof

Translate the cube by $v$. This is an automorphism preserving short
edges, arbitrary matching edges, and the specified omitted vertex;
after translation $v=0$ and its parity class is the even class.
Write the other majority holes as $Z$, $|Z|=5$, and the minority holes
as $W$, $|W|=4$.

If $z\in Z$ and $w\in W$ are short-adjacent, add $zw$ to $F$.
The resulting matching has five even and three odd holes and still
leaves $0$ free. Full A8 gives the required 31-cycle containing this
larger matching and omitting $0$. Relative to $F$ its one additional
required edge $zw$ is short, so this cycle proves the original claim.

Otherwise $Z\cup W$ is independent. The exact geometry classification
accepted in [Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json) contains 55 such
marked geometries. Under coordinate permutations they form exactly
these three disjoint orbits:

| representative $Z$ | representative $W$ | orbit size | positive input |
|---|---|---:|---|
| $3,5,6,15,23$ | $8,16,25,26$ | 30 | [A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.json) |
| $3,5,6,15,23$ | $8,25,26,28$ | 20 | [A10_ORBIT2_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A10_ORBIT2_REVIEW.json) |
| $15,23,27,29,30$ | $1,2,4,8$ | 5 | final-orbit forest/rank theorem |

The first theorem uses two forced closed matching sets with an odd
intersection. The second uses one forced closed set and a complete
canonical family with independently checked positive cycles. The third
uses legal short-complement forests whose endpoint-pairing rows have
full rank in the matching connectivity matrix. Each theorem quantifies
over every arbitrary matching on the complement of its marked hole set.

Choose a coordinate permutation taking the normalized instance to its
listed representative. Apply the relevant orbit theorem and invert
the permutation and translation. This preserves each required edge,
shortness of every new edge, simplicity, and the exact omitted vertex.
The augmentation case and the three orbits exhaust all inputs, so the
stated full A10 theorem follows once the listed inputs are accepted.

##### Consequences of accepted full A10

Together with full A8, A10 discharges the two assumptions of
[Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION.md](#proof-q5-higher-hole-reduction), whose reduction and finite neighbor bound
were independently accepted in [Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json).
Consequently every feasible Q5 imbalance-two avoid-one input holds;
every arbitrary $K(Q_5)$ matching with balanced holes has a spanning
path from any free root to every opposite-parity target, covered or
free, and a spanning cycle extension. All surviving new edges are short.
The zero-hole cycle case is the explicit perfect-matching import, and
the 32-hole endpoint case has no covered target, as checked in that
reduction. No infeasible 17-hole parity class is used.

These are Q5 auxiliary results. They do not by themselves discharge the
marked multiple-omission inputs in Q6. Complete ten-hole covered targets,
the complete 12/14/16/18-hole layers, and full P6 remain open.

##### Required final audit

Verify all upstream final reviews and source hashes, the last-orbit
forest and rank certificates and the precise published rank theorem,
the exact disjoint 30+20+5 geometry cover, the augmentation and symmetry
steps, and the hypotheses of the already audited Q5 consequence theorem.
The complete Q6 goal must remain open in the resulting state.


</details>


<details id="proof-q5-a8-endpoint-and-ten-consequences" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q5_A8_ENDPOINT_AND_TEN_CONSEQUENCES.md — A8 consequences: full balanced-eight-hole endpoints and ten-hole progress</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q5_A8_ENDPOINT_AND_TEN_CONSEQUENCES.md)。SHA-256：`a6caced4ddffb4605051e0433a703b220d25e5aa7c9c6e1153550f758638d670`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json)。

#### A8 consequences: full balanced-eight-hole endpoints and ten-hole progress

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Acceptance requires complete A8 final PASS
and a separate review of these consequences. Full ten-hole P6 remains open.

##### 1. Exact endpoint theorem

Let F be any matching of K(Q5) with four holes of each parity. For every
free root r and every opposite-parity vertex y, covered or free, there is
a Hamilton r-y path containing F, with all edges outside F short.

If y is free, add the auxiliary edge ry. The resulting matching has three
holes of each parity. The already accepted K6 full-cycle theorem applies
even when ry is long, since its required matching edges are arbitrary.
Delete ry from that cycle to obtain the desired path.

If y is covered, put h=F(y) and F'=F-yh+hr. Its holes are the old holes
minus r plus y, with counts3:5 and y a majority hole. Complete A8 gives
a cycle on exactly Q5-y containing F'. Delete hr and append the original
edge hy at h. This is a Hamilton r-y path restoring all original edges.
The auxiliary edge hr disappears and all other new edges are short.

This theorem includes every possible mate h and every arbitrary complete-
graph matching, so it is suitable for the long edges created by Q6 path
compression. It fills the prescribed-covered-target part that K8 alone
did not supply. Taking y to be a short neighbor of r and closing the path
also gives a full cycle; K8 had already been independently established.

##### 2. Six unconditional ten-hole cut rows

For a Q6 short27-edge matching, free root u=0 and covered odd target v,
use Z,W,A,B,a,b from TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_A8_TRANSFER.md. After the
standard short augmentation, Z union W is independent. The six rows

$$ (0,1),(1,1),(0,2),(3,4),(4,4),(3,5) $$

are now sufficient without any additional local marked-geometry test.
The first row uses K8, the next two use complete A8 at the bridge mirror,
and the final three use the full balanced-eight-hole endpoint theorem
above. All completion, root selection, optional bridge, tagged closure,
conflict suppression and expansion steps are exactly those already
audited in TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW. The only former additional
hypothesis was membership in the accepted partial A8 geometries; complete
A8 removes that hypothesis for every marked geometry arising in these rows.

The existence of an admissible bridge source remains automatic where
required: among two or five original odd holes at most one mirrors to the
root, and v is covered so it is not one of those sources. Required matching
edges are preserved, and both the free root and covered target remain the
prescribed global endpoints.

##### 3. Exact additional coverage obligation

The accepted TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW fixed the remaining covered-
target domain at91225 normalized geometries (26880,29955,34390 for
v=1,7,31). Its frozen independent residual files are the inputs here.
For every record, test all six actual cuts for one of the six rows above.
If such a cut exists, Section2 supplies a path for every matching realizing
that geometry. Keep every other record unchanged as an open obligation.

The producer ten_covered_after_full_A8.py records every chosen row/cut and
the exact remaining input bytes. Its predicted additional coverage is37003,
leaving54222 (16920,17022,20280). These are complete hole-geometry counts,
not numbers of sampled matchings. A separate independent enumeration and
fixed-input hash check are required before accepting these exact counts.

##### 4. What this does and does not establish

Complete A8 supplies a reusable local endpoint theorem and expands the
accepted ten-hole covered-target domain. The remaining54222 geometric
cases, once independently confirmed, still need universal matching proofs.
Multiple-omission local cycle inputs and b=0 exposed-port cases are not
automatically covered by A8. Full A10, complete12--18-hole Q6 layers and
full P6 remain open. No claim of mathematical novelty is made here.


</details>

#### Complete Q5 A8: proof assembly

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Assembly requires final acceptance of every
listed orbit input and a separate independent whole-A8 review. Full P6
is not claimed by this auxiliary theorem.

##### Exact theorem

Let F be any matching of K(Q5) whose holes have counts3 and5 in the two
parity classes. For every specified majority-parity hole v there is a cycle
on exactly Q5 minus {v}, containing F, with all edges outside F short.
The required matching may contain arbitrary long and same-parity edges.

##### Dependency map and acceptance gate

1. Complete A6 and its already accepted arbitrary-matching scope.
2. A8_PARTIAL_PROOF_PACKAGE.md, with A8_PARTIAL_REVIEW: augmentation and
   every cut with majority-minus-minority count1,2,3.
3. A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT.md and its final review: first residual orbit.
4. A8_ORBITS2_3_ANALYTIC_CLOSURE.md and its final review: second and third
   residual orbits, using closed matching sets and parity.
5. A8_ORBIT4_FULL_CLOSURE.md and its final review: fourth residual orbit,
   four sufficient cut constructions plus all200475 finite positive inputs.
6. A8_ORBIT5_FULL_CLOSURE.md and its final review: fifth residual orbit,
   four sufficient cut constructions plus all2732625 finite positive inputs.
7. A complete independent geometry cover and disjointness check. Prior
   independent A8 and Q5 higher-hole reviews established the2700-geometry
   domain and exact orbit partition; the assembly review must check that
   every imported orbit theorem has the required marks and quantifiers.

Every final review must be PASS and bind fixed proof/evidence hashes before
the whole-A8 acceptance gate is met. In particular a running certificate
producer, positive samples, or a merely conditional final-orbit draft is
insufficient. Full unrestricted T15 is not an import.

##### 1. Short augmentation and normalization

If a minority hole is adjacent to a majority hole other than v, add their
short edge to F. This leaves2:4 holes and keeps v free. Complete A6 supplies
a cycle on exactly Q5-v, preserving F and the added short edge. Thus assume
no such adjacent pair exists.

Translate v to0. The majority holes become even and the minority holes odd,
regardless of their original numerical parity. Write the four other even
holes as Z and the three odd holes as W. Now |Z|=4, |W|=3, and no Z-W
short edge exists. Translation and coordinate permutations preserve all
short edges and transport the full arbitrary-matching domain bijectively.

##### 2. Complete geometric partition

There are exactly2700 normalized pairs (Z,W) satisfying these conditions.
Exactly2540 have a coordinate face containing0 whose majority-minus-
minority hole count is1,2,3. The full matching instances of these geometries
are covered by the accepted partial theorem, including zero/one crossings
where applicable and arbitrary long original crossing partners.

The remaining160 pairs are precisely the following disjoint coordinate
orbits. The prescribed omitted hole remains0 in every row.

| Z | W | orbit size | complete proof input |
|---|---|---:|---|
|3,5,6,15|8,25,26|60|first-orbit delta4 theorem|
|3,5,6,15|25,26,28|20|orbits2/3 analytic theorem|
|3,5,15,23|25,26,28|30|orbits2/3 analytic theorem|
|15,23,27,29|1,2,4|30|orbit4 complete theorem|
|15,23,27,29|2,4,8|20|orbit5 complete theorem|

The sizes sum to160. Each imported theorem covers **every** matching on
the complement of its representative hole set, with arbitrary required
edges, and omits exactly0. A coordinate permutation carrying a row to any
other member carries the entire construction and preserves those marks.
Thus the representative theorem proves every realizing matching of every
geometry in its orbit, not merely the finite sample of one matching.

##### 3. Completion and boundaries

Short augmentation handles all inputs outside the normalized independent
domain. The partial theorem and five full orbit inputs cover every member
of that domain. Translating back gives the exact theorem for every F and
every specified majority hole v. All new surviving edges are short and
the result is a single31-cycle, by the explicit imported conclusions.

This proves A8 once the acceptance gate above is met. It does not prove
A10, all arbitrary-hole Q5 endpoint statements, or any complete remaining
Q6 hole layer. Previously accepted K8 is not used to prove A8 here, so its
dependence on the partial A8 theorem introduces no circularity.


</details>

<summary>Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION.md — Two remaining auxiliary levels suffice for all balanced Q5 endpoints</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION.md)。SHA-256：`24841edb1206c8fe22adc0c465a68c3b17ae7afe0555f4d8d969dc9b4f6e098f`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[FOURTEEN_REUSE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_REUSE_REVIEW.json), [HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json), [Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json), [Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Two remaining auxiliary levels suffice for all balanced Q5 endpoints

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Conditional reduction, not a proof of A8,
A10, or full P6. Independent review pending.

##### Claim and notation

For $t\ge1$, let $A_{2t}$ mean: every matching of $K(Q_5)$ with hole counts
$(t-1,t+1)$ has a cycle on precisely $Q_5-v$ for every specified majority
hole $v$, containing the matching and using only short new edges. Either
global parity can be the majority. Full $A_2,A_4,A_6$ are established imports.
The exact additional obligations are $A_8$ (hole counts $3,5$) and $A_{10}$
(hole counts $4,6$), with arbitrary required edges and arbitrary majority v.

If A8 and A10 hold, then:

1. Every feasible $A_{2t}$ holds, with any number of holes.
2. Every matching of $K(Q_5)$ with balanced holes has a Hamilton path from
   any free root to any opposite-parity target, covered or free, containing
   the matching and using only short new edges.
3. Every matching of $K(Q_5)$ with balanced holes has a Hamilton cycle
   extension using only short new edges.

These are conditional auxiliary consequences, not assertions that the
remaining Q6 cut configurations all reduce to these local inputs.

##### 1. Finite geometric fact

Every set of five vertices of one parity in $Q_5$ has at least eleven
neighbors. Hence every five vertices of one parity and every six vertices
of the other parity contain a short edge between the sets.

The first statement is a finite assertion on $\binom{16}{5}=4368$ sets
for one parity. [q5_higher_hole_reduction_geometry.py](research/six_directions/q5_higher_hole_reduction_geometry.py) enumerates those
sets, unions the five coordinate neighbors of each vertex, and records
the full histogram. Its minimum is eleven; translation by a coordinate
unit supplies the other parity. An independent checker must re-enumerate
this small universe before treating the fact as accepted evidence.

##### 2. Reduction of every larger avoid-one input

Suppose $t\ge6$ in an $A_{2t}$ instance. There are at least five minority
holes and at least six majority holes other than $v$. Section 1 gives a
short edge between these sets. Add it to the matching; $v$ stays free,
and both hole counts decrease by one. Repeat until $t\le5$. The terminal
instance is covered by A2/A4/A6/A8/A10. Its cycle contains the original
matching, omits precisely $v$, and every added matching edge was short.
Thus it has the required scope relative to the original instance.

##### 3. Balanced endpoints and cycles

Let $P_m$ be the endpoint assertion for $m$ holes of each parity, and let
$C_m$ be the corresponding full-cycle assertion. Fink's arbitrary perfect-
matching extension theorem supplies $C_0$.

Inductively assume $C_{m-1}$. For $P_m$, let $r$ be a free root and $y$
an opposite-parity target. If $y$ is free, add the possibly long auxiliary
edge $ry$; apply $C_{m-1}$ to this arbitrary complete-graph matching, then
delete $ry$. All surviving new edges are short.

If $y$ is covered, write $h=F(y)$ and set

$$ F'=(F\setminus\{yh\})\cup\{hr\}. $$

Its holes have counts $(m-1,m+1)$, with the majority parity that of $y$;
$y$ is now free. Apply $A_{2m}$ from Section 2, avoiding $y$. In the
resulting 31-cycle replace the required auxiliary edge $hr$ by $h-y-r$
and delete the temporary edge $yr$. This yields a Hamilton $r$--$y$ path,
restores the original edge $yh$, and removes the only new auxiliary edge.
Thus $P_m$ holds.

To obtain $C_m$, take any free root and any short neighbor as target in
$P_m$, then close that Hamilton path by the short edge between its ends.
This closes the induction. For $m=16$ the matching is empty, so the
covered-target branch (which would call the infeasible A32) never occurs;
the free-target branch uses $C_{15}$. All other covered-target calls have
feasible majority counts at most sixteen.

##### 4. Exact new geometry sizes, not matching counts

Normalize the forbidden majority vertex to $0$. For A8, the other majority
holes are four even vertices Z and the minority holes are three odd vertices W.
For A10 the corresponding sizes are five and four. If a short Z-W edge
exists, add it to reduce to the predecessor A theorem without covering 0.

The producer's complete nonadjacent domains have 2700 A8 geometries and
55 A10 geometries. No such domain remains for A12 or larger; the geometric
fact above supplies an analytic explanation for all larger feasible sizes.
These are marked hole configurations, not matchings. Each unresolved
configuration must still be proved for every arbitrary complete-graph matching
on its covered vertices. The separate A8 writer is investigating the 160
geometries without a delta-1/2/3 cut; those transfers and that residual
classification are not imported as proved by this document.

##### Status

The implications above are PROVABLE AFTER EXTRA ASSUMPTIONS A8 and A10,
and acceptance of the explicitly finite five-neighbor fact. A8 and A10
remain open. None of the complete 10--18-hole Q6 layers is closed here.


</details>


<details id="proof-q5-k8-closure" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q5_K8_CLOSURE.md — Q5 balanced eight-hole cycle extension</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q5_K8_CLOSURE.md)。SHA-256：`5e6ec0fdb9114d49ae5cc69dad1044e083b43216a39ea37601f9fa759f50bc68`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [Q5_K8_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_K8_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json), [TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json)。

#### Q5 balanced eight-hole cycle extension

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Complete proposed proof relative to the
listed imports and finite geometry witnesses; independent review pending.

##### Exact claim

Every matching $F$ of $K(Q_5)$ with exactly four even and four odd holes
has a Hamilton cycle containing $F$, all of whose edges outside $F$ are
short. Required matching edges may be long or join equal parities.
Call this assertion K8. It is not the full balanced-eight-hole endpoint
theorem and not the full A8 avoid-one theorem.

##### Dependencies

1. Full Q5 balanced-six-hole cycle extension K6, accepted with A6 in
   [A6_AND_EIGHT_FREE_CLOSED.md](#proof-a6-and-eight-free-closed) and its cited independent reviews.
2. Only the delta-1/2/3 branches of Q5 A8 from
   [A8_PARTIAL_PROOF_PACKAGE.md](#proof-a8-partial-proof-package), which require independent acceptance.
   No unresolved A8 orbit, A10, or higher-hole P6 theorem is used.
3. The finite geometric assertion and positive witnesses below, generated
   by [q5_k8_geometry.py](research/six_directions/q5_k8_geometry.py); a separate independent check is required.

##### Proof

If two holes are short-adjacent, add their edge. The new matching has
three holes of each parity and K6 supplies the full cycle. The added edge
was short, so this is also an allowed extension of F. Thus assume all
eight holes are independent. Write their parity classes as E and O.

The following finite assertion holds: for every independent set with four
holes of each parity, there is a free vertex r and a short neighbor y
such that, after replacing hole r by y, the new 3:5-hole geometry has a
coordinate cut containing y with majority-minus-minority count 1, 2, or 3.
Here y is necessarily covered by F, since the holes are independent.
The majority class is the parity of y, and y is its prescribed omitted hole.

Choose such r,y and write h=F(y). The four vertices r,y,h and the other
holes have the required distinctness: r is free and h,y are covered.
Set

$$F'=(F\setminus\{yh\})\cup\{hr\}.$$

This is an arbitrary complete-graph matching whose holes are precisely
the old holes minus r plus y. The selected delta-1/2/3 branch of A8 gives
a cycle on exactly $Q_5-y$ containing F', with short new edges. Replace
its required edge hr by the two-edge path h-y-r. The original edge hy
is restored and yr is short. This is a Hamilton cycle containing F;
the auxiliary edge hr disappears. Its construction works for every
matching on the specified covered support, independently of the value
of h. This proves K8, subject to acceptance of the finite assertion.

##### Finite assertion: explicit complete universe

Enumerate each of the $\binom{16}{4}$ even hole sets E. List all odd
vertices nonadjacent to E, and enumerate all four-element subsets O.
This produces exactly 980 independent balanced-eight-hole geometries,
without symmetry reduction. For each, enumerate the eight choices of r
and its five coordinate neighbors y. For each pair compute the five cut
imbalances of the marked 3:5-hole set $(E\cup O\setminus\{r\})\cup\{y\}$,
always taking the face containing y. A pair is successful if some
imbalance is 1,2,3.

All 980 geometries have a successful pair. The exact histogram of
successful (r,y) pairs is 580 geometries with 40, 320 with 18, and 80
with 24. [q5_k8_geometry.json](research/six_directions/q5_k8_geometry.json) records each input and one actual r,y,
coordinate, and imbalance witness. A verifier need only rebuild the
complete finite domain and check each witness with the stated formulas;
it need not search for Hamilton cycles or inspect matching instances.

##### Limits

K8 supplies a cycle with freely selected construction endpoints. It does
not supply a path to an arbitrary prescribed covered endpoint: that would
require handling the corresponding fixed A8 geometry, which may be open.
No full ten-hole covered-target or other full P6 conclusion is asserted.


</details>


<details id="proof-q5-neighbor-abundance-and-ep0" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>Q5_NEIGHBOR_ABUNDANCE_AND_EP0.md — Proof Package: Q5 free-neighbor abundance and EP0</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/Q5_NEIGHBOR_ABUNDANCE_AND_EP0.md)。SHA-256：`2ec2a322b8cc127d3cf90659ea2c6377cd2dc4510e4bb13be3df23c95f9006f1`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json)。

#### Proof Package: Q5 free-neighbor abundance and EP0

Date: 2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. New proof package; previously audited files and global coverage state are unchanged. Independent semantic/finite audit is pending.

##### Claims

**Q5 neighbor abundance.** Let $M$ be an arbitrary complete-graph matching on $V(Q_5)$ with exactly two distinct holes $q,v$ of equal parity. Let $U(M;q,v)$ consist of the short neighbors $a$ of $q$ for which there is a simple cycle on $V(Q_5)\setminus\{v\}$ containing $M$ and the edge $qa$, with every edge outside $M$ short. Then
$$|U(M;q,v)|\ge3.$$
Since $q$ is a hole, every incident cycle edge is new and short.

**EP0 consequence.** In an $(a,b)=(2,0)$ eight-hole cut as defined in [EIGHT_HOLE_COVERED_NEXT_DRAFT.md](#proof-eight-hole-covered-next-draft), suppose there is an odd original crossing port $q\ne v$ with
$$|N_A(q)\cap S|\ge3,\qquad S=\{\bar w:w\in W\}.$$
Then EP0 holds at that cut. The original Q6 matching is short; the auxiliary complete-graph matching need not be short or bipartite.

##### Status

**PROVABLE AS STATED**, subject to the explicit finite inputs and existing imported theorems below passing their independent audit. A complete mathematical reduction and positive finite certificates are supplied. The new sixty-million-pair finite check currently has a complete producer result; independent fresh-context verification is in progress. This document alone does not assert an unconditional final eight-hole or P6 theorem.

##### Assumptions and notation

A short edge differs in one bit. All required matching edges in the Q5 abundance theorem may have arbitrary lengths or parity. A free vertex is not incident to a required matching edge. Coordinate cuts have mirror pairs with the same remaining local labels.

For a Q4 matching $F$ with free vertex0 and omitted equal-parity vertex $h$, let $\mathcal P(F)$ be the family of unordered neighbor pairs at0 occurring in its valid fifteen-cycles. For a complete perfect matching $P$ on Q4, let $G(P)$ consist of unit vertices $a\in\{1,2,4,8\}$ for which a Hamilton cycle containing $P$ uses $0a$ as a new edge. An edge of $P$ itself is excluded from this optional-edge set.

##### Dependencies

1. Q4 free-neighbor classification below: $|\bigcup\mathcal P(F)|\ge3$ for either possible equal-parity hole distance.
2. The existing Q4 perfect-matching extension theorem, allowing arbitrary complete-graph matchings and only short new edges.
3. [Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md](#proof-q4-perfect-endpoint-abundance) and its checked full minimal-endpoint-set classification: $|G(P)|\ge2$ for every Q4 perfect matching. A Hamilton $0$--$a$ path containing $P$ is equivalent to a Hamilton cycle containing $P$ with optional edge $0a$, by closing/deleting that short edge. The path cannot contain its own endpoint edge $0a$ on sixteen vertices.
4. The audited complete opposite-hole Q4 fourteen-cycle tables, used to describe exact unavailable optional edges of a perfect matching.
5. The finite star-input mask check described in Step4.

##### Proof of Q5 abundance

###### Step1. The complete Q4 neighbor-pair data

Normalize free vertex $q$ to0. Its distinct equal-parity omitted vertex can be normalized to3 or15 by coordinate permutation. For either geometry, every one of the $135135=13!!$ arbitrary matchings on the other fourteen vertices is included.

The exact neighbor-union histograms are:

| Omitted vertex | Matchings with union size3 | Matchings with union size4 |
|---:|---:|---:|
|3|208|134927|
|15|212|134923|

These are independently obtained in two ways. [eight_ep0_q4_neighbor_inverse.py](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_neighbor_inverse.py) contracts a required optional edge $0s$ through the original edge $st$, obtaining a fourteen-cycle matching with holes $h,s$. Each audited negative matching has the unique inverse obtained by replacing its edge $0t$ with $st$. No matching is unavailable at two different unit neighbors. Outside the complete negative inverse sets, the positive fourteen-cycle expands through $0-s-t$ to give a fifteen-cycle.

[verify_eight_ep0_q4_neighbor_spectrum.cpp](research/six_directions/verify_eight_ep0_q4_neighbor_spectrum.cpp) independently enumerates all input matchings and every possible short degree completion: degree two at0, zero at the omitted vertex, one at all other vertices. It rejects repeated required edges, checks exact cycle support and connectivity, and accumulates every available neighbor. There are116 degree patterns for omitted3 and96 for omitted15. The exact histograms coincide and the checker reports PASS.

For omitted15, the fuller pair-family classification in [eight_ep0_q4_pair_spectrum.json](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_pair_spectrum.json) shows precisely444 matchings for which
$$\bigcap_{B\in\mathcal P(F)}B\ne\varnothing.$$
The intersection is a single center $a$; two mandatory neighbors would contradict the union lower bound. For each center $a\in\{1,2,4,8\}$ there are111 such matchings. These are the star matchings. The remaining134691 matchings have empty pair intersection.

[eight_ep0_q4_star_A_prepare.cpp](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_star_A_prepare.cpp) supplies every star matching, its center, all its positive fifteen-cycle witnesses, and the union $U_A(F)$ of optional short edges in those cycles that are not incident to0. The files are [eight_ep0_q4_star_A.jsonl](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_star_A.jsonl) and [eight_ep0_q4_star_A.bin](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_star_A.bin). No required matching edge is included in this union.

###### Step2. A positive-crossing cut of Q5

Choose a coordinate on which $q,v$ agree. Let A contain both holes and B be its opposite Q4 face. The crossing count $c$ is even. Suppose $c>0$.

Pair all A crossing ports arbitrarily into an artificial matching D. Together with $M_A$ this is a Q4 matching with holes $q,v$. Step1 supplies fifteen-cycles whose optional neighbors at $q$ have union size at least three.

For any one of these cycles, delete D, attach every original crossing, and compress the resulting A path forest to edges on the distinct B ports. There is no closed component: deletion of the nonempty D breaks the original A cycle into paths, and crossing attachments have distinct leaves. Join the compressed edges to $M_B$ to form a perfect matching on B. The Q4 perfect-matching extension theorem gives a Hamilton B cycle; expansion restores the entire A face except $v$ and produces a thirty-one-cycle containing the original M.

No edge at $q$ was deleted, since $q$ is a hole and is in no edge of D. Therefore each of the at-least-three A neighbor options survives in a Q5 cycle, possibly with a different B completion. This proves the abundance bound whenever such a positive-crossing common-coordinate cut exists.

###### Step3. Zero crossings when $d(q,v)=2$

There are three coordinates on which $q,v$ agree. If any has positive crossings, Step2 applies. Otherwise each of the three common-coordinate cuts has zero crossings.

For any one of these cuts, choose an A fifteen-cycle and a B Hamilton cycle both having the same optional short edge $qa$ in their common local labels. Such an edge exists: Step1 gives at least three available A unit neighbors; Dependency3 gives at least two B unit neighbors among the same four units, so the two sets intersect.

Delete the two copies of $qa$ and add the two mirror bridges at $q,a$. The two opened disjoint cycles become one thirty-one-cycle on exactly $Q_5-v$, retain every original matching edge, and use only short new edges. Its neighbor at q across this cut is the vertical mirror of q. Repeating this existential construction at each of the three zero-crossing common-coordinate cuts yields three distinct vertical neighbors of q. The cycles need not be the same. This proves the abundance bound for distance2.

###### Step4. Zero crossings when $d(q,v)=4$

There is exactly one common-coordinate cut. If it has positive crossings, use Step2. Otherwise A contains a Q4 matching F with holes $q,v$, and B a Q4 perfect matching P. Normalize common local labels to $q=0,v=15$.

Let $\mathcal F=\mathcal P(F)$ and $G=G(P)$. Splicing A and B at an optional edge $0a$ with $a\in G$ preserves the other A neighbor $b$ from the pair $\{a,b\}\in\mathcal F$ and adds the vertical neighbor of0. Thus every vertex in
$$T=\{b:\text{ some }a\in G\text{ satisfies }\{a,b\}\in\mathcal F\}$$
is a realizable nonvertical Q5 neighbor.

Here $|G|\ge2$ and $|\bigcup\mathcal F|\ge3$. If $T$ had size one, say $T=\{b\}$, then $b\notin G$: any edge of $\mathcal F$ entirely in G would put both its endpoints in T. Every family edge incident to G must contain b. At most two vertices lie outside G, so any family edge disjoint from G must also contain b. Hence every edge of $\mathcal F$ contains b. Therefore $\mathcal F$ has a mandatory center outside G.

It follows that $|T|\ge2$ unless F is one of the444 star matchings and its center $a$ is unavailable in P. In all nonexceptional cases the two nonvertical neighbors in T and the vertical neighbor give the desired bound.

For the exceptional pairs, use a non-q optional edge. If
$$U_A(F)\cap U_B(P)\ne\varnothing,$$
where $U_B(P)$ is the exact union of optional short edges over B Hamilton cycles, select one common edge, choose its witnessing A and B cycles, and splice at that edge. Since the edge is not incident to q, the resulting Q5 cycle retains both distinct A neighbors of q. Separately the q-edge splice already supplies a cycle containing the vertical q neighbor. This again yields at least three Q5 neighbor options.

The displayed intersection holds for every exceptional F,P pair, by the following complete finite certificate.

**Exact exceptional P universe.** For a fixed unit center a, P is unavailable at optional edge $0a$ in exactly two disjoint cases. First, P contains $0a$, giving $135135=13!!$ matchings. Second, $P(0)\ne a$ and its Hamilton $0$--$a$ path contraction is one of the51 audited negative fourteen-cycle matchings on holes0,a. For each negative T, choose an edge $bc$ and either endpoint assignment, then replace it by $0b,ac$. These give714 distinct nonmatching-edge obstructions. This follows from the exact endpoint-path contraction and its unique inverse; hence all135849 exceptional perfect matchings are included.

**Exact $U_B$ masks.** For each of the32 Q4 short edges, perform the same negative inverse construction. [eight_ep0_q4_PB_bad_optional.py](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_PB_bad_optional.py) produces16816 distinct perfect matchings with22848 labeled unavailable nonmatching optional edges. For any P, an optional short edge is unavailable precisely when it is an edge of P or appears in this inverse dictionary. Thus its exact positive union mask is the complement, among the32 short edges, of those two bad masks.

**Complete pair comparison.** [eight_ep0_q4_star_joint.cpp](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_star_joint.cpp) reads all444 star F inputs. For each center it enumerates all135135 P containing the center edge and all714 additional inverse obstructions. For each of the111 star F with that center, it tests the two short-edge union masks. All
$$4\cdot111\cdot135849=60316956$$
pairs have a nonempty common non-q optional edge; there are zero residual pairs. The producer's result is [eight_ep0_q4_star_joint.json](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_q4_star_joint.json), with the positive A cycles stored separately for checking. This finite mask comparison completes the distance4 zero-crossing case.

Distinct equal-parity vertices in Q5 have distance2 or4. Steps2--4 exhaust all cuts and both distances, proving Q5 neighbor abundance.

##### Deriving EP0

Fix the original eight-hole matching and a cut satisfying the second claim. Set $r=0$ if the root lies in A, otherwise choose either of the two nonroot even holes in A. Choose any perfect matching D on the EP0 completion domain
$$(X_A\setminus\{q\})\cup((Z\cap A)\setminus\{r\}).$$
This domain has even cardinality, and its vertices are disjoint from the internal matching $M_A$. The completed matching $L=M_A\cup D$ has exactly holes $r,q$. The covered target $v\ne q$ has the same parity as q; let $t=L(v)$.

Define
$$K=L-\{vt\}+\{rt\}.$$
The four vertices $r,q,v,t$ are distinct. K is a matching with holes v,q of the same parity, so Q5 abundance applies. At least three neighbors of q occur on its valid thirty-one-cycles omitting v. Since $|N_A(q)\cap S|\ge3$ and q has five neighbors, at least one of these cycles C has an edge $qs$ with $s\in S$.

C contains the required artificial edge rt. Replace rt by $r-v-t$ and delete rv. The result is a Hamilton r--v path on A containing every edge of L. The original edge vt is restored and the artificial edge rt is gone. The inserted edge rv is deleted, so its length is immaterial. All surviving new edges are short.

The edge qs is unchanged: q is a hole of K, and differs from r,v,t. This remains true if s equals r or t. Therefore this path, together with the chosen q,D,s, satisfies exactly the quantified EP0 obligation. No prescribed-edge strengthening of the imported N10 theorem is assumed. Instead that strengthening is derived from the proved abundance theorem.

##### Additional local facts and limits

The separate endpoint-path lemma in [eight_ep0_endpoint_path_probe.py](research/six_directions/eight_ep0_endpoint_path_probe.py) is valid but closes no additional representative by itself: if the only non-S q neighbors are r,a and the chosen completion contains av, avoiding qS forces the entire Hamilton path to be the four-vertex path $r-q-a-v$, a contradiction. Adding these clauses still leaves realizing matchings for the five previously open orbits. Such matching witnesses refute only that sufficient rule, not EP0.

The maximal-short-matching reduction and its exploratory counts are recorded separately; they are not needed for this proof. The abundance proof uses only the finite Q4 inputs and Q5 constructions above.

##### Proof

###### 1. Full-rank unforced rows

Each selected forest is verified directly as a graph and compressed to its
actual terminal matching $P$. For each of the ten unforced rows the saved
$2048$ forest pairings and matching columns have connectivity rank $2048$
over $\mathbb F_2$. The imported upper bound makes those complete rows span
the whole matching-connectivity row space. Every column indexed by an
arbitrary original matching $F$ is nonzero: cyclically connect consecutive
required edges to construct another arbitrary matching whose union with
$F$ is one alternating cycle. Hence some selected forest pairing connects
with $F$. Expanding the forest paths yields the required simple $29$-cycle.
Only stored legal forests are needed, not exhaustive forest enumeration.

Every actual union retains the two matching labels. A common pair would
form an isolated two-edge component and cannot pass the single-cycle test.
Thus no physical short edge duplicates a required edge on expansion.

###### 2. Forced cherry and exact conditional classification

For a forced row all three omissions are short neighbors of $0$. The two
remaining neighbors are precisely $p,q$, and both are covered vertices:
the four included majority holes are nonneighbors of $0$. Every admissible
forest must include $p-0-q$, so every $P$ contains $pq$.

If the required matching contains $pq$, its three edges with this forced
path make an isolated triangle. No spanning $29$-cycle can have such a
component. This proves necessity analytically, without a failed search.

Otherwise put $a=F(p)$ and $b=F(q)$. The four vertices are distinct.
Suppress $a-p-q-b$ in the labeled graph $F+P$: replace $pa,qb$ in $F$ by
$ab$ and remove $pq$ from $P$. The resulting perfect matchings $F',P'$
are on $K\setminus\{p,q\}$ and have a single alternating cycle exactly
when $F+P$ does. This is path suppression, valid even for long or
same-parity original edges.

For each of the seven forced rows, the saved $1024$ shortened forest
pairings $P'$ have rank $1024$ against supplied arbitrary matching columns
on those $22$ endpoints. The generic upper bound and the same nonzero-column
argument give some connecting $P'$ for every $F'$. Use its associated full
forest $S$ and expand the suppressed path to recover all original edges,
$p,q$ and the included minority hole $0$. The result is the required
$29$-cycle. Thus absence of $pq$ is sufficient as well as necessary.

###### 3. Exact certificate formats and verification

Unforced prefixes are `Q5_T17_RANK_batch_XX`, forced prefixes are
`Q5_T17_RANK_forced_XX`. Every config contains the eight holes and three
omissions; forced configs additionally append $p,q$.

For an unforced prefix, `_forests.bin` has $2048$ records of $34$ bytes,
`_pairs.bin` and `_columns.bin` have $2048$ records of $24$ bytes, and the
matrix/pivot/combination files each have $2048$ rows of $256$ bytes.

For a forced prefix, `_forests.bin` has $1024$ records of $34$ bytes;
`_full_pairs.bin` has $1024$ records of $24$ bytes. Its corresponding
`_pairs.bin` deletes the forced pair and has $1024$ records of $22$ bytes;
`_columns.bin` also has $1024$ records of $22$ bytes. Its matrix/pivot/
combination files each have $1024$ rows of $128$ bytes. Bits in each row
are stored least-significant-bit first. Pairs use actual Q5 labels.

The new reduced search preserves the full twenty-four endpoint degree
constraints and full forest paths, checks that the compressed pairing
contains the forced pair, and only then removes it for the rank matrix.
It does not silently pretend $p,q$ are omitted vertices of the forest.

[Q5_T17_RANK_batch_author_check.py](research/six_directions/Q5_T17_RANK_batch_author_check.py) verifies all $27648$ saved forests,
all full and shortened endpoint pairings, every matching column, all
$49283072$ connectivity matrix bits and every pivot XOR combination.
The highest set bit of pivot row $j$ is exactly $j$, proving the rank
lower bounds in exact binary arithmetic. All seventeen checks pass.
These checks are producer evidence and need fresh independent acceptance.

For a covered-target Q6 input use the accepted uniform-transfer notation.
In row $(a,b)=(3,1)$ select the three even A holes. The B input has the
one remaining nonroot even hole as minority and four odd B holes plus the

the minority is the sole odd B hole and the majority is the four even B

The full-rank inputs allow every arbitrary compressed matching. No

T26-batch remainder files and checks equality with the candidate source
