[verify_t44_sameface_path_gluing.py](research/six_directions/verify_t44_sameface_path_gluing.py); it imports no producer or older
checker. It relies on the separate proof of exhaustiveness of the
perfect-endpoint exceptional universe, rather than assuming the 4708
JSON rows alone establish that exhaustiveness.

##### 1. Endpoint hitting triples

Let $e_i,e_j,e_k$ be three distinct coordinate unit vectors of Q4.
For every perfect matching $P$, each of the sets

$$\{e_i,e_j,e_k\},\qquad
  \{e_i,e_j,e_i\mathbin\oplus e_j\mathbin\oplus e_k\}$$

intersects $G(P,0)$.

There are four triples of the first form and twelve of the second.
The checker generates all sixteen directly. None is contained in any
of the 4708 exact exceptional bad sets. A nonexceptional matching has
at most one bad endpoint, so it cannot contain any three-element set
of bad endpoints either. This proves the assertion for every perfect
matching, using the imported classification. Translation through a
root $r$ gives the corresponding statement for $G(P,r)$.

##### 2. Q4 T44 positive path cover

Let $L$ be a matching of $K(Q_4)$ whose four holes $x,y,b,t$ all have
one parity, where $x,y$ are to be omitted. Normalize by translating
$x$ to $0$ and permuting coordinates so $y=p\in\{3,15\}$. All four
holes are then even. Order the included holes so $b<t$.

For each $p$, the included pair ranges over
$\binom{6}{2}=15$ choices. For each such hole set, the other twelve
vertices have $11!!=10395$ perfect matchings. Thus the thirty files
`q4_t44_path_abundance_p_b_t.bin` cover all normalized inputs.

Every row consists of sixteen mate bytes, one path-count byte, and
that many explicit 14-vertex paths. Each listed path starts at $b$,
ends at a different odd vertex, visits exactly $Q_4\setminus\{0,p\}$,
contains $L$, and has only short edges outside $L$.

Let $S$ be the set of endpoints appearing in the positive witnesses
for a row. The checked alternative is

$$|S|\ge5\quad\text{or}\quad
  S\mathbin\oplus b\text{ contains one of the sixteen triples in Section 1}.$$

Here $S\mathbin\oplus b=\{s\mathbin\oplus b:s\in S\}$ normalizes
the path root to $0$. The checker validates all positive paths, all
mate involutions, exact hole sets, distinct endpoint witnesses, and
bijective recursive matching-rank coverage of $0,\ldots,10394$ in
each file. No claim that the listed endpoints are all possible
endpoints is necessary: positive witnesses and their endpoint lower
sets suffice.

There are only 216 rows with at most four listed endpoints. Their
translated endpoint sets have thirteen possible values. Each contains
one of the sixteen hitting triples. The checker also checks directly
that none of those thirteen endpoint sets is contained in any of the
4708 exceptional bad sets. This direct comparison is redundant but
provides a second implementation of the finite intersection step.

##### 3. Q4 path compatibility consequence

For any $L$ as in Section 2 and any perfect matching $P$ on another
copy of Q4 identified vertex-for-vertex with the first, there is a
common endpoint $q$ such that:

* the first copy has a path from $b$ to $q$ on exactly its fourteen
  nonomitted vertices, extending $L$ with short new edges;
* the second copy has a Hamilton path from $b$ to $q$, extending $P$
  with short new edges.

To prove this, take the positive-witness endpoint set $S$ from Section 2.
If $|S|\ge5$, then $|G(P,b)|\ge4$ and both are subsets of the same
eight opposite-parity vertices, so $S\cap G(P,b)\ne\varnothing$.
If $S\oplus b$ contains a hitting triple, Section 1 again gives a
member of $S\cap G(P,b)$. Choose such a member $q$ and the two paths
that witness its membership. Since $q$ is opposite in parity to $b$,
the endpoints are distinct.

The normalization is a proof device only: translate and permute both
copies by the same Q4 automorphism, apply the conclusion, then undo
that automorphism. The actual matching $P$ remains an arbitrary
complete-graph perfect matching under this automorphism.

##### 4. Q5 gluing proof

Since $F$ has no crossing edge, $F_A$ has exactly the four original
holes and $F_B$ is a perfect matching on $B$. Normalize the two faces
as in Section 2, applying the same identification to both.

By Section 3 choose an A path $R_A$ from the included hole $b$ to $q$
on exactly $A\setminus\{x,y\}$, and a B Hamilton path $R_B$ from
$\bar b$ to $\bar q$. Add the two short cube edges

$$b\bar b,\qquad q\bar q.$$

The A and B paths have disjoint supports, and their two pairs of
endpoints are distinct. Their union with these two edges is one
cycle: start at $b$, traverse $R_A$ to $q$, cross to $\bar q$,
traverse $R_B$ backwards to $\bar b$, and cross back to $b$.
It contains fourteen A vertices and sixteen B vertices, exactly
$Q_5\setminus\{x,y\}$. Every internal required edge belongs to its
corresponding path, and there are no original crossing edges to
restore. Every added edge is either a short path edge or one of the
two displayed short bridges. This proves the claim. $\square$

##### Consequence and limits

Together with the positive-crossing same-face lemma in
[T15_ANALYTIC_NOTES.md](research/six_directions/T15_ANALYTIC_NOTES.md), this closes the T44_5 branch in which all
four holes lie in a common coordinate face, regardless of crossing
count. In particular it handles the previously exceptional
same-face orbit with avoided pair $\{0,3\}$ and included pair
$\{5,9\}$ in Q5.

It does not supply a coordinate face for hole geometries that have
none, and it does not resolve the remaining T44_5 geometric orbits.
The original T44_5 and T15 statements are unchanged.
No remaining R8-covered input is claimed closed by this file.

##### Reproduction and open risks

Run:

```powershell
python research\six_directions\verify_t44_sameface_path_gluing.py
```

The output is [t44_sameface_path_gluing_verification.json](research/six_directions/t44_sameface_path_gluing_verification.json), including
all thirty file hashes, complete record/path counts, low endpoint sets,
the sixteen hitting triples, and imported-classification hash.

The main external proof dependency is the correctness and complete
scope of [Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md](#proof-q4-perfect-endpoint-abundance). This file explicitly uses
its exceptional-set classification, not merely its two endpoint-count
bounds. An independent reviewer should check this dependency as well
as the new path verifier and the two-bridge gluing.


</details>

<summary>TEN_COVERED_T63_SPLIT_APPLICATION.md — Ten-hole covered targets from a marked six-hole split input</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_T63_SPLIT_APPLICATION.md)。SHA-256：`a9402af1f4c3da26861b9a9a0267ca1266f5b4e20c5043dba2e9bf6e9c1503de`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_T63_SPLIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_T63_SPLIT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Ten-hole covered targets from a marked six-hole split input

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate. Independent acceptance pending.

##### Claim and status

Relative to the complete Q5 T63 split theorem specified below, the
accepted 54222 remaining ten-hole covered-target geometries have 12916
additional uniformly positive geometries. The remaining set has size
41306. This is a conditional application, not a complete ten-hole or P6
proof, and not an assertion that those 41306 inputs are negative.

##### Exact imported statement

Let $L$ be an arbitrary matching of the complete graph on a five-cube,
with exactly six holes $H$, all of one parity. Let $U\subset H$ have
size three. Suppose some coordinate splits $(H,U)$ into counts $(2,1)$
and $(4,2)$. The required imported theorem gives a single cycle on
$Q_5\setminus U$ containing $L$, with all other edges short, for every
such $L$, including those with zero matching edges across that cut.

The proposed full split proof uses Q4 N14 and Q4 T44 for a nonempty
crossing matching. For zero crossing it uses witnessed optional-edge
unions plus a complete finite exceptional gluing domain. This import
must receive its own independent acceptance before the application below
can be counted as closed.

##### Reduction to that import

Use the accepted uniform transfer in [HIGHER_HOLE_UNIFIED_TRANSFER.md](#proof-higher-hole-unified-transfer).
The original Q6 matching is short with 27 edges; its free even root is
$u=0$, and the odd target $v$ is covered. Write the remaining holes
as even $Z$, $|Z|=4$, and odd $W$, $|W|=5$. The accepted input domain
already has $Z\cup W$ independent. Let $A$ be the coordinate face
containing $v$, and $B$ the other face; put $a=|Z\cap A|$, $b=|W\cap A|$.

For $(a,b)=(4,2)$, choose any three vertices $S\subset Z\cap A$.
The A completion has balanced four holes, so its prescribed endpoint
input is already proved. The B matching after the audited tagged
transfer and simultaneous suppression has hole counts $(0,6)$,
and must omit exactly the three odd mirrors $U=\overline S$.
Its six holes are precisely $(W\cap B)\cup U$.

For $(a,b)=(1,5)$, choose three vertices
$S\subset (W\cap A)\setminus\{\overline u\}$. There are at least four
eligible vertices, because $v$ is covered and hence is not in $W$.
Again the A completion has balanced four holes. The B matching has
hole counts $(6,0)$ and must omit exactly the three even mirrors
$U=\overline S$. Its six holes are precisely $(Z\cap B)\cup U$.

All these are actual distinct holes: the independence reduction excludes
an original hole at a bridge mirror, a free source excludes a crossing
matching port there, and the odd-consumption choice excludes $u$.
The B matching may have long edges; the proposed split theorem explicitly
allows them. Its marked geometry depends only on the holes, cut and
chosen $S$, not on the arbitrary completion matching in A.

Whenever an internal coordinate of B has the marked $(2,1)/(4,2)$ split,
apply the imported theorem to this actual B input. Expanding the
suppressed paths and deleting the tagged $uv$ edge gives a Hamilton
$u$--$v$ path preserving every original matching edge. The expansion
and degree accounting are exactly those of the accepted uniform
transfer, with no additional restrictions on the original matching.
If the original Q6 cut has no matching crossing, its already imported
five-direction endpoint theorem applies directly instead.

##### Complete conditional coverage calculation

[ten_covered_t63_complete_split_profile.py](research/six_directions/ten_covered_t63_complete_split_profile.py) reads only the three frozen
residual files accepted by [Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json). It tests
every one of the six outer cuts, every eligible three-subset $S$ for
the two rows above, and the marked internal split counts. It records
an actual witness for each newly covered record and preserves all
other records byte for byte in separate output files.

| target | accepted input | newly covered if import accepted | remaining |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 16920 | 4000 | 12920 |
| 7 | 17022 | 4296 | 12726 |
| 31 | 20280 | 4620 | 15660 |
| total | 54222 | 12916 | 41306 |

These are hole-geometry counts. Each successful row proves the result
for every realizing original matching, not just one matching sample.
Independent review must reconstruct the exact residual domain and each
actual marked split witness before these numbers enter the main ledger.

##### Remaining obligations

The complete split theorem and this application require independent
acceptance. Complete ten-hole covered targets, the complete higher Q6
layers, and full P6 remain open.


</details>


<details id="proof-ten-hole-covered-partial-a8-transfer" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_A8_TRANSFER.md — Ten-hole covered targets using the accepted partial A8 and K8 inputs</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_A8_TRANSFER.md)。SHA-256：`da885643ff1b0fc266d3594bbd725d7d5be6d3fd12ce639972f2f2c894133bbc`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json), [TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json)。

#### Ten-hole covered targets using the accepted partial A8 and K8 inputs

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Proposed sufficient classes; independent
review pending. This is not full ten-hole P6.

##### Domain and imports

Let M be any short 27-edge matching of Q6, u a free root, and v a covered
target of opposite parity. Normalize u=0. Its other even holes Z have size4,
and its odd holes W size5. If Z-W has a short edge, add it and apply full
eight-hole P6; assume henceforth that Z union W is independent.

Use the notation A,B,a,b,delta,c of HIGHER_HOLE_UNIFIED_TRANSFER.md.
The target v is in A. For c=0 the imported five-direction theorem applies.
The accepted inputs are the complete eight-hole theorem, the accepted
uniform transfer and its original eight ten-hole rows, the 24 complete
marked T15 cores and full T15 split case, Q5 K8 from Q5_K8_REVIEW, and
the partial A8 results accepted in A8_PARTIAL_REVIEW and
A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW. No complete A8 is imported.

Call a marked Q5 geometry (minority set L of size3, majority set J of size5,
omitted hole y in J) admissible if either of these conditions holds:

1. a coordinate face containing y has majority-minus-minority count 1,2,3;
2. a coordinate face containing y has all five majority holes and one minority.

In the applications below L and J minus y are nonadjacent, as they come
from the original independent Z,W. The two audited partial A8 theorems
therefore provide the required 31-cycle for every arbitrary matching on
the complement of each admissible marked geometry.

##### Local endpoint conversion

Suppose F is any matching of K(Q5) with four holes of each parity,
r is an even hole, and y is a covered odd vertex. Write h=F(y) and form
F'=F-yh+hr. Its holes are the old holes minus r plus y. If this marked
3:5 geometry, omitting y, is admissible, partial A8 gives its 31-cycle.
Delete hr and append the original edge hy at h. This gives a Hamilton
r-y path preserving F with short new edges. This works for every h and
does not require knowing the mate h from the hole geometry.

##### Six additional cut rules

All coordinates in a local admissibility test are the five coordinates
other than the original Q6 cut. All parities below are global parities.

* (a,b)=(0,1): use the uniform no-bridge transfer. A needs the accepted
  balanced-two-hole endpoint theorem; B has four holes of each parity,
  after the tagged closure consumes the root if necessary. Apply K8.
* (1,1): let z be the unique Z hole in A and let y be its mirror in B.
  Use one even-hole bridge. A needs the two-hole endpoint theorem.
  The B hole geometry is minority Z intersect B (three vertices),
  majority (W intersect B) union {y} (five vertices), omitted y.
  This cut succeeds whenever that actual geometry is admissible.
* (0,2): choose w in W intersect A with mirror y different from u.
  At least one choice exists. Use one odd-hole bridge. The B geometry
  has minority W intersect B, majority (Z intersect B) union {y},
  omitted y. Its admissibility suffices.
* (3,4): use no bridges. The A completed matching has balanced eight holes.
  In the local endpoint conversion, the root is removed and v added,
  leaving minority Z intersect A and majority (W intersect A) union {v}.
  If this geometry omitting v is admissible, the required A path exists;
  B needs only its already accepted balanced-two-hole cycle theorem.
* (4,4): choose z in Z intersect A as the even bridge source. The A endpoint
  conversion has minority (Z intersect A) minus {z}, majority
  (W intersect A) union {v}, omitted v. Its admissibility suffices.
  B has exactly two odd holes, one the bridge mirror; use N14 avoiding it.
* (3,5): choose w in W intersect A whose mirror differs from u.
  The A endpoint conversion has minority Z intersect A, majority
  ((W intersect A) minus {w}) union {v}, omitted v. Its admissibility
  suffices. B has two even holes; N14 omits the bridge mirror.

These are complete statements for every matching realizing each eligible
geometry, not just for a sampled matching. The choices of z,w and a local
admissibility cut depend only on the original marked hole geometry.

##### Endpoint and forest bookkeeping

For the first three rows, the accepted uniform transfer applies directly;
only its precise B input is replaced by the new accepted theorem.

For the last three rows, repeat its completion D and bridge construction.
If delta=1, the A root r is u. If delta=0 and there is no even bridge,
it is an even crossing port, which exists by the port imbalance. If delta=0
in row (4,4), it is the chosen even bridge source z. In all three cases
the completed A matching has four holes of each parity, and removing r
and adding v leaves exactly the geometry displayed above. This equality
does not depend on the chosen artificial D or crossing port.

The covered global target v stays covered in the completed A matching:
an internal original edge covers it, or it is an odd crossing port paired
by D. It cannot be the even root, nor an original free bridge source.
Thus the local endpoint conversion applies. Once the A path is supplied,
all remaining steps of the uniform transfer are unchanged: remove D,
attach original crossings and the optional single bridge, join the global
endpoints by a tagged edge, compress the forest and its bridge conflict,
apply the stated B theorem, expand, and remove the tag. The root/target
degrees, preservation of every original matching edge, and shortness of
all surviving new edges follow from that already audited bookkeeping.

##### Exact finite coverage task

The independent census should enumerate all Z of four nonzero even Q6
vertices, and all W of five odd vertices nonadjacent to Z, for normalized
covered target v=1,7,31 with v outside W. For every input it tests the
eight old basic rows, all actual accepted T15 projections, and the six new
rules above. Any remaining input stays OPEN.

The producer chain gives 145248180 eligible covered-target geometries,
121690 remaining after the old rows and conservative T15 lookup, and
91225 after the new rules (26880,29955,34390 at targets1,7,31). These numbers
are unaudited producer evidence until independently reconstructed.
No feasibility exclusion was used for the ten-hole final remainder.

Relevant producer files are higher_hole_geometry_census.cpp,
higher_hole_t15_lookup.py, higher_hole_t15_filter.cpp, and
ten_covered_partial_a8_filter.cpp. No unrestricted same-face T15 shortcut
is used by that conservative lookup. The exact remaining bytes are in
ten_covered_after_partial_a8_v1.bin, v7.bin, and v31.bin.

Even after this partial coverage is audited, the remaining geometries
still require proofs for all their realizing matchings. No complete ten-
hole covered-target, A8, A10, or P6 conclusion is asserted.


</details>


<details id="proof-ten-hole-free-closure" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>TEN_HOLE_FREE_CLOSURE.md — Ten-hole P6 with both endpoints free</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_FREE_CLOSURE.md)。SHA-256：`eae99ab5636bf70135779cc4fcd63b1b77ecb52a115f204d93a2a204e0973243`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[TEN_HOLE_FREE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_FREE_REVIEW.json), [TEN_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json)。

#### Ten-hole P6 with both endpoints free

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Proposed complete proof relative to the
listed imports and a finite hole-geometry census; independent review pending.
The covered-target ten-hole branch and full P6 remain open.

##### Exact claim

For every short 27-edge matching $M$ of $Q_6$, every free root $u$, and
every free target $v$ of opposite parity, there is a Hamilton $u$--$v$
path containing every edge of $M$. Only short new edges are used.

##### Imports and dependency map

1. Full eight-hole P6, including covered targets, from
   [EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_CLOSURE.md](#proof-eight-hole-full-closure) and its final independent review.
2. The unified cut transfer in [HIGHER_HOLE_UNIFIED_TRANSFER.md](#proof-higher-hole-unified-transfer), including
   its eight unconditional ten-hole rows and its marked T15 rows. This new
   transfer must itself pass independent review before this claim is accepted.
3. The 24 complete marked T15 cores accepted in the final eight-hole review:
   $\{0,1,2,4,5,7,8,10,13,14,15,18,19,21,23,24,25,27,31,32,35,37,38,44\}$.
   IDs refer to [t15_analytic_geometry.json](research/six_directions/t15_analytic_geometry.json); all required matchings are
   arbitrary complete-graph matchings, and both specified omissions matter.
4. The full geometric T15 split case in [Q4_RICH_GLUING.md](#proof-q4-rich-gluing), with accepted
   independent `Q4_RICH_GLUING_REVIEW.md/.json`. After translating the minority
   hole to 0, this case has a coordinate with exactly two of the five odd
   holes in its one-face and with the two omitted holes in different faces.
   It applies at both positive and zero original crossing counts.
5. Adjacent minority/included-hole augmentation to T44_5 is also permitted
   by the lookup, but does not occur in the independent input domain here.

No unrestricted T15 theorem, higher-hole P6 theorem, or matching sample
stands in for these imports. The finite work below is geometry coverage;
the full matching quantifiers are supplied by the imported local theorems.

##### 1. Endpoint-symmetric short augmentation

Suppose two free vertices $x,y$ of $M$ are adjacent.

If $\{x,y\}\ne\{u,v\}$, at least one of $u,v$ remains free after adding
$xy$. Apply full eight-hole P6 to $M+xy$, rooted at that still-free endpoint
and targeted at the other endpoint. The other endpoint may now be covered,
which is explicitly allowed by the eight-hole import. Reverse the path if
necessary. It contains $M$ and has the required endpoints.

If $xy=uv$, apply full eight-hole P6 to $M+uv$ with any remaining free root
$r$ and a short neighbor $s$ as target. Close the Hamilton $r$--$s$ path
by the short edge $rs$. This edge cannot already be the endpoint edge of
a path on 64 vertices; it is also not a matching edge since $r$ is free.
The resulting Hamilton cycle contains $M+uv$. Delete $uv$ to obtain the
required $u$--$v$ path containing $M$.

Therefore the only new domain has **all ten holes independent**, including
both endpoints. Translate $u$ to 0, write the other even holes as $Z$ with
$|Z|=4$, and the odd holes as $W$ with $|W|=5$ and $v\in W$. A coordinate
permutation takes $v$ to 7 or 31 according to its distance 3 or 5 from 0;
distance 1 is excluded by independence.

##### 2. Sufficient cuts tested on the independent domain

For every coordinate put A on the target side and calculate
$a=|Z\cap A|$, $b=|W\cap A|$.

The eight universally sufficient rows are

$$ (1,2),(2,3),(2,2),(3,3),(1,3),(2,4),(4,3),(2,5). $$

Otherwise use the two T15 rows:

* For $(a,b)=(3,2)$, choose any two of the three A even nonroot holes as
  bridge sources. The sole B nonroot even hole is the T15 minority; the
  three B odd holes are its included majority holes; the two bridge mirrors
  are its marked omissions.
* For $(a,b)=(1,4)$, choose any two A odd holes excluding the free target
  and any hole mirrored to the root. The sole B odd hole is the minority;
  the three B nonroot even holes are its included majority holes; the
  bridge mirrors are its two marked omissions.

Translate each B vertex by the minority and delete the cut coordinate.
This actual cube isomorphism normalizes the minority to 0 and all five
majority holes to odd labels of $Q_5$. Accept a choice only when it belongs
to one of the 24 audited marked cores, or the audited split case above.
The unified transfer supplies the full global path for every realizing
original matching of any geometry with such a choice.

##### 3. Finite coverage obligation and producer evidence

The finite assertion to be independently checked is:

> Every set $\{0\}\cup Z\cup W$ of ten independent vertices of $Q_6$,
> with $|Z|=4$ even, $|W|=5$ odd, and target $v=7$ or $31$ in W,
> has a sufficient row or an accepted marked T15 choice from Section 2.

Producer files [higher_hole_geometry_census.cpp](research/six_directions/higher_hole_geometry_census.cpp),
[higher_hole_t15_lookup.py](research/six_directions/higher_hole_t15_lookup.py), and [higher_hole_t15_filter.cpp](research/six_directions/higher_hole_t15_filter.cpp) enumerate the
larger domain where only $Z\cup W$ is independent. There are 56805 residual
free-target geometries for $v=7$ after the eight basic rows, all handled
by accepted T15 choices. For $v=31$ the corresponding count is 51935;
51875 have accepted T15 choices. Each of the remaining 60 has a member
of W adjacent to root 0, and hence was already handled by Section 1.
No infeasibility exclusion is used in these free-target counts.

These producer counts are supporting diagnostics, not independent proof
certificates by themselves. The reviewer must independently regenerate
the complete independent-hole domain, reconstruct the actual marked
projections and accepted orbit maps, and confirm that no input remains.
No extrapolation from a random matching or from one Hamilton witness is used.

##### 4. Conclusion and limits

Once the precise finite assertion in Section 3 and the new transfer are
independently accepted, Sections 1--2 prove the exact free-target ten-hole
claim. This does not prove ten-hole covered targets, any complete 12--18-hole
layer, full T15, or full P6. Those obligations remain in the active goal.


</details>


<details id="proof-three-matchings-disconnection" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>THREE_MATCHINGS_DISCONNECTION.md — Blocking three boundary pairings</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/THREE_MATCHINGS_DISCONNECTION.md)。SHA-256：`a1f87ead5d1567fb8c892b8617aa4e9afae75f7555d573ef0de47866fe2013e2`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json), [T15_CORE0_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/T15_CORE0_FULL_REVIEW.json)。

#### Blocking three boundary pairings

Date: 2026-11-01. Proof-writer; independent review pending.

##### Claim

Let V be a set of even cardinality N>=6. For any collection of at most
three perfect matchings R_i on the complete graph on V, there is a
perfect matching D such that the multigraph D union R_i is disconnected
for every i. Common edges count twice in this multigraph, but connectivity
is the same as in the ordinary edge-set union.

##### Proof

The empty collection is immediate. Repeat a member if necessary so the
collection has three entries, with repetitions allowed.

If N>=10, choose an edge e1 of R1. At most two edges of R2 meet its two
vertices, so R2, having at least five edges, has a disjoint edge e2.
At most four edges of R3 meet the four chosen vertices, so R3 has an
edge e3 disjoint from both. Complete the three disjoint edges to a perfect
matching D on the remaining even number of vertices. For each i, the
shared edge ei is a two-vertex component of D union Ri: its endpoints
already have their only partner in both matchings. Since N>2, the union
is disconnected.

For N=6 or 8 relabel V so R1 is the canonical consecutive pairing.
This loses no generality: every perfect matching can be sent to that
pairing by a vertex bijection, which preserves connectivity and sends
the other two matchings to arbitrary perfect matchings on the same set.
There are respectively 15 and 105 perfect matchings. The certificate
[three_matchings_disconnection.json](research/six_directions/three_matchings_disconnection.json) lists every matching and, for every
ordered choice of R2,R3, supplies an index of a D whose union with each
of R1,R2,R3 is disconnected. There are 225 and 11025 pairs, including
equal matchings. [three_matchings_disconnection.py](research/six_directions/three_matchings_disconnection.py) checks each union
by graph traversal. A fresh checker must verify matching-list coverage,
the complete rectangular index set and every specified D; failed search
is never a certificate. Undo the relabeling to conclude. QED.

##### Application principle

Suppose a construction, for every auxiliary boundary pairing D, supplies
a pairing R such that D union R is connected. If at most three specific
pairings are forbidden and N>=6, the construction has a permissible
choice: choose D from the claim to rule out all three forbidden outputs.
This respects the quantifiers; it does not assert that one can prescribe
R independently of D.


</details>


<details id="proof-three-odd-holes-transfer" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>THREE_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md — Z15：三个奇孔同侧的避目标圈转移</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/THREE_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md)。SHA-256：`9e8208e1e71e18386158c4f43bed33d185b0d4c4acad3347235f130dfe403753`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.json)。

#### Z15：三个奇孔同侧的避目标圈转移

日期：2026-11-01。状态：新证明草稿，待独立审计。完整 P6 未证明。

##### 命题与依赖

设 $M$ 是 $Q_6$ 的短匹配，孔为 $u,z,w,t$，$p(u)=p(z)\ne p(w)=p(t)$，指定 $p(v)\ne p(u)$。若存在坐标 $i$ 满足

$$v_i=w_i=t_i\ne z_i,$$

则存在包含 $M$ 的 Hamilton $u$—$v$ 路径。不限制 $u$ 位于哪一面。

依赖 N8、N10，以及 TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md 的 N14。同奇偶双孔的避孔圈是两层都使用的输入；本定理不依赖完整 P6。

##### 证明

平移取 $u=0$，于是 $z$ 偶、$w,t,v$ 奇。若目标自由，用 N8。若 $z$ 与 $w$ 或 $t$ 相邻，添加该短边，再用 N10。因此以下目标被覆盖且 $z$ 不与 $w,t$ 相邻。

令 $h=M(v)$，$M^*=(M\setminus\{vh\})\cup\{hu\}$。沿 $i$ 切分，令 $A$ 包含 $v,w,t$，$B$ 包含 $z$。$M^*$ 的孔恰为这四点，$hu$ 是唯一可能的长边及唯一同偶边。记跨边为 $C^*$，端口为 $X_A,X_B$。$A$ 的孔数为三，因此跨边数为正奇数。

###### 1. 至少一个可用桥接点

两个候选 $w\oplus e_i,t\oplus e_i$ 都在 $B$，同为偶点，且均不等于 $z$，因为排除了 $z$ 与 $w,t$ 相邻的情形。

若候选不等于原自由点 $u$，则原来必由 $M_B$ 覆盖：它不是孔，而跨面邻点为原孔。由 $M$ 变为 $M^*$，只有 $u,h$ 的匹配伙伴发生变化（$v\in A$），所以除候选 $u,h$ 外覆盖性质不变。

若 $u,h$ 都在 $B$，新边 $hu$ 在 $B$ 内，两个候选即使等于其中之一也被 $M_B^*$ 覆盖。若 $u,h$ 都在 $A$，它们不等于候选，覆盖也不变。若 $u,h$ 分处两面，则它们中只有位于 $B$ 的那个可能是失去内部覆盖的候选。两个候选不同，故至少另一个仍由 $M_B^*$ 覆盖。

交换 $w,t$ 后，选定 $b=t\oplus e_i$ 被 $M_B^*$ 覆盖，记 $r=M_B^*(b)$。

###### 2. A 侧避目标圈与转移

在偶数个点 $X_A\cup\{t\}$ 上任取完整图完美配对 $D$。集合至少含两个点，故 $D$ 非空。令 $L_A=M_A^*\cup D$，则其孔恰为同奇偶的 $v,w$。N14 给出包含 $L_A$、覆盖 $A\setminus\{v\}$ 的圈 $C_A$。

删除 $D$，得到覆盖 $A\setminus\{v\}$ 的顶点不交非平凡路径族，端点集恰为 $X_A\cup\{t\}$。给 $X_A$ 各端点接回真实 $C^*$ 边，给端点 $t$ 接短边 $tb$。所得路径族内点全在 $A\setminus\{v\}$，端点恰为 $X_B\cup\{b\}$。把各段缩成形式边，得到匹配 $R$。

###### 3. 消去 B 侧唯一冲突

$M_B^*$ 与 $R$ 恰在顶点 $b$ 发生覆盖冲突。令 $s=R(b)$，则 $s\in X_B$。因为 $b,r$ 原由 $M_B^*$ 覆盖，而 $z,s$ 不被它覆盖，四点 $b,r,z,s$ 两两不同。构造

$$L_B=(M_B^*\setminus\{br\})\cup(R\setminus\{bs\})\cup\{rs\}.$$

该匹配恰不覆盖 $z,b$：$R$ 原填满全部 $X_B$ 并额外覆盖 $b$；删除两条冲突边后留下 $z,b,r,s$，补 $rs$ 后仅留 $z,b$。$z,b$ 同偶，故 N14 给出包含 $L_B$、覆盖 $B\setminus\{b\}$ 的圈 $C_B$。

###### 4. 展开并恢复原目标

把辅助边 $rs$ 替换成原匹配边 $rb$，再接从 $b$ 到 $s$ 的那条 R 所代表的 A 路径。将其余 $R\setminus\{bs\}$ 边全部展开。

原圈 $C_B$ 各 B 点除 $b$ 外出现一次；$b$ 在 $rs$ 展开中恢复一次。各展开段的 A 内点互不相交并覆盖 $A\setminus\{v\}$。因此得到覆盖 $Q_6\setminus\{v\}$ 的单圈，包含全部 $M^*$。即使 $br$ 恰为长边 $hu$，也在此步真实恢复并保留到下一步；不假定 $br$ 是短边。

删除 $hu$，在端点 $h$ 接回原边 $hv$，得到所需 Hamilton $u$—$v$ 路径。原匹配全部恢复；$D,rs,R,hu$ 均删除或展开，新增边仅为面内输入圈的短边和桥接短边 $tb$。证毕。

##### 与 Z14 的合并

对每个满足 $v_i\ne z_i$ 的坐标，若 $w_i\ne t_i$，用 Z14；若 $w_i=t_i=v_i$，用 Z15。两者均不适用的情况只剩：在每个 $v,z$ 不同的坐标上，$w_i=t_i=z_i$。

这只是几何充分条件的共同例外，不是完整证明的反例。Z9、Z11、Z13 等仍可处理其中一些；六孔以上也尚未统一处理。


</details>

#### Fifteen new forced T17 marked classifications: reduced rank1024

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer producer proof. PROVABLE AS STATED relative
to the primary generic rank upper bound and explicit finite certificates,
pending independent verification. No old input or accepted state changed.

##### Exact quantified local theorem

For EACH row below let H={0} union J, U={1,2,4}, K=Q5-H, and p=8,q=16.
For every arbitrary perfect matching F of the COMPLETE graph on K, there
is one simple29-cycle on exactly Q5-U containing F with only short new
edges IF AND ONLY IF pq is absent from F. Original required edges may be
long or equal-parity. All marked sets and the forced pair must be transported
together under cube automorphisms, including parity reversal. This proves
only the exact fifteen marked inputs, not unrestricted T17 or a Q6 layer.

| 177 | 1,2,4,7,11,21,26 | 177 |

| 179 | 1,2,4,11,13,19,22 | 179 |
| 180 | 1,2,4,11,13,19,28 | 180 |

| 182 | 1,2,4,11,21,26,28 | 182 |

| 283 | 1,2,4,25,26,28,31 | 283 |

Every included hole has its exact declared degree. The UNIQUE hole with
only two short neighbors outside U is0, with neighbors precisely8 and16,
both covered. These fifteen marked cases were compared with all120
coordinate permutations of the old seven accepted forced T17 inputs;
none belongs to those seven. They therefore need their own new reduced
certificates rather than an unsupported import of old classification.

##### Necessity and reduced-rank sufficiency

Any permitted cycle has degree2 at the uncovered vertex0, whose only
remaining short neighbors are p,q. It must contain p--0--q. If F contains
pq, these three vertices form an isolated triangle, impossible in a
spanning29-cycle. This is a direct analytic negative certificate, not
a consequence of deficient rank or unsuccessful search.

The positive certificate supplies1024 short forests S on Q5-U. Every
covered vertex of K has degree1, each of the five included holes has
degree2, and no component is a cycle. There are17 short edges and12
path components, with endpoints precisely the24 vertices of K. The
component through0 is exactly p--0--q. Its full endpoint matching P
therefore contains pq. Delete that matching pair to obtain P' on
K'=K minus {p,q}, which has22 vertices.

If F lacks pq, put a=F(p),b=F(q). These four vertices are distinct.
Replace pa,qb by ab to give an arbitrary complete-graph perfect matching
F' on K'. Contracting the labelled path a--p--q--b proves connectedness
of F+P equivalent to connectedness of F'+P'. The compressed edge ab
need not be short; the local rank domain permits it.

The primary matching-connectivity theorem, Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof,
Corollary3.5, bounds rank_GF2(H_22)<=2^(22/2-1)=1024 on ALL complete-graph
perfect matchings. Its generic source/domain alignment is recorded in
A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md. For each row the supplied1024
P' rows and1024 valid arbitrary-matching columns give rank1024. Their
complete rows consequently span H_22's row space. Every matching column
is nonzero: cyclically link consecutive oriented required edges. Hence
some P' connects the arbitrary F'. Undo contraction and expand P's paths
through S to obtain the required simple29-cycle, retaining all F edges.
A common required/forest endpoint pair would create an isolated labelled
2-cycle and cannot occur in the successful global connected union.
The only deliberately fixed pair pq is already absent from F.

##### Independent-verification interface and finite formats

Each prefix is TWELVE_EXTRA_FORCED_orbit_XXX, with original308 indexXXX.
The1024 records per file have these exact formats:

- _forests.bin:34 bytes, seventeen sorted distinct short edges.
- _full_pairs.bin:24 bytes, twelve full endpoint pairs on K.
- _pairs.bin and _columns.bin:22 bytes on K'.
- _matrix.bin, _pivots.bin, _combos.bin:1024 rows of128 bytes, low-bit-first.
- _config.txt and .json: actual holes, omissions and extraction metadata.

Pivots have distinct highest set bits0,...,1023 and equal the XOR of
original rows selected by combos, certifying exact binary rank. A checker
may instead recompute rank from scratch. It must also independently
verify every forest's exact support, shortness, degrees, acyclicity,
full endpoint pairing and forced cherry; remove pq and compare P'; check
every column; and recompute all1024^2 matrix bits per row. The total is
15360 forests and15728640 connectivity bits. The separate producer author
checker performs these computations but is not a fresh acceptance review.

The producer extraction takes independent columns of each existing
1024-by2048 full-endpoint matrix and contracts its selected original
matching columns through p,q. Its source indices explain construction
only. The target reduced certificate stands independently; no forest
exhaustiveness, old full-row matrix or reported rank need be trusted.

##### Scope and dependencies

The acyclic local DAG is primary generic rank bound + new selected finite
forests/columns/reduced matrices -> exact fifteen conditional statements.
It imports no full T17, Q6 twelve-hole theorem or P6 conclusion. The
necessary obstruction is proved analytically. An unsuccessful rank
criterion alone would remain OPEN, not disprove the local theorem.
Application requires the accepted general forced-cherry transfer and
actual root-not-obstruction/source/marked geometry conditions, proved
separately in TWELVE_EXTRA_FORCED_APPLICATION.md. No main ledger changed.


</details>


<details id="proof-twelve-extra-types-application" class="source-doc" markdown="1">

#### New actual smaller-hole inputs: exact twelve-hole positive coverage

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer producer application, pending independent
local rank and actual coverage acceptance. Existing local registries are
not treated as universal. Root profile/search/summary and all original
29370 input bytes remain unchanged. Full twelve-hole and P6 stay OPEN.

##### Exact input boundary and local theorem scopes

The common input is29370 covered-target marked geometries in
TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_HALL_union_remaining_v{1,7,31}.bin, with6315/9828/13227
eleven-byte records. Each lists the five nonroot even holes Z and six odd
holes W; root0 is free/even, target v covered/odd, and Z union W independent.
The earlier reduction, Hall exclusions, forced applications and exact
source-domain reviews are separate acceptance gates. No matching feasibility
filter or additional exclusion is imposed by this application.

For every original short Q6 matching realizing such a geometry, an actual
cut/source choice is sufficient if its ACTUAL marked B minority,majority
and omitted sets lie in a selected candidate universal local theorem.
Every such theorem must allow arbitrary complete-graph required matchings,
including the long or same-parity edges created by transfer. An unmarked
hole orbit test, or treating the old55 T26 / old T17 registry as complete,
would be invalid. The308 new rows here are explicit actual marked inputs.

The final producer summary completes all308 searches, with293 full-rank
and15 nonfull inputs. All15 nonfull are T17 with rank1024; they remain
OPEN and are not negative certificates. This application forms the complete
positive record union using only the293 full-rank candidates. It then
selects11 candidates whose union is exactly the same. Only these11 local
theorems need be accepted for the selected application conclusion.

##### Local rank and actual source rows

| Type | Local holes | Marked omissions | Endpoints / full rank | Forest edges | Q6(a,b) rows | A balanced holes |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---|---|
|T26|2 minority,6 majority|2|24 /2048|18|(3,2),(1,4)|2+2|
|T15|1 minority,5 majority|2|26 /4096|17|(4,3),(2,5)|3+3|

No T63 actual projection occurs in this residual profile. The source
supports its type shape conservatively but uses no nonexistent registry
row. All selected11 candidates are T26 except original308 index12, which
is an unforced full-rank T17. The exact selected marked geometry, prefix
and rank are in TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_greedy_registry.json, with indices
0,3,5,51,77,183,32,18,58,52,12.

The universal local rank criterion is the generic complete-graph
matching-connectivity upper bound rank_GF2(H_n)<=2^(n/2-1). Legal short
forests have degree0 at omissions, degree2 at included holes, degree1 at
covered endpoints, and no cycle. A full-rank restriction using valid
arbitrary matching columns makes their complete rows span H_n's row
space. Every matching column is nonzero by cyclically linking its oriented
required edges. Thus some selected forest connects with every required
matching, and expanding its paths yields the desired local single cycle.
Shared labelled pairs would be isolated2-cycles and cannot occur in a
successful connected endpoint union. Local finite certificates, rather
than the producer flag alone, need their independent verification.

##### Universal actual Q6 transfer proof

For a target-oriented coordinate cut A put a=|Z intersect A|, b=|W intersect A|.

mirror exclusion leaves enough sources. Every selected mirror is distinct
and internally B-covered: original Z--W independence excludes another
hole, the free short mirror excludes an original crossing edge, and the
root-mirror exclusion prevents consuming u.

Use the accepted root/completion construction, obtain the A path, delete
completion edges, attach actual crossings and source bridges, and add
the endpoint tag. Its graph is a forest, including the accepted D-empty
and target-port boundaries. Suppression conflicts occur only at the

selected candidate LOCAL marked theorem, expand all paths and delete

#### Eleven additional marked Q5 local inputs

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate. Independent review pending.

##### Exact statement

Use precisely the eleven indices in [TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_greedy_registry.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_greedy_registry.json):
0,3,5,51,77,183,32,18,58,52,12. For each, take its exact marked minority,
majority and omitted sets in [TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_summary.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_summary.json), and put
H=minority union majority and K=V(Q5) minus H. For EVERY perfect matching
F of the complete graph on K, there is a simple cycle on exactly
V(Q5) minus U containing F and adding only cube edges. The same holds
for all common cube automorphic images of (H,U). Matching edges may
be long or same-parity. The exact hole and omission sets matter.

The first ten listed indices are T26 (2:6 holes, two majority omissions).
Index12 is T17 (1:7 holes, three majority omissions). All have24 covered
endpoints. No unrestricted T26/T17 claim or old-registry extrapolation
is made. The remaining producer rows are not premises of this theorem.

##### Proof

For each claimed row, the certificate supplies2048 forests S_i of short
edges on the retained vertices. They have degree one at K, degree two
at H minus U, and no cycles. A T26 forest has18 edges and covers30
vertices; a T17 forest has17 edges and covers29 vertices. Each is the
disjoint union of twelve paths, with endpoint pairing P(S_i) on K.

The complete matching-connectivity matrix on all complete-graph perfect
matchings of K has GF(2) rank2^(24/2-1)=2048 by Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof,
Corollary3.5. The general primary theorem and version are recorded in
[A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md](#proof-a10-orbit3-universal-primary-source) (arXiv1211.1506,
DOI10.1145/3148227). It has no bipartite restriction on the matchings.

The2048 supplied forests and2048 arbitrary matching columns yield a
connectivity submatrix of exact binary rank2048. Thus their complete
rows span the full matching-connectivity row space. Every column F is
nonzero: orient the twelve F edges and join the end of each to the start
of the next cyclically. Therefore some selected P(S_i) is connected with
the arbitrary required F. Expand its paths to obtain one cycle on all
retained vertices. A common required/forest physical edge would give
an isolated labelled two-edge component of P(S_i)+F, impossible on24
endpoints in a connected union. All new physical edges are short.

This proves the exact local claim subject to the finite checks below.
Exhaustiveness of the producer search, the complete geometry census and
the greedy selection algorithm are not dependencies of this local proof.

##### Finite certificates

Prefixes are `TWELVE_EXTRA_TYPES_orbit_XXX`, using the selected index.
There are2048 records per file. Forest records contain36 bytes for T26,
34 bytes for T17. Pairings and matching columns contain24 vertex bytes.
Matrix, pivot and combo rows contain256 bytes, little-bit-first.
The respective suffixes are `_forests.bin`, `_pairs.bin`, `_columns.bin`,
`_matrix.bin`, `_pivots.bin`, `_combos.bin`, `_config.txt`, and `.json`.

The independent checker must reconstruct all short forests and endpoint
pairings, validate every column, recompute every connectivity bit, and
verify binary rank2048. Metadata is insufficient. Totals are22528 forests
and46137344 connectivity bits. The frozen existing T26/T17 generator
sources are reused with new prefixes and inputs; none was modified.

Q6 application and the exact remaining domain require a separate review.
This local theorem alone closes no complete Q6 hole layer. Full twelve-
hole and P6 remain OPEN.

<summary>TWELVE_HALL_PROOF.md — Explicit neighbor-deficiency witnesses remove7483 impossible geometries</summary>

#### Explicit neighbor-deficiency witnesses remove7483 impossible geometries

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate; independent review pending.

##### Exact sufficient exclusion

For each record certified in [TWELVE_HALL_witnesses.bin](research/six_directions/TWELVE_HALL_witnesses.bin), there is no
short Q6 matching whose uncovered set is exactly H={0} union Z union W
from that record. These are7483 of the37405 original-label inputs in
`TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_positive_remaining_v{1,7,31}.bin`. No conclusion about
nonexistence of Hamilton paths for an actual matching is asserted.
These records cannot be realized by the original matching in the first
place. Other records are retained without a negative or positive theorem.

##### Direct proof from each witness

Let L be the even vertices outside H and R the odd vertices outside H.
Both have26 elements. Every short matching with exactly those holes
must pair every vertex of L with a distinct vertex of R by a cube edge.
The supplied nonempty S is a subset of L. Its supplied T is checked
to equal all cube neighbors of S that lie in R, and |T|<|S|.
All partners of S would lie in T and would be distinct, giving an
injection from the larger finite set S into the smaller T. This is
impossible. This proves the exclusion without trusting a matching solver
or needing the converse of Hall's theorem.

##### Exact format and finite obligations

Each21-byte record is little-endian `<BIQQ`:

- normalized target v: one unsigned byte;
- original input record index: uint32;
- S: uint64 bitmask of actual Q6 vertices;
- T: uint64 bitmask of actual Q6 vertices.

Each input record consists of eleven vertex bytes, sorted Z5 then W6,
with root0. The checker must verify source file bindings, legal target
and hole counts, each unique source index, S subset of covered evens,
T equal to the entire covered odd neighborhood, and the strict cardinality
deficiency. Keeping all records not so certified, in source order, must
reproduce each claimed residual byte stream exactly.

|7|11661|1581|10080|
|31|17712|4185|13527|
|total|37405|7483|29922|

S,T. Its control flow or maximality is not a premise of the proof: each

The local exclusions depend only on the specified input bytes and their

#### Complete twelve-hole Q6 theorem for two prescribed free endpoints

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer assembly. Status: PROVABLE AS STATED
relative to the explicitly listed accepted imports and the final actual
application review. Independent assembly review pending.

##### Exact theorem

For every short matching M of Q6 with exactly 26 edges (twelve uncovered
vertices), and every two prescribed uncovered vertices u,v of opposite
parity, Q6 has a Hamilton u--v path containing every edge of M.
All path edges are cube edges. This theorem requires BOTH endpoints free.
It does not assert the twelve-hole covered-target branch or complete P6.

##### Dependency map

1. [TEN_HOLE_FULL_CLOSURE.md](#proof-ten-hole-full-closure) / [TEN_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json): complete
   preceding ten-hole theorem, including covered opposite targets.

   predecessor reduction, near-balanced cut theorem and exact normalized
   residual domains. Only its twelve-hole part is used here.
3. [HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_PROOF.md](#proof-higher-q5-full-reuse-proof) /
   [HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_Q5_FULL_REUSE_REVIEW.json): accepted marked local inputs and
   exact further residual, including all free-target quantifiers.
4. [HIGHER_Q5_FULL_T37_APPLICATION.md](#proof-higher-q5-full-t37-application) /
   [HIGHER_Q5_FULL_T37_APPLICATION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_Q5_FULL_T37_APPLICATION_REVIEW.json): actual free residuals
   covered by either of two independently applicable routes. The T37
   route imports [Q5_T37_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_T37_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.json); the forced T17 route
   imports [Q5_T17_RANK_BATCH_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_T17_RANK_BATCH_REVIEW.json) and
   [HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json).

All finite sets below are over-domains of hole geometries: no exclusion
for non-realizability by a short matching is used. Every successful
geometry transfers uniformly for every realizing original short matching.
Completion pairings may depend on that matching. None of these inputs
depends on the desired complete twelve-hole theorem.

##### Step 1: remove adjacent free holes using the full preceding layer

Suppose two holes x,y are adjacent. Add xy to M, obtaining a short
27-edge matching. If xy differs from uv, at least one of u,v stays free.
Use that endpoint as the root in the complete ten-hole theorem and the
other as target. Reverse the resulting Hamilton path if necessary. The
path contains M and has the prescribed endpoints; its extra xy is short.

If xy=uv, choose another free root r of the augmented matching and any
cube neighbor s of r. There are ten free vertices after augmentation,
so r exists and is distinct from u,v. The full ten-hole theorem supplies
a Hamilton r--s path containing M and uv. The edge rs is not already in
this 64-vertex path, because it joins its two endpoints. Add rs to form
a Hamilton cycle, then delete uv. The resulting Hamilton u--v path
contains M. Neither the deleted uv nor rs was an original required edge
incident to a free vertex.

It therefore remains to treat matchings whose entire twelve-hole set
is independent. This step genuinely uses the full ten-hole theorem,
including its covered-target quantifier when needed.

##### Step 2: normalize all independent geometries

Translate u to zero and permute coordinates. Its opposite-parity target
has odd Hamming weight 1,3 or5 and can be normalized to v=1,7 or31.
Translation and permutation preserve short edges and matchings; a final
path transports back to the original prescribed endpoints. Write the
hole set as {0} union Z union W, with five nonzero even vertices Z and
six odd vertices W, and v in W. Because the holes are independent,
the v=1 case cannot occur here.

For each actual target-oriented coordinate face A, put
a=|Z intersect A| and b=|W intersect A|. The accepted near-balanced
theorem covers b-a in {0,1,2} with b>=1. In its odd-source row the source
must avoid v and the root mirror; full-hole independence excludes the
root mirror from W, so a legal source exists. All target/omission
conditions are part of the imported theorem, not an endpoint relaxation.

The independently exhaustive normalized census leaves precisely the
following free records after these cuts:

| normalized target | near-balanced residual | after accepted reuse | after final application |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|1|0|0|0|
|7|80622|27|0|
|31|107984|20|0|
|total|188606|47|0|

The first column is the exact remaining set in
`HIGHER_Q5_FULL_residual_h12_v{1,7,31}_free.bin`, not a random sample.

##### Step 3: accepted reuse and the forty-seven final witnesses

The accepted reuse application checks all records against its precise
already accepted marked local registry and multi-source transfer. Its
success witnesses and remaining files partition the input in original
order. The only remaining free records are the 27 and20 above, in
`HIGHER_Q5_FULL_reuse_remaining_h12_v{7,31}_free.bin`.

For EACH of these47 records, the final application supplies both:

- a legal two-source T37 cut whose actual marked (holes,omissions) is
  a common automorphic image of one of the55 accepted full-rank inputs;
- a legal three-source forced-T17 cut whose actual obstruction pair
  excludes the global root, satisfying the accepted generic safe-transfer
  theorem and one of the seven accepted conditional local classifications.

Either route alone suffices. Neither assumes an unrestricted T37 or
ignores a forbidden artificial matching edge. In the T37 route the
local theorem quantifies over every compressed required matching. In
the forced route the accepted completion construction proves that the
ACTUAL compressed matching avoids the forbidden pair. The source sets
exclude the prescribed free target and root mirror as required. Both
routes preserve every original edge and the tag deletion restores exactly
the prescribed Hamilton u--v endpoints. The c=0 branch is covered by
the explicit accepted five-direction import in the transfer theorem.

The final three free residual files are empty, and the application
review verifies exact record sets and witnesses, not merely counts.
Thus every independent free-endpoint geometry has been covered. Together
with Step1 and the reversible normalization this proves the theorem.

##### Scope of closure

The complete twelve-hole FREE-target theorem follows once the final
application and this assembly receive independent PASS. The covered-target
branch remains OPEN; the combined application still leaves215243 covered
geometries. In particular this free-endpoint theorem cannot serve as the
full predecessor theorem required for all fourteen-hole reductions.
Complete twelve/fourteen/sixteen/eighteen-hole P6 layers and full P6 remain
OPEN. Acceptance is relative to explicit literature imports and exact
finite certificates, same-family/provisional and not formal verification.

<details id="proof-twelve-new-forced-proof" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_PROOF.md — Twenty-seven actual single-cherry local classifications</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_PROOF.md)。SHA-256：`8c45729c0d838eae4aeca4938027b9f9ac265dad75b71f3ea7c79c50059a7b00`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_HALL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_HALL_REVIEW.json), [TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_REVIEW.json)。

#### Twenty-seven actual single-cherry local classifications

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate, independent verification pending.

##### Exact conditional local theorem

For each of the27 rows in [TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_summary.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_summary.json), put
H=minority union majority, U=omitted, K=V(Q5) minus H. The row specifies
an included hole h and two covered vertices p,q. For every perfect
matching F of the COMPLETE graph on K, a cycle on exactly V(Q5) minus U
containing F and adding only cube edges exists if and only if pq is not
an edge of F. The statement transports under common cube automorphisms
of all marked data (H,U,h,{p,q}). It does not assert any unlisted input.

All rows have22 covered endpoints. Their types are T28 (2:8 holes,
three majority omissions) or T19 (1:9 holes, four majority omissions).
Every neighbor of h outside U is precisely p or q, and both are in K.
Thus any permitted cycle must contain p--h--q. If F contains pq this
forms an isolated triangle, while the retained graph has29 or28 vertices.
The forbidden pair is therefore a genuine necessary obstruction.

##### Sufficiency by a reduced rank certificate

The certificate supplies512 short forests S. Each covers V(Q5) minus U,
has degree one at K, degree two at H minus U, and no cycle. These forests
have eighteen edges for T28, seventeen for T19. Each consists of eleven
paths, and the h path is exactly p--h--q. Its endpoint matching P(S)
contains pq. Delete that pair to obtain P'(S) on K'=K minus {p,q},
with twenty endpoints.

For any F not containing pq, write Fp=a and Fq=b. The four vertices
p,q,a,b are distinct. Delete pa,qb from F and replace them by ab,
obtaining a perfect matching F' on K'. The labelled graph F+P(S)
is connected if and only if F'+P'(S) is connected: contract its path
a--p--q--b. This equivalence is an exact graph operation, not an
assumption that the compressed matching remains short.

The complete matching-connectivity matrix on K' has GF(2) rank
2^(20/2-1)=512 by Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof, Corollary3.5; the same
general primary-source import is recorded in
[A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md](#proof-a10-orbit3-universal-primary-source) (arXiv1211.1506,
DOI10.1145/3148227). For every claimed geometry the512 supplied reduced
forest pairings and512 supplied arbitrary matching columns give a
full-rank512 submatrix. Thus the selected complete rows span the full
matching-connectivity row space. Every column is nonzero, by cyclically
joining the ten edges of its perfect matching. Some selected P'(S)
is therefore connected with the arbitrary F'. Undo the contraction,
then expand P(S) to S. The result is the required simple cycle.
Common required/forest physical edges cannot occur in a successful
connected pairing union: they would be an isolated labelled two-edge
component; the particular common pair pq was excluded explicitly.

The finite checks of forest legality, the fixed cherry and exact binary
rank are the only computational hypotheses. No generator exhaustiveness,
deficient-rank negative inference or full-Q6 theorem is used.

##### Certificate formats and independent obligations

Each summary row gives its prefix `TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_orbit_XXX`.
There are512 unsigned-byte records in each forest or pairing file:

- `_forests.bin`: 36 bytes per T28 record, 34 per T19 record.
- `_full_pairs.bin`: 22 bytes, the full eleven endpoint pairs.
- `_pairs.bin`: 20 bytes, the ten reduced pairs.
- `_columns.bin`: 20 bytes, arbitrary perfect matchings on K'.
- `_matrix.bin`, `_pivots.bin`, `_combos.bin`: 512 rows of64 bytes,
  little-bit-first; pivots use highest-bit positions and combos select
  original rows by XOR.
- `_config.txt` and `.json`: actual geometry and extraction metadata.

Independent verification must reconstruct every forest and its full
pairing, check exactly the available neighbors of h and its forced
physical cherry, delete pq and compare the reduced pairing, validate
every reduced column, reconstruct all512^2 connectivity bits, and check
rank512. The source full-matrix column indices in metadata explain
construction but need not be trusted; the resulting reduced certificates
stand on their own. Total:13824 forests and7077888 connectivity bits.

The author extraction uses independent columns of an already produced
512-by-1024 matrix and contracts the selected columns. It is merely a
producer; the target theorem does not rely on trusting those original
matrices or their rank metadata.

##### Q6 application boundary

An actual cut may use this local theorem only after checking the marked
geometry, legal sources and the hypotheses of
[HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_TRANSFER.md](#proof-higher-forced-cherry-transfer) / [HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json),
including exclusion of the global root from the actual pair {p,q}.
Original shortness alone does not ensure the compressed F lacks pq;
the accepted safe-completion argument supplies that fact. No actual Q6
coverage count is claimed here. Full twelve-hole/P6 remain OPEN.


</details>

#### Twelve-hole four-type positive registry: actual coverage and greedy certificate scope

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer producer application. Local rank inputs and
this application require their separate independent acceptance. The
148 nonfull searches remain OPEN; none is a negative certificate. No
original profile, summary, search source, old raw input or main ledger
was modified.

##### Exact input and sufficient statement

The input consists of215243 covered-target twelve-hole marked geometries,
in the three frozen HIGHER_Q5_FULL_T37_FORCED_union_remaining_h12_v{1,7,31}
_covered.bin files. The root is0, the odd target v is covered, Z consists
of five other even holes, W of six odd holes, and Z union W is independent.
Each eleven-byte record lists sorted Z then sorted W in original labels.
The earlier reductions/censuses and accepted ten-hole predecessor are
separate source-bound gates; this scan does not itself accept those gates.

For every original short Q6 matching realizing a record, an actual cut
and legal source set is sufficient if its resulting marked B geometry
is a common cube-automorphic image of one of the selected FULL-RANK
candidate local inputs. Required B matching edges may be long or same-
parity; the local theorem must quantify over all such complete-graph
matchings and preserve its marked omissions. No favorable original
matching or unknown mate is selected by the hole-geometry witness.

##### Exact four local types and actual Q6 rows

| Type | Minority/majority holes | Omitted majority | Covered endpoints | Rank needed | Short forest edges | Q6(a,b) rows |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
|T28|2/8|3|22|1024|18|(3,1),(0,4)|
|T19|1/9|4|22|1024|17|(4,1),(0,5)|
|T84|0/8|4|24|2048|16|(5,2),(1,6)|
|T105|0/10|5|22|1024|16|(5,1),(0,6)|

The candidate universal local theorems are defined by explicit minority,
majority and omitted sets in TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_profile.json and the local
rank certificates. The generic matching-connectivity rank upper bound
on n covered endpoints is2^(n/2-1). Legal selected forests have omitted
degree0, included-hole degree2, covered degree1 and no cycles; expanding
a connecting endpoint matching gives the local single cycle. Full rank
on valid complete-graph columns makes their rows span the complete
connectivity row space, and every arbitrary matching column is nonzero
by cyclically linking its oriented edges. These are candidate LOCAL
proofs, not a conclusion from producer full_rank flags alone.

There are380 actual marked local orbits in the source domain. The final
producer summary has232 full-rank and148 nonfull rows. This application
uses only the232 full-rank rows to determine a complete positive union,
then reduces the needed proof registry to111 full-rank rows with the SAME
union. Nonfull and unselected positive rows are not premises of the
selected application theorem. No unrestricted theorem for any of these

##### Transfer proof and legality

For a target-oriented cut A let a=|Z intersect A|, b=|W intersect A|.
Even-consumption rows select s=a+1-b sources from Z intersect A; the table
has b=1 or2, s=3,4 or5. Odd-consumption rows select s=b-a-1 sources from
W intersect A excluding its possible mirror to root0; the table has
a=0 or1 and s=3,4 or5. Since v is covered it is not a source hole.
For odd rows b-s=a+1>=1, so at most one root-mirror exclusion leaves
enough sources. The code explicitly enumerates legal source subsets.

All rows fall within the accepted uniform transfer's ORIGINAL A endpoint
ranges: b<=3 in even consumption, a<=2 in odd consumption. Their completed
A matching has balanced b:b or(a+1):(a+1) holes; here only balanced2 or4
total holes arise. Choose the free even A root and completion matching
exactly as in that accepted proof, including the even-port surplus when
root0 is in B. Covered v remains a valid target even if it is a crossing
port. For zero original crossings use the accepted five-direction theorem.

Every bridge mirror is distinct and internally B-covered: its source is
an original free short mirror, independence excludes another original
hole, and source choice excludes root0. After deleting completion edges,
attaching actual crossings/bridges and adding the endpoint tag, the accepted
construction is a forest. Conflicts occur only at the same-parity mirrors;
their distinct original short mates are opposite-parity pendant endpoints
outside the transferred endpoint set, so suppression cannot create a
cycle. The final B matching has exactly the actual projected minority,
majority and marked mirror omissions encoded in the witness.

Its candidate local theorem supplies a cycle on B minus those mirrors.
Expand all conflict and A paths and delete the tag. Every original required
edge and all Q6 vertices are restored, with the prescribed root/target
endpoints. Artificial completions were deleted, compressed edges expanded,
and the tag removed. All surviving new physical edges are short. Thus
each marked positive-orbit witness is universally sufficient once its
local and application acceptance gates pass.

##### Actual synchronous marked lookup and all positive hit sets

TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_coverage.py imports or executes no profile/search program.
It reads the frozen explicit380-row geometry registry and final summary,
requires completed=requested=380, and verifies the required rank for each
used full-rank row. It independently constructs synchronous marked images
using every coordinate permutation and an anchor translation: a minority
hole when present, otherwise a marked omitted hole. The runtime actual
geometry is normalized by the same rule. Minority,majority and omissions
are always transformed TOGETHER. Omitting the marked set from a lookup
would be invalid and is not done.

For every original record it examines all six actual target-oriented cuts
and every legal source subset for the four type shapes. It projects away
only that cut coordinate and forms the actual B minority, majority and
mirror-omission masks. For EACH positive local orbit hit it retains one
concrete cut/source witness; it does not stop at the first local orbit.
This yields541463 distinct original-record/positive-orbit hits. All232
per-orbit record counts agree exactly with the independently reconstructed
lookup/actual projection sets and the supplied profile counts.

The complete positive hits are stored as28-byte records in
TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_positive_hits.bin: v uint8, original file record index
uint32, local orbit uint16, outer cut uint8, original source-mask uint64,
then actual local minority,majority,omission masks as three uint32 values,
all little-endian. Each original record can have several orbit hits, but
each orbit appears at most once for that record. These full sets, not
producer coverage totals, define the positive union.

##### Greedy sufficient registry and exact remaining domain

Greedy selection repeatedly chooses the positive orbit covering most
currently uncovered ORIGINAL RECORD IDs, breaking ties by smaller index.
It stops when its union equals that of ALL232 positive orbits. The result
contains111 rows, recorded with exact geometry/prefix/rank in
TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_greedy_registry.json. No minimum-cardinality claim is
made. The other121 full-rank rows are producer reserves, not needed by

One chosen-greedy actual witness per covered original record is saved
with the same28-byte format in TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_selected_witnesses.bin.
The output copies every uncovered original eleven-byte record unchanged
and in original order.

##### Open scope and dependency boundary

The dependency DAG is accepted balanced2/4-hole endpoint and uniform

#### 111 marked Q5 local inputs from full-rank forest certificates

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate. Independent review pending.

##### Exact statement

For each index in [TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_greedy_registry.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_greedy_registry.json), take its exact
minority set, majority set and marked omissions U from the corresponding
row of [TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_summary.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_summary.json); put H=minority union majority.
For EVERY perfect matching F of the complete graph on K=V(Q5) minus H,
there exists a simple cycle on exactly V(Q5) minus U containing F, with
every edge outside F a cube edge. Every common cube automorphic image
of (H,U) has the same conclusion. Required edges may be long or join
vertices of the same parity. There are precisely111 claimed marked inputs.

| type | minority/majority holes | omitted majority holes | endpoints | rank | short forest edges | cycle vertices |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|T28|2/8|3|22|1024|18|29|
|T19|1/9|4|22|1024|17|28|
|T84|0/8|4|24|2048|16|28|
|T105|0/10|5|22|1024|16|27|

Only these explicit marked inputs are asserted, not all inputs of any
type. Other successful producer rows and deficient ranks are not imported.
The greedy choice is merely a way to select useful claims; its optimality
or global coverage is not a premise of the local theorem.

##### Uniform proof

Fix a claimed row and write n=|K|, r=2^(n/2-1). Each supplied short forest
S has degree one at every K vertex, degree two at every included hole
H minus U, no omitted vertex and no cycle. It therefore consists of n/2
vertex-disjoint paths covering every retained vertex. Its endpoint
pairing P(S) is a perfect matching of K.

The complete matching-connectivity matrix H_K on all complete-graph
perfect matchings of K has GF(2) rank r by Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof,
Corollary3.5 (arXiv1211.1506, DOI10.1145/3148227). The exact general
primary-source import, without a bipartite restriction, is documented in
[A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md](#proof-a10-orbit3-universal-primary-source) and already used at both n=22
and n=24 in accepted local certificates.

The supplied r forests and r arbitrary matching columns X_j have a
connectivity submatrix of exact binary rank r. Hence the complete rows
H_K[P(S_i),:] span the full row space. For an arbitrary prescribed F its
column is nonzero: orient its n/2 edges as (a_i,b_i), then pair b_i to
a_(i+1) cyclically. This gives a matching connected with F. At least one
selected P(S_i) must therefore also be connected with F.

Expand that endpoint pairing back to its short forest paths. The resulting
graph is a single simple cycle on all retained vertices and contains F.
An original required edge cannot duplicate a forest edge: a common pair
of F and P(S_i) would be an isolated labelled two-edge component of the
matching union, impossible because n>=22 and the union is connected.
All nonrequired physical edges come from S_i and are short. This proves
the claimed local theorem under exactly the finite checks below.

##### Certificate obligations and independence boundary

three decimal digits, and geometry/type as specified in the registry.
All vertex records are unsigned bytes. Every pairing/column record has
n bytes, listing n/2 actual vertex pairs. Each forest record has twice
the short-edge count in the table. All binary matrix records have r/8
bytes, with bit order little-bit-first.

- `_forests.bin`: r short forest records.
- `_pairs.bin`: r endpoint pairing records.
- `_columns.bin`: r arbitrary matching records.
- `_matrix.bin`: r connectivity rows.
- `_pivots.bin` and `_combos.bin`: r rows; pivot j has highest set bit j
  and equals the XOR of matrix rows selected by combo j.
- `_config.txt` and `.json`: exact input and producer metadata.

A checker must validate every short forest edge, vertex degree, omitted
vertex and absence of cycles; independently derive its pairing; validate
all columns; reconstruct every connectivity bit; and check rank over
GF(2). Stored producer ranks alone are not a proof. The selected finite
certificates do not require exhaustion of the forest generator or the
actual Q6 geometry domain.

[TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_LOCAL_MANIFEST.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_NEW_TYPES_LOCAL_MANIFEST.json) binds exactly these111 positive
families and their source registry. The application to the215243 Q6
geometries has a separate proof and acceptance gate. No Q6 coverage count,

##### Conditional local proof supplied by a verified certificate

Vertex0 is an included hole and its only remaining short neighbors are

edge8--16 would close an isolated triangle, so its absence is necessary.
Each selected legal forest has that cherry as an entire component and
its endpoint matching P contains the pair8--16. Removing that pair gives
P' on22 terminals. If F lacks8--16, replace its two edges8--a,16--b by
a--b, giving arbitrary F' on those22 terminals. Contracting the labelled
path a--8--16--b preserves the component count of F+P versus F'+P'.

The generic primary matching-connectivity rank upper bound at22 endpoints
is2^(22/2-1)=1024. Full rank of the supplied1024-row restriction makes

matching column is nonzero by cyclically linking its oriented edges;
some selected P' therefore connects every F'. Undo contraction and
expand P's disjoint short paths. The resulting simple29-cycle contains
every original F edge and adds only short edges. No shared pair can
survive a connected labelled alternating cycle, so no duplicate physical
edge is hidden. This proves sufficiency once the finite positive and
rank data are independently accepted. It uses neither a Q6 theorem nor

##### Exact finite local assertion

##### Complete domain boundary and independent cardinality requirement

Every short edge of K0 joins one of O's11 vertices to one of E's15.
Specifying each odd vertex's unique even partner or an unmatched sentinel

The producer enumerates this domain and separately counts it in another

##### Only positive opening forests are used, never their deficient rank

Two SOURCE forest files are used:

* TWELVE_ROOT_STAR_OPENING_case_00_forests.bin, canonical(q,b,t)=(3,4,7).
* TWELVE_ROOT_STAR_OPENING_case_03_forests.bin, canonical(q,b,t)=(15,1,7).

The source files happened to be selected during rank probes with rank8031,
but THIS FINITE PROOF DOES NOT USE THAT RANK, its closeness to8192, a basis
claim, or exhaustion of legal S. It uses only each chosen S's positive
graph properties and its compatibility with THIS M_A. Unused source
forests, matrices and the forest generator's completeness are irrelevant.

##### Direct compatibility and the bipartite completion lemma

Form L_A as stated. The original matching is short and bipartite. In
the internal-target case,31 is odd and h even; the replacement w odd--h
even is bipartite and legal because w was a hole. In the target-port case
there is no internal replacement. Vertex31 and0 are absent from both
S and L_A, and q,b are uncovered in L_A. Distinct matching edges give
degree at most2 in S+L_A. All graph edges retain LABELS: if an L_A edge
equals an S edge, they form a two-edge cycle and the witness is rejected,
rather than collapsed into one physical edge.

The producer tests cycles by first contracting S's14 paths, then adding
each L_A edge with a14-component DSU. Every union must join distinct
components. A fresh checker may instead insert all actual S and L_A
edges directly into a32-vertex DSU; the acyclicity statement is identical.
No assertion about arbitrary prescribed completed matching is inferred
from a rank probe.

Since acyclic, S+L_A consists of14-m paths, where m=|M_A|. Their endpoint
set is exactly K_open minus V(L_A), with
K_open=Q5 minus {0,q,31,b}. It has14-m even and14-m odd endpoints.
The balance follows because K_open has14 vertices of each parity and
L_A has m opposite-parity pairs. Here14-m is3,4 or5, so several components

internal case (X_A minus {q}) union the other three unit holes S_sources;
in the port case replace original31 port by virtual w first. This identity
does not assume the virtual crossing is short.

**Bipartite path-joining lemma.** For disjoint paths with equally many
even and odd endpoints, a bipartite matching of the endpoints can join
all paths into one cycle when the nondegenerate component count here is
at least3. The numbers of EE-ended and OO-ended paths are equal. If both
are zero, orient all EO paths from E to O and concatenate them cyclically
by O--E edges. Otherwise alternate the EE and OO paths in a cycle using
opposite-color connecting edges, then insert each EO path into a suitable
connector with its orientation chosen accordingly. Each endpoint gets
one connector; connectors join distinct path components. Thus no connector
duplicates a forest edge. Call their matching D.

D is disjoint from L_A's covered vertices and avoids q,b,0,31. It gives
exactly the bipartite completion required by the structured A matching.
The resulting simple30-cycle retains every L_A edge, every D edge, and
q--t. The opening edge lies in S and cannot be in D or L_A because q
is an unmatched port and t was mandatory internally covered. This proves
the existential completion statement from a verified finite witness.
