<details id="proof-twelve-star-maximal-a-reduction" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_REDUCTION.md — A conditional finite route for the six remaining root-star geometries</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_REDUCTION.md)。SHA-256：`9245ab20cd90223e3c2db6690686eb644ea60e3bbb2ffcc31c4f98c27470d49f`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[FOURTEEN_FINAL25_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_FINAL25_REVIEW.json), [TWELVE_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json), [TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_FINITE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_FINITE_REVIEW.json), [TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_REVIEW.json)。

#### A conditional finite route for the six remaining root-star geometries

2026-11-02. ARIS proof-writer candidate. The universal finite A witness
obligation below is OPEN. This file proves a proposed reduction, not Q6.

##### Original domain

Use the accepted235-record residual and its six normalized representatives:
u=0, v=31, W={1,2,4,8,16,32}, and Z one of

1. {39,43,45,51,53};
2. {39,43,45,51,63};
3. {39,43,45,54,63};
4. {39,43,51,60,63};
5. {39,43,53,57,63};
6. {39,43,53,58,63}.

Let A be the face with bit32 zero, B the other face, and J={1,2,4,8,16}.
Identify A with Q5 and write bar(x)=x xor32. The original holes are
{u} union Z union W. Let M be any realizing short26-edge matching and
L=M internal to A. Put T={bar(z):z in Z}. Every t in T is originally
A-covered and cannot be a crossing port, because its actual short mirror
is a B hole. Thus L covers every vertex of T. A's original covered graph
G is Q5 induced on the15 nonzero even vertices and the11 odd nonunit
vertices. The graph G and T depend only on the displayed representative.

Extend L by ADDING short edges of G to any inclusion-maximal matching
L* of G. Original edges are never changed. Necessarily |L*|<=11 and
its unmatched even vertices number15-|L*|>=4. The candidate finite
enumeration must cover every such L* containing all of T, not a sample.

##### The finite positive A obligation

For every inclusion-maximal L* of G covering T, supply:

- q: an unmatched even vertex of G;
- t in T minus {v}, adjacent to q;
- distinct w,b in J, and S=J minus {w,b};
- a legal short forest P on A minus {u,v} with degree one at
  K=A minus {u,q,v,b}, degree two at q,b, no cycle, and edge q-t;
- an accepted B marked input as specified below.

Define L*' by replacing v-h* with w-h* if v is covered by L*, where
h*=L*(v); otherwise put L*'=L*. Require the labelled union P+L*'
to be acyclic. Duplicate required/forest edges count as two-edge cycles.
This positive condition is what must be verified for EVERY enumerated L*.
Neither a deficient rank nor finite random tests establish it.

Let X* be the vertices of G unmatched by L*. Define X*'=X* when v is
covered, and X*'=(X* minus {v}) union {w} otherwise. The path endpoints
of P+L*' are exactly Q*=(X*' minus {q}) union S. Their even/odd counts
are equal: the original unmatched-port surplus is four even vertices,
then q removes one even and S adds three odd vertices. The union has
at least three path components because |X*|>=4 and |Q*|=|X*|+2>=6.

Any bipartite path forest with balanced endpoint counts and at least
three components admits an opposite-parity matching D* of its endpoints
joining all components into one cycle. Indeed orient each even-odd
component consistently and arrange the even-even and odd-odd components
alternately (their numbers are equal), inserting the even-odd components
between them. Pair consecutive exposed ends cyclically. If there are
no same-parity components, orient all components from even to odd and
join cyclically. All added pairs are opposite-parity and join distinct
components, so no two-edge component is created. Hence
C_A=P union L*' union D* is a cycle on A minus {u,v}, with edge q-t.
D* need not be short; every such completion edge will be deleted.

##### Why maximal internal matchings suffice

Let h=M(v) be the ACTUAL target mate. Replace original edge v-h in the
global matching by the auxiliary edge w-h, obtaining F. If h is in A,
its internal part L' is L minus {v-h} plus {w-h}. If h is in B then
h=63, L'=L, and the actual crossing v-h is replaced by a virtual crossing
w-h. This is the only potentially long crossing and will be removed
at the final step. Its endpoints, not its direction, are used in gluing.

In every case L' is a submatching of L*'. If v was already L-covered,
its mate cannot change in an extension. If v was originally unmatched
in A but becomes covered by L*, the artificial edge w-h* is simply a
completion pair; no original edge is asserted there. Thus
D=D* union (L*' minus L') is a matching and C_A=P union L' union D.
Its endpoint domain is exactly Q=(X' minus {q}) union S, where X' is
the actual A crossing-port set after the possible replacement v by w.
All added L*' minus L' edges may be treated as completion edges. This
also handles the case of an originally crossing v that becomes internally
matched only in L*. Therefore a certificate for L* supplies the required
A cycle for its original submatching L without changing the original M.

The chosen t belongs to T minus {v}, so it was internally L-covered
even before maximalization. The chosen q remains an actual even crossing
port. This distinction is essential for the next opening operation.

##### Open the A cycle and form the exact B input

Delete every edge of D AND the short edge q-t from C_A. These edges
are disjoint: D avoids q, and t is covered by L'. A nonempty proper
edge deletion from a single cycle is a path forest. Attach all actual
F crossings, including the possible long w-63 edge, the three new short
bridges s-bar(s) for s in S, and the new short bridge t-bar(t).

At q, deleting q-t makes room for its original crossing. At t, its
original internal required edge remains, and deleting q-t makes room
for t-bar(t). The vertex bar(t) is an original B hole in Z and is now
consumed; it is not a conflict vertex. Each Y={bar(s):s in S} is an
original internally B-covered vertex, not a port or original hole.
The only conflicts are at these three same-parity Y vertices. Their
original short mates are distinct opposite-parity pendant endpoints
outside every transferred endpoint. Suppress these three conflicts as
in the accepted uniform transfer, retaining their expansion paths.

The resulting arbitrary B matching has holes
{32} union (Z minus {bar(t)}) union Y, with precisely Y omitted by the
desired local cycle. This is T17: one minority hole32, seven majority
holes, and three marked majority omissions. The only remaining short
neighbors of32 after omitting Y are p=bar(w), r=bar(b). Both remain
originally internally B-covered and outside the transferred endpoints,
Y and bar(t). This remains true for a virtual w-63 crossing:63 differs
from these weight-two vertices. Their original B edges are unchanged
and short, so the compressed matching cannot contain the same-parity
edge p-r. Thus an accepted exact local classification with obstruction
p-r supplies the B cycle. The finite witness must verify the simultaneous
marked geometry against an ACCEPTED B registry; no unrestricted T17
claim is used.

Expanding yields a cycle on Q6 minus {u,v} containing the whole modified
matching F, with only short physical edges apart from the auxiliary w-h.
Delete w-h, prepend u-w and append h-v to the resulting Hamilton w--h
path. This gives the desired Hamilton u--v path on all64 vertices,
preserving all original M edges and adding only cube edges.

##### Remaining proof obligations

The mathematical reduction requires fresh independent audit, including
the maximalization lift and the covered-source bridge. Its finite premise
still requires exhaustive inclusion-maximal L* enumeration for the six
T sets, with a positive q,t,w,b,P witness for EACH case, and independently
verified B registry transports. Existing force-opening rank8031/7998
files contain useful legal forests, but prove no universal A statement.
A deterministic complete witness cover could suffice even though no
full-rank arbitrary-matching opening theorem has been obtained.

No235-record decrement, complete twelve-hole theorem, or full P6 closure
is asserted by this conditional reduction.


</details>

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[A4_FACTOR_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A4_FACTOR_REVIEW.json), [A4_SINGLE_GEOMETRY_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A4_SINGLE_GEOMETRY_REVIEW.json), [A6_CLOSURE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A6_CLOSURE_REVIEW.json), [EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json), [EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json), [FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.json), [Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json), [Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_HIGHER_HOLE_REDUCTION_REVIEW.json), [SIX_HOLE_COVERED_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/SIX_HOLE_COVERED_REVIEW.json), [SIX_HOLE_FREE_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/SIX_HOLE_FREE_REVIEW.json), [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Z14：收缩目标后的同奇偶双孔面转移

日期：2026-11-01。状态：新证明草稿，待独立审计。完整 P6 未证明。

##### 命题

设 $M$ 为 $Q_6$ 短匹配，孔恰为 $u,z,w,t$，其中 $p(u)=p(z)\ne p(w)=p(t)$。对指定 $p(v)\ne p(u)$，若存在坐标 $i$ 满足

$$v_i\ne z_i,\qquad w_i\ne t_i,$$

则存在包含 $M$ 的 Hamilton $u$—$v$ 路径。不要求 $u$ 和 $v$ 在该坐标的同侧；不要求局部匹配有两个方向。

##### 输入与近完美避孔圈引理

输入为 Fink–Mütze Theorem 8、已证 N10、N8，以及用户提供的五方向论文 Theorem 8 的未覆盖起点分支。五方向输入只用于原短匹配未使用某方向的情况。

**N14。** 若 $m\ge5$，$L\subseteq K(Q_m)$ 恰有两个同奇偶的孔 $a,b$，则存在遍历 $V(Q_m)\setminus\{a\}$ 的圈，包含 $L$，且新增边均短。

证明：对 $L$ 中任意方向 $j$ 的半层，两孔均在其端点集补集。同奇偶的两孔在该补集中有相同第 $j$ 位，所以 $b$ 满足 Theorem 8 相对于禁用点 $a$ 的条件 (H)。该定理给出包含 $L$、避开 $a$ 的圈 $C$。

令 $\epsilon=1$ 若两孔偶，$\epsilon=-1$ 若两孔奇。$L$ 覆盖点的偶点数减奇点数是 $-2\epsilon$，因此 $L$ 中同偶边数减同奇边数为 $-\epsilon$。新增短边不改变后一个差值。任意圈满足“偶点数减奇点数＝同偶边数减同奇边数”，所以 $C$ 不可能仅覆盖 $L$ 的端点。唯一可补进的顶点是 $b$，故 $C$ 恰覆盖除 $a$ 外全部顶点。证毕。这也是 N10 证明步骤 3、4 的独立表述。

##### Z14 证明

平移令 $u=0$，故 $z$ 偶，$w,t,v$ 奇。若 $v$ 是自由点，使用 N8。以下 $v$ 被覆盖，记 $h=M(v)$，并令

$$M^*=(M\setminus\{vh\})\cup\{hu\}.$$

这是完整图匹配，孔为 $v,z,w,t$；唯一非二部边是同偶边 $hu$，唯一可能的长边也是它。

沿命题中的 $i$ 切分，把包含 $v$ 的面记为 $A$。交换 $w,t$ 后可令 $v,w\in A$，$z,t\in B$。令 $C^*$ 为全部跨面匹配边，$X_A,X_B$ 为其端口。跨边可能包含长边 $hu$，以后始终按真实端点转移它。

###### 正跨边分支

因 $A$ 有两个孔，$|X_A|$ 为偶数；若非零，至少为二。在 $X_A$ 上任取完整图完美配对 $D$，令

$$L_A=M_A^*\cup D.$$

这是完整图近完美匹配，孔恰为同奇偶的 $v,w$。由 N14 得到覆盖 $A\setminus\{v\}$ 的圈 $C_A$，包含 $L_A$，新增边短。

删除非空匹配 $D$，得到覆盖 $A\setminus\{v\}$ 的互不相交路径族。每个顶点最多失去一条圈边，不产生孤立点；删除至少一条圈边后不留下圈分量。其端点集恰为 $X_A$。给每个端点接回其真实 $C^*$ 边，得到内部顶点在 $A\setminus\{v\}$、端点为 $X_B$ 的互不相交路径族。把它们分别缩成形式边，得到完整图匹配 $R$。

于是

$$L_B=M_B^*\cup R$$

恰有孔 $z,t$，二者异奇偶。N10 给出自由根 $z$ 到任一面内短邻点 $y$ 的 Hamilton 路径；加回短边 $zy$，得到包含 $L_B$ 的 Hamilton 圈 $C_B$。这里 $y\ne z$ 且 $p(y)=p(t)$，满足 N10；因面有 32 个顶点，该路径不含两端间的边 $zy$。

展开 $C_B$ 中的全部 $R$，得到覆盖 $Q_6\setminus\{v\}$、包含全部 $M^*$ 的圈。所有 A 内点位于互不相交的展开段中，所有 B 点在 $C_B$ 中恰出现一次。删除辅助 $hu$，在端点 $h$ 接回原边 $hv$，得到 Hamilton $u$—$v$ 路径。$M$ 全部恢复，$D,R,hu$ 均已消去或展开，新增边均短。

###### 零跨边分支

若 $C^*=\varnothing$，则 $M_A^*$ 在 $A$ 恰不覆盖两个奇点 $v,w$。它的覆盖点中偶点比奇点多二，所以其同偶边数减同奇边数为一。$M^*$ 全图唯一的非二部边是同偶边 $hu$，因此 $hu$ 必完全位于 $A$。于是原边 $vh$ 也完全位于 $A$，原 $M$ 与 $M^*$ 的跨边集相同，都为空。

因此原短匹配 $M$ 不使用方向 $i$，至多使用五个方向。直接用五方向论文的未覆盖根端点定理，得到所需路径。这一步没有把原匹配扩展到含长边的输入，也没有假设完整 P6。

两分支覆盖全部情况。证毕。

##### 推论及范围

用整数编码写，Z14 的几何条件为

$$((v\mathbin{\mathrm{xor}}z)\mathbin{\mathrm{and}}(w\mathbin{\mathrm{xor}}t))\ne0.$$

特别地，若 $w,t$ 在六个坐标全部不同，则任何奇 $v$ 不可能等于偶 $z$，故存在所需坐标。这关闭“两个异于根奇偶的孔互为对跖点”的整个四孔匹配族的全部目标。

若 $d(w,t)=4$，不满足该条件的奇目标只有两个；若 $d(w,t)=2$，只有八个。这些计数仅描述该充分条件的例外顶点，不能称为完整 P6 剩余数；其他引理可能继续覆盖它们。未证明其余四孔及六孔以上。


</details>

<summary>UNBALANCED_CORE_THEOREM.md — Z7：孔{0,3,13,49}的完整匹配族，一半坐标侧的全部指定终点</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/UNBALANCED_CORE_THEOREM.md)。SHA-256：`8c6b4d6a99021b979d810f0f0dec2599f4c4c2fc06ceb2084348b469d4b4d5c7`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Z7：孔{0,3,13,49}的完整匹配族，一半坐标侧的全部指定终点

日期：2026-11-01。状态：局部证明，独立审读记录见GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.md。完整P6仍开放。

##### 目标与范围

对每个Q6短边匹配M，若其孔恰为{0,3,13,49}，则对每个奇顶点v满足最低位v_0=1，存在包含M的Hamilton 0—v路径。

这包含此前明确记录的全称义务v=61。量词涵盖全部具有该孔配置的匹配，而非仅保存的一个样例。最低位为0的已覆盖奇终点不在本命题范围内。

##### 两个终点的半层排除引理 E1

设m≥5，P为B(Q_m)的完美匹配。三个不同顶点c,d,e满足c与d,e异奇偶，且P中接触c,d,e的边均为短边，并有cd,ce∉P。设

`J={j : d_j=e_j≠c_j}`。

若在(c,d)、(c,e)处压缩P都产生半层，则P(c)=c⊕e_j，其中j∈J。因此若P(c)的方向不在J，至少一对端点的压缩不含半层，GNS端点定理给出相应的Hamilton路径。

证明：设第一压缩含方向j半层H。P至少含H中除新增伙伴边外的2^(m−2)−1≥7条j方向短边。若第二压缩含方向k半层，Z0说明所有不接触c,e的P短边只能沿k；上述至少7条j边中至多2条接触c,e，故k=j。方向j恰有两个半层，其端点集互为补集；c被两次压缩删除，所以两个半层只能是同一个H。

记S为H端点集、T为其补集，则c,d,e∈T。在第二压缩的Z0结论中，P中接触d的短边没有接触c,e：cd∉P，且d,e同奇偶而P二部。因此P(d)=d⊕e_j∈T。第一压缩新加的P(c)P(d)不可能属于H，故H原已完整包含于P。于是P(c)∈T；cP(c)为短边，T内短边只沿j，所以P(c)=c⊕e_j。最后c与d,e异奇偶且均在T，要求其第j位分别相反，即j∈J。证毕。

##### Z7证明

沿第0位切分，A为偶数编码顶点，B为奇数编码顶点（这是编码最低位，不是顶点奇偶性）。孔0在A，孔z=3,w=13,t=49在B。

令c=2、d=12、e=48，分别是3、13、49沿第0位的A内邻点。它们均被M_A覆盖：它们不是孔，跨层伙伴却是孔，不能被M跨边覆盖。c为奇顶点，d,e为偶顶点。距离d(c,d)=d(c,e)=3，所以cd,ce∉M_A。

令X_A为原跨边端口，在X_A∪{0}上任取二部完美配对D，得P_A=M_A∪D。该配对存在，因为这恰是二部匹配M_A在A内未覆盖的集合。P_A在c,d,e处的匹配边就是原M_A短边，且cd,ce∉P_A。

以A的五个坐标{1,2,3,4,5}计，E1中的J只有坐标1：c=2只在坐标1为1，而d=12和e=48的支撑分别为{2,3}、{4,5}，没有共同的1位。P_A(c)不等于0，因为c由M_A覆盖而0为原孔。因此P_A(c)的方向不是1。

由E1，P_A至少有Hamilton c—d或c—e延拓。选中哪一个，就把对应的B孔13或49作为Z6中的t，另一奇孔作为w。对任意在B中且已被M覆盖的奇顶点v，Z6（UNBALANCED_TRANSFER.md）与N10给出Hamilton 0—v延拓。

若v为自由奇孔13或49，则使用已证N8四孔自由端点定理（BIPARTITE_NEAR_PERFECT.md）。因此命题所列全部v成立。证毕。

##### 依赖与未解范围

输入依赖：Z0半层刚性、GNS二部完美匹配端点定理、N10、Z6、自由端点分支N8。没有假设完整P6，也没有用有限样例代替全称证明。

本命题关闭UNBALANCED_FOUR_HOLE_CORE.md中根0、目标61的特定全称匹配族；不关闭其他孔配置，也不关闭本孔配置中最低位0的全部已覆盖目标，更不关闭六孔及更多孔。


</details>


<details id="proof-unbalanced-transfer" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>UNBALANCED_TRANSFER.md — Z6：一孔/三孔切分到完整图近完美匹配</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/UNBALANCED_TRANSFER.md)。SHA-256：`81e0355e3dd647442ba38ea7e0aa48bb0eb36960c8cbd5ac9e0cbdf1c9c588e7`。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：[GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.json)。

#### Z6：一孔/三孔切分到完整图近完美匹配

日期：2026-11-01。状态：局部证明，独立审读记录见GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.md。完整P6仍开放。

##### 命题与假设

设n≥6，M为Q_n短边匹配，恰不覆盖u,z,w,t，其中u,z偶，w,t奇。沿方向i切分成A,B两个Q_(n−1)，u∈A而z,w,t及指定目标v∈B；v奇且被M覆盖。

记C为M的跨层边，X_A,X_B为其端口；c=z⊕e_i、d=t⊕e_i。设存在A内二部配对D，恰覆盖X_A∪{u}，使完美匹配P_A=M_A∪D具有包含P_A的Hamilton c—d路径K_A，且K_A\P_A全部为A内短边。

则M具有Hamilton u—v延拓。

D存在作为二部配对不成问题：M_A为二部匹配，A内未覆盖点为X_A∪{u}，故该集合奇偶平衡。额外路径K_A的存在须另证，不能视为自动。c由M_A覆盖：c奇、u偶，故c不是A唯一的原孔u，其跨层伙伴z是孔，故也不能是跨端口。若d≠u，同理d由M_A覆盖；d=u的边界在以下单独处理。

##### 证明

1. 以c（奇）到d（偶）的顺序定向K_A。因P_A为完美二部匹配，其匹配边全部沿奇→偶出现。删除D中全部边，得到覆盖A的顶点不交路径族。若d≠u，D不接触c,d，故没有孤立顶点，端点集恰为X_A∪{u,c,d}。若d=u，路径末边属于D，删除后u成为唯一孤立顶点；其他非平凡分段的端点集恰为X_A∪{c}。

2. 在每个X_A端点接回其C跨边，并加入短跨边cz、dt。得到内部顶点全在A的互不相交路径族，端点集恰为X_B∪{u,z,t}。特别地，d=u时短边dt=ut将孤立顶点u接成路径J=u—t。

3. 设包含u的路径为J，另一个端点为q。证明q≠v：若d=u，已知q=t。若d≠u，D中接触u的边沿a→u出现，其中a奇、u偶，故u所在分段是该删除边之后的分段。若分段在下一条D边之前结束，则结束端点为奇点，其跨层伙伴q偶。若之后没有D边，则结束于d，转移后q=t。分段不含起点c，所以q≠z。因此q∈X_B且偶，或q=t。v奇且被M覆盖，所以两种情况下均q≠v。

4. 将J以外各条转移路径缩成形式边，得到K(B)中的匹配R，恰覆盖(X_B∪{z,t})\{q}。这些形式边可能同奇偶，不能直接调用二部版本N9。

   L_B=M_B∪R是K(B)匹配，恰不覆盖q,w：M_B恰不覆盖X_B∪{z,w,t}，两部分的覆盖点不交。孔q可以偶也可以奇，但目标v始终与另一孔w同奇偶，且v≠q。

5. 层维数n−1≥5，由GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT.md的N10，L_B具有Hamilton q—v延拓K_B。展开R的每条形式边，再在起点q前接入J（从u到q），得到所需u—v路径。

6. K_B原先各B顶点出现一次；展开各R及添加J恢复全部A顶点，各段A内点集合互不相交。所有M_A边在这些分段中保留，所有跨边C在步骤2恢复，所有M_B边在K_B中保留。D已全部删除，R已全部展开，其他新增边均为两层内部短边或cz、dt。因此得到包含M的Hamilton u—v路径。证毕。

##### 剩余义务

K_A的存在是唯一额外结构前提。可用GNS完整二部图端点定理：需cd∉P_A，且端点c,d处压缩后无半层。充分条件为cd∉M_A，且M_A中避开c,d的短边至少使用两个方向；Z0随后排除半层。

本命题尚未证明每个四孔匹配都存在这样的一孔/三孔切分，也未证明每个该类切分都能选出合适D和孔t。


</details>

#### Independent final audit of complete P6

explicit imports below. The served backend model is not independently attested.

**PASS: complete P6 is proved relative to the explicit accepted imports.**
All nine complete layers and the root-preserving range reduction are accepted.
There are zero remaining predecessor conditions or hole levels.

##### Exact quantified obligation

For every matching M in the short-edge graph Q6, every u outside V(M), and
every v of opposite Hamming parity, a Hamilton u-v path containing M exists.
There is no condition that v be free. The intermediate use of arbitrary
complete-graph matching edges in local imported proofs does not enlarge the
original matching domain or permit long physical edges in the final path.
If M is perfect there is no eligible u, so that case is vacuous. Empty and
all smaller matchings are within the reduction's quantifier scope.

##### Independent semantic check of the final implication

Fix an eligible triple (M,u,v). Every edge of M lies in Q6-u. Add cube edges
whose endpoints are both free until an inclusion-maximal matching L in Q6-u
is reached. Termination follows from strict increase of its cardinality in
a finite graph. Every intermediate matching contains M and leaves u free.
The construction makes no restriction on v; in particular it can cover v.

There are two exhaustive cases. If every neighbor of u is covered by L,
no edge can be added in full Q6: edges away from u are excluded by deleted-
root maximality, and edges at u are excluded by the covered other endpoint.
Thus the explicit full-cube maximal-matching theorem gives |L|>=24.
Otherwise select a free cube neighbor a of u. The matching L+ua is maximal
in full Q6. An edge with both endpoints still free could touch neither u
nor a and would contradict maximality of L in Q6-u. Hence |L|+1>=24 and
|L|>=23. The temporary ua is discarded; it is never an added requirement
on the Hamilton path. The upper bound |L|<=31 follows from the free root.

Therefore L has exactly one of 2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18 holes. Apply the
corresponding complete endpoint theorem with this same u and v. The layer
has the correct exact cardinality, its required edges are cube edges, its
root is free, and its target is of opposite parity. Its covered-target
scope is essential when augmentation has covered v. The resulting path
contains L and therefore M. Its endpoints remain the prescribed u,v.
This implication contains no induction assumption or hidden uniform choice
of an auxiliary witness. The chosen L and subsequent local witnesses can
depend on M,u,v.

#### 新增六方向圈推论核对记录

日期：2026-11-02。子任务：`/root/p6_report_corollary_audit`。作用范围仅为 [SIX_DIRECTION_CYCLE_COROLLARIES.md](#proof-six-direction-cycle-corollaries) 的新增推导与适用边界。

**结果：PASS，条件为明确导入已接受的 P6 与所列文献结果；保证等级 same-family/provisional。** 零开放 FATAL/CRITICAL/MAJOR 事项。这里的 PASS 不将语义保证提升为跨家族终审。

##### 身份与独立性

本任务独立于父任务的总报告主写作者，直接阅读本地论文和 P6 的精确命题后核对新推论。但推论说明与本记录均由本子任务撰写，没有独立于本说明作者的第二次盲审，也没有另起一个更强模型审核；不得把它写成 fresh independent review of own proof。配置沿父任务授权的 GPT-6.1-sol/high；服务端实际模型未独立认证。

##### 输入审查与散列

已读取 [paper.txt](research/six_directions/paper.txt) 的首页、Theorem 1/4/5、Conjecture 2、Theorem 5 全部证明、Observation 14、Theorem 7 与 Conjecture 5。来源内容足以直接核验，而不是仅凭引用编号推断。

已读取 [P6_FULL_CLOSURE.md](#proof-p6-full-closure)、[P6_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/P6_FULL_REVIEW.json)、[P6_FULL_REVIEW.md](#review-p6-full-review) 和 [P6_RELEASE_CHECK.json](research/six_directions/P6_RELEASE_CHECK.json)。重新计算 P6_FULL_REVIEW 三类顶层绑定映射、报告绑定及 release 的三项绑定，共 27 次比较，全部一致。计数包含不同映射中的重复目标，不代表 27 个不同文件；不代表重新核验全审所报的 5155 个传递绑定或执行大型证书。

具体输入散列见 JSON。没有改写既有证明、冻结证书、审查报告或账本。

##### 逐项证明义务

|编号|义务|核对结果|
|---|---|---|
|O1|完美匹配没有自由点时仍有 C6 证明|另用 Fink 完美匹配定理，n=6≥2|
|O2|非完美匹配满足 P6|取自由 u、任意 cube 邻点 v；对目标不强加自由性|
|O3|闭合边 uv 不已在路径中|64 顶点简单路径两端之间的边不可能是路径边；否则整条路只有一条边|
|O4|P6 与维数六 Conj2 的量词相同|均为 short M、自由根、任意异奇偶目标，包括已覆盖目标|
|O5|坐标置换没有损失|图自同构且可逆；保留匹配、覆盖、奇偶、Hamilton 性质|
|O6|少于六个方向时仍可作六维纤维分解|把实际方向集合补成恰六个坐标；所有 M 边留在纤维内|
|O7|各纤维 Hamilton 圈都存在|直接应用 C6，允许局部匹配完美、空或非完美|
|O8|可删除一条非匹配圈边|圈在 u_i 处度为 2，匹配在该点度≤1|
|O9|首纤维最终端点奇偶性满足 P6|k=2^(n−6) 偶；k−1 次内部边使右部奇偶反转；跨纤维边右部不变|
|O10|首纤维 P6 的自由端点参数正确|自由的是 v1，故用 (根 v1, 目标 u1)，无向路可倒读|
|O11|拼接确实是单个 spanning 简单圈|各纤维路径顶点不交，按循环次序逐条连接，覆盖全部纤维|
|O12|n=7 商图 Q1 退化情形|用两个商点的循环次序；两条实际跨纤维边不同，因为 u1≠v1|
|O13|低维 2≤n≤5|实际方向数≤n≤5，满足既有 Theorem 4|
|O14|RS 推论未越界|仅全维数 n≤6，或任意 n 的≤6方向限制|
|O15|未将 P6 当作 Conj5|明确不推出 Theorem7 所需的两个已覆盖端点及两条路径性质|

以上均为有限图命题，无极限、概率模态、积分交换或渐近常数事项。没有含糊的“对足够大 n”，完整范围明确为 n≥2。

##### 反例与退化情形尝试

1. **完美 M：** P6 前提为空；若只用自由点法则证明不完整。已分支使用 Fink 定理。
2. **空 M：** 任取自由点，首纤维仍自由；不需要假设方向非空，坐标集合可补足。
3. **31 条边、仅两个洞：** 邻点目标可能被覆盖，P6 精确量词允许，闭合证明成立。
4. **首目标 u1 已覆盖：** 由 P6 允许 covered targets 直接覆盖；没有暗中缩成双自由端点。
5. **局部 M_i 完美：** 在 C_i 任一顶点仍有一条非匹配边可删，无需在该纤维找自由点。
6. **n=7：** 商图 Q1 无通常简单 Hamilton 圈，原文循环记号易误读。新增说明明确改用两纤维循环次序，并证明两条真实跨边不同。这是补足解释，而不是声称原 Theorem5 假。
7. **k 奇数：** 若任意取奇数个纤维，最后奇偶可能失败；实际 k=2^m 且 m≥1，始终偶数，排除此候选。
8. **n=1：** Q1 没有简单 Hamilton 圈；结论严格从 n≥2 开始，未纳入该反例。
9. **n>6 且用七个方向：** 不满足 D6/U6 假设，不得当作已解决的完整 RS。
10. **任意两个已覆盖端点：** P6 无此覆盖范围，不得代替 Conj5。未找到本文实际声明范围内的反例；反例搜索不是证明替代品。

##### 范围及来源陷阱

本地论文标题含 five directions，与新推导的 six directions 不是同一项原文公开定理。作者是 Fink–Hotmar；Wang–Wang 是其引用的有大小限制的旧定理作者。来源编号固定为 arXiv:2501.19029v1；不能混入后来版本的标题、作者或编号，也不把所读 v1 的历史开放性视作今天的文献现状。

新增结论导入 P6、Fink 完美匹配定理与五方向 Theorem4。不重证这些输入，不认证新颖性，不认证发表/同行审查，不证明任意维数全部 RS，不证明任意端点六方向路径完整分类，不证明任意完全图原匹配版本。


</details>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`42355a053202a2b23786db1eddcdd4adf3bb5298c8508d31cb2fb9c24daf1677`。

#### A10 first marked orbit: independent proof review

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer: `/root/a10_first_orbit_audit`.
User-requested setting: GPT-6.1-sol, high; ARIS proof-checker.
`review_independence: same-family`; `acceptance_status: provisional`.

##### Verdict and exact scope

**PASS, relative to the declared certified Q4 inputs.** No missing mathematical
assumption or open proof obligation was found in the stated first-orbit theorem.
For every matching of the complete graph on Q5 with holes exactly
`{0,3,5,6,8,15,16,23,25,26}`, a simple cycle on exactly Q5 minus 0 contains
the matching and uses only short additional edges. Required edges may be long
or join vertices of the same parity. Coordinate permutations prove exactly
the stated orbit of 30 marked normalized geometries.

This review proves neither full A10 nor Q6 P6. No full Q5 A8 theorem is an
input. Its contemporaneous audit is unnecessary here. No production source,
producer output, or main progress state was changed. Provisional denotes the
same-family assurance level, not an unclosed branch of this scoped argument.

##### Assumptions and dependency ledger

The acyclic dependency graph is:
Q4 GQ4-avoid + Q4 T15 exact classification -> the two-bridge sufficient rule
-> failure constraints for six choices -> two closed eight-sets -> impossible
odd covered intersection -> first marked orbit, then coordinate transport.

The Q4 statements were read directly in [Q4_GENERAL_AUGMENTATION.md](#proof-q4-general-augmentation) and
[Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION.md](#proof-q4-t15-classification). Their audited bridge use and prior certification
were inspected in `A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW.md/.json` and
`Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW.md/.json`. This is a relative review of these
imports, not a rerun of all transitive Q4 certificates. No A8 global closure,
Q5 A10 theorem, or P6 conclusion occurs in the dependency graph.

The complete quantified claim is: for every matching F with precisely H as
its uncovered set, there exists a simple 31-cycle K with vertex set V-H0,
where H0={0}, F subset E(K), and every edge of E(K)-F has Hamming distance
one. For each coordinate permutation the same quantifiers hold with the
transported H and unchanged forbidden vertex 0. There is no restriction on
the crossing count, on the parity of required-edge endpoints, or on whether
a selected bridge mirror is a crossing port.

Symbols are consistent: F_A,F_B,C partition F; X_A,X_B are endpoint sets of
C; T is a set of A vertices; P,J,D,Q are matchings on T with D perfect;
L is the compressed matching on B. Here Q is the endpoint matching called S
in earlier bridge material. A terminal means the B endpoint of a component
meeting T, with its unique T root; unrelated F_B endpoints are not such
terminals. All contracted cycle statements use labelled multigraph edges.

| Obligation | Discharge |
|---|---|
| Exact input, arbitrary required edges | Claim and hypothesis use only matching and exact H; no later step tests required-edge length |
| Bridge legality | A endpoints t,s are distinct original holes; tw,sz are new short mirror edges, not presumed original C edges |
| Crossing count and T | 2|F_A|+c=10, so c even, 0<=c<=10; T has c+2 distinct vertices and 1<=d<=6 |
| G is a path forest | Every T vertex has degree one; only selected mirrors can have degree two in B, and each leads to an A leaf |
| Unique roots and endpoint pairing | Each T--T component contributes a disjoint P edge; each other T component has one distinct B terminal/root |
| Root prescription is a matching | Roots of p,q, when both exist, are distinct and unused by P |
| Strict J subset D | With r=2d-2|P| even, an outside terminal gives r>=2 for e=0 and r>=4 for e=1, hence d>|P|+e |
| GQ4-avoid hypotheses | F_A+D has exactly three majority holes and one minority hole; 0 remains an uncovered majority vertex |
| Removing D leaves paths | D is a nonempty matching in the 15-cycle; endpoint set is exactly T, giving Q and a single alternating Q+D cycle |
| No premature cycle | Any proper subset J of labelled D breaks that alternating cycle; Q+J and Q+P are forests |
| Compression produces a matching | All A minus 0 and selected mirrors are path interiors; endpoints are precisely covered B nonmirrors |
| Compressed obstruction excluded | Single-edge F_B components excluded by pq notin F_B; two rooted terminals excluded by adding their root edge to J |
| T15 hypotheses | L holes are original singleton a and five opposite-parity holes; avoided mirrors are two neighbors and remaining neighbors p,q are not paired in L |
| Expansion | Disjoint interiors restored once; all F_A,F_B,C survive, D disappears, all other added edges are short |
| Six-choice quantifiers | At least four nonfixed choices; each candidate lies in at least two of them, including the two-disjoint-fixed-edge case |
| Closure and contradiction | Both covered eight-sets are invariant under the original mate involution; their five-point covered intersection must have even size, contradiction |
| Orbit transfer | All 120 coordinate permutations yield exactly 30 marked images, fixing 0 and preserving required edges, shortness, and simplicity |

There are no asymptotic constants, analytic interchanges, probability-mode
changes, or limit orders in this finite proof.

##### Independent reconstruction of the decisive steps

At lines 94--108, let r be the number of rooted terminals. Their count is
even because r=|T|-2|P|. If p,q are both rooted terminals and there is
another terminal, r>=3 and hence r>=4. Otherwise the one outside terminal
already forces r>=2. Thus in both cases r>2e, where e records whether the
extra root edge was prescribed. Consequently J extends to D with at least
one D edge outside J. Equality |J|=d is never used as a successful case.

Deleting D from K produces paths, including any length-one paths. Their
endpoint matching Q and D make a single alternating multigraph cycle.
Restoring a proper subset of the D edges cannot form a cycle. This includes
d=1: coincident Q and D endpoint pairs are two labelled parallel edges;
retaining both would be a two-edge cycle. This convention also handles a
root prescription whose endpoints are already joined by a Q edge.

In the attached graph, a closed component would contract to a cycle of
Q+P, excluded by Q+J being a forest. Original B--B components not meeting
T are single original F_B edges: any longer path would need an internal
selected mirror, whose bridge leads to an A leaf. Thus p,q can become a
compressed pair only through their original edge, explicitly excluded, or
through their distinct rooted components. The second alternative would
join their roots in Q+P and form a cycle upon adding the prescribed root
edge in J. This excludes precisely the T15 obstruction, including long
compressed edges. Expansion preserves every original crossing edge even
when its A endpoint is unrelated to a mirror endpoint.

At lines 138--175 the global no-cycle hypothesis applies to *every* bridge
pair. For a nonfixed pair, a crossing port outside M is a rooted terminal
outside {p,q}; an internal partner outside M of a selected mirror is also
such a terminal. Therefore the port restriction follows from any one
nonfixed pair and the internal-partner restriction follows separately for
each candidate selected in a nonfixed pair. For a fixed candidate x, the
three complementary obstruction edges lie on the other three candidates,
so at most one belongs to F_B. At least two nonfixed choices select x.
This proves the needed coverage even if F_B contains two disjoint edges
inside M; it never assumes at most one fixed obstruction overall.

Every covered vertex of B outside M consequently has its mate in that
same set: it cannot cross, and cannot pair to M. Apply this to both cuts:

| Cut | Candidate neighbors M | Closed covered set |
|---|---|---|
| b=8, singleton 15 | 11,13,14,31 | 9,10,12,24,27,28,29,30 |
| b=16, singleton 23 | 19,21,22,31 | 17,18,20,24,27,28,29,30 |

Their intersection is {24,27,28,29,30}. It contains no hole. If both sets
are closed under the original matching, so is the intersection. The mate
map on it is a fixed-point-free involution, which partitions it into pairs.
Five vertices cannot admit that partition. This is an analytic contradiction
for every original F, not an inference from unsuccessful Hamilton search.

##### Independent finite checks and adversarial pass

[A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/A10_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW_check.py) is a separate implementation that does not
import or run the producer checker. It reads the frozen JSON only for
comparison and verifies that the producer's recorded checker hash matches
the actual source. It checks both cuts, hole parities, all six bridge/OB
complements, the eight-sets, their five-point covered intersection, and the

#### A10 second marked orbit: independent proof and certificate review

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer: `/root/a10_first_orbit_audit`, a fresh independent

##### Scope and verdict

The quantified theorem is: for every complete-graph matching F on the 32 Q5

vertex set exactly `{1,...,31}` containing every edge of F; every edge of
that cycle outside F has Hamming distance one. Required edges are arbitrary,

##### Dependency and hypothesis accounting

C closed -> exact C/D matching domain -> coordinate/stabilizer quotient ->

The imported Q4 statements were inspected directly and their use was checked

components meeting T, not endpoints of unrelated internal F_B edges.

##### Analytic adversarial review

Steps 1--3 use the same general sufficient bridge rule as the first-orbit
proof, with independently checked new geometry. The bridge mirrors need not
be internal: a mirror that is an original crossing port produces a valid
T--T path. A mirror's original partner is never assumed to be its mirror.
Long crossings and long internal required edges do not affect the degree
or component arguments.

For strictness, if both obstruction endpoints p,q are rooted terminals,
their roots are distinct and unused by P. A terminal outside {p,q} forces
at least three terminal roots, hence at least four by parity. Otherwise at
least one terminal forces at least two. Thus the prescribed root edge, if
present, still leaves J a proper subset of D_port. Equality is not accepted
as a successful case. The contracted objects must be multigraphs: coincident
Q and D_port edges are separately labelled, including a two-edge cycle
when d=1. A proper subset breaks even that cycle.

An unrelated B--B component of G is a single original F_B edge. A longer
one would pass through a selected mirror, whose bridge leads to an A leaf.
If pq is compressed from two rooted components, their root-to-root path
in Q+P together with the extra edge of J would form a cycle in Q+J. This
excludes the only T15 obstruction before applying that theorem. Compression
and expansion restore all A vertices except 0 and both selected mirrors
exactly once; artificial pairing and compressed edges do not survive as
new long edges in the final cycle.

Under global nonexistence, every nonfixed bridge pair obeys the failure
constraints. A matching on the four candidates can contain two disjoint
fixed obstruction edges, but for any particular candidate x the three
bridge pairs selecting x have complementary edges on the other three
vertices. At most one of those three edges is fixed. Hence every x is
selected in a nonfixed pair. Ports outside M are forbidden by any nonfixed
pair, and internal partners of each x outside M are forbidden by a pair
selecting x. Therefore every other covered B vertex is internally matched
outside M. That set is exactly C={16,17,18,20,24,27,29,30}.

Consequently nonclosed C already gives the desired global cycle by
contraposition. Closed C is exactly the union-of-two-perfect-matchings
domain, not an extra unproved assumption imposed on all F. Its size is
105*135135=14,189,175. The independent positive certificates address all
orbits of this exceptional domain.

The template failures in the final explanatory section are also correct.
For bit 8, each of the four possible three-mirror choices leaves the free
singleton 15 with one available short face neighbor. For bits 1,2,4 the
specified triples similarly leave the original holes 25,26,28 with one
neighbor. A free cycle vertex needs two distinct incident new short edges.
This rules out only those templates and does not rule out the original
global theorem. In particular no T63 input is inferred from a T17 pattern.

##### Independent canonical-domain reconstruction

It generates every perfect matching using an explicit stack of partial

For each C representative its stabilizer G_C is independently found. The
checker takes *every* D matching, computes its least image under G_C, and
forms the exact set of all those minima. It orders that set by the stated
matching enumeration order and reconstructs the actual 22-byte records.
Every reconstructed block is compared with the corresponding frozen bytes;

All 23 blocks agree. Their C-stabilizer sizes are 1,2,3,6 and their D

`f75459b8203101f4001f34855c80cff46a53cb63ccaff6666b87fb90215129c9`.
Per-block counts and weighted counts independently agree with the producer

maps are (105,135135), three copies of (9,375), and two copies of (3,27).
Burnside yields 2,366,577; the full-orbit weighted count is 14,189,175.

The producer source was inspected: its least-unpaired-vertex recursion,

and binary pair order implement precisely the stated quotient. Independence

#### Final A10 orbit: independent universal-proof review

2026-11-01. Reviewer `/root/a10_final_rank_review`; user-selected
`gpt-6.1-sol / high`. ARIS proof-checker; **same-family / provisional**.

**PASS, relative to the explicit published matching-connectivity rank
theorem.** Every arbitrary eleven-edge matching whose uncovered set is
H={0,1,2,4,8,15,23,27,29,30} has a simple cycle on exactly Q5−0 containing
the matching, with all other edges short. The five coordinate images pass.

of original matching inputs is a premise of this acceptance.

##### Primary import and exact domain

I independently opened the [author repository manuscript](https://pure.tue.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/99596886/1211.1506.pdf)
and checked its abstract/introduction (PDF pages 1,3), Theorem 3.4 and
Corollary 3.5 (PDF page 9). The repository cover identifies the publication
as Cygan–Kratsch–Nederlof, JACM 65(3), Article 12 (2018),
[DOI 10.1145/3148227](https://doi.org/10.1145/3148227).

The full matrix indexes every perfect matching of the complete graph on
an even number t of labelled vertices; it does not impose bipartiteness,
parity or cube adjacency. The displayed corollary gives GF(2) rank
2^(t/2−1). Its proof explicitly factors the full matrix through 2^(t/2−1)
columns. For t=22 this supplies exactly the upper bound 1024 needed here.
Relabelling the covered vertex set by 0,...,21 preserves the matrix.
The separate real-rank result for a bipartite restriction mentioned in
the introduction is not the imported result. Online text extraction
confirmed the displayed formula; the screenshot request returned a cache
error and was not used as evidence. This is a declared theorem import,
not a claim to have newly proved its technical appendix.

##### Independent deterministic checks

New [A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_REVIEW_check.py) imports or executes no producer
code. It independently checks all 1024 selected forests: twenty distinct
short edges, no vertex 0, degree one at each of the 22 covered vertices,
degree two at each of the nine included holes, acyclicity by DSU, and
eleven components each with exactly two endpoints. Component endpoint
pairings equal their stored matching records. Every selected record also
matches its indexed source record. Each of the 1024 columns is a valid
perfect matching on the exact covered set.

All 1,048,576 matching-connectivity bits are recomputed by unioning both
matchings in DSU and counting components, independently of the producer's
alternating-walk routine. Every bit equals the saved matrix; it contains
158674 ones. Column-first Gaussian elimination using Python integers,
row swaps and elimination below each lowest-column pivot gives exact
GF(2) rank 1024. The producer's saved pivots, combinations, basis
construction and elimination implementation are not used for this rank.
All manifest byte counts and SHA256 values pass, as do all hashes in
the spectrum FROZEN file. The latter binds context without accepting its
full-spectrum exhaustion claim. New evidence and input hashes are pinned
in the adjacent review JSON.

| U02 | Each selected positive witness is an admissible short forest and compresses to its recorded row matching; independently checked for all 1024. | PASS |

DAG: imported rank upper bound + valid 1024 forests/columns + independently
full-rank restriction -> complete-row spanning -> nonzero at every F column

I specifically tested the possible failure modes of a disconnected

<summary>A4_FACTOR_REVIEW.md — Independent audit of the A4 spanning cycle-factor lemma</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/A4_FACTOR_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`4ccedd316c14d5249e659e17ae7953e6f30e4502b1d121edd05d6310bd8abbba`。

#### Independent audit of the A4 spanning cycle-factor lemma

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer: GPT-6.1sol, high (explicit user setting).
Review independence: same-family. Semantic acceptance: provisional.

**Verdict: PASS for the cycle-factor claim and CF1, relative to imported N14.**
The deterministic GF5 check is independently reproduced. No open fatal,
critical, major, or minor issue was found in the factor reduction. This audit
does not prove connectedness, A4 Hamiltonicity, or full P6. The introductory
"independent review pending" in the hashed input is superseded by this report.

##### Input and exact statement

Primary input: [A4_SPANNING_FACTOR.md](#proof-a4-spanning-factor), SHA256
`08b78af7f4388089c6e3329b2f95dc3d538551447af17aa97baf9fa85207edc9`.

For every matching F of the complete graph on V(Q5), whose four uncovered
vertices have parity split 1+3, and for every choice v among the three
majority-parity holes, there exists a simple 2-regular spanning graph on
V(Q5) minus v containing F, with every added edge a cube edge.
F has 14 edges. Arbitrary long and same-parity edges of F are permitted.

N14 is an explicit imported theorem for the adjacent branch. Its local
statement and application were checked in [TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md](#proof-two-odd-holes-transfer); this
audit does not independently re-prove the external Fink–Mütze Theorem 8 on
which N14 rests. The final bibliographical source-comparison paragraph of the
factor document is not part of the audited theorem or its dependency chain.

##### Obligation ledger

| ID | Obligation and independent verification | Result |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | XOR by the minority hole maps that hole to 0 and the other three to odd vertices; preserves every short edge and matching incidence. | Closed |
| O2 | If ab or at is short, adjoining it gives a matching with exactly two odd holes, including v. N14 at dimension 5 produces the required cycle; the adjoined edge is short relative to original F. | Closed modulo N14 |
| O3 | Otherwise r(a)=r(b)=r(t)=2 and r=1 elsewhere; even demand 15+2=17, odd demand 13+2+2=17. | Closed |
| O4 | A lost odd neighbor other than v must have exactly one neighbor in S because F contains at most one edge incident to it. Its partner cannot be a. Distinct lost neighbors have distinct partners. Thus losses are bounded by R(S), including when some F edges are long. | Closed |
| O5 | Both b and t retain all incident cube edges, and at most 16-n(S) of them are outside the full neighborhood. Their extra demand contributes at least max(0,n(S)-14). Removing v costs at most one. | Closed |
| O6 | GF5 holds for all 65,535 nonempty subsets of the 16 even vertices, by independent exhaustive integer computation. Empty clone subsets satisfy 0<=0 directly. | Closed by finite computation |
| O7 | For any subset U of even clones, its represented original set S has exactly the same clone neighborhood as the full set of clones of S, and size(U)<=size(S)+1[a in S]. Weighted Hall therefore covers partial-clone subsets as well. Equal sides of size 17 turn the saturating matching into a perfect matching. | Closed |
| O8 | A repeated projected edge requires both endpoints to be doubled. The only doubled vertices are a,b,t; b,t have equal parity, and ab,at are absent in this branch. No duplicate can occur. | Closed |
| O9 | H avoids every short F edge by definition of G; long F edges cannot equal a short H edge. Thus F union H is simple and degree two at all 31 allowed vertices. No F edge meets v because v is a hole. | Closed |
| O10 | Every finite simple graph of degree two is a disjoint union of cycles; this yields exactly the claimed scope and does not imply connectivity. | Closed |
| O11 | CF1: for nonempty proper clone subsets, proper original support has at least one unit of excess by GF5's table; full support has all 17 odd neighbors and at most 16 clones. Thus strict Hall holds. Removing endpoints of any chosen clone edge leaves Hall, so that edge lies in a perfect matching and its original edge lies in a spanning factor. | Closed |

Dependency graph is acyclic: normalization and the adjacent-case import are
independent of GF5; GF5 plus the loss estimate yields clone Hall, then simple
projection, then the cycle factor. A4 or P6 is not used anywhere.

CF1 uses the strict version of the same Hall bound and the same projection
argument. It permits prescribing one allowed new edge in the nonadjacent
branch. Removing two selected endpoints costs at most one neighbor for any
subset of the remaining even part; that subset was a proper subset of the
original 17-vertex part. Equal remaining sides of size 16 allow Hall again.
There is no inference to simultaneous prescription of several edges or to
keeping a previously chosen component while joining another one.

##### Independent computational verification

The submitted checker [verify_a4_factor_geometry.py](research/six_directions/verify_a4_factor_geometry.py) was read and rerun.
Its 65,535 nonempty masks cover every relevant S, and its leaf-parent bitset
counts distinct parents rather than leaf edges. It returns PASS with the
stated minima.

An independent checker, [a4_factor_gray_audit.py](research/six_directions/a4_factor_gray_audit.py), instead visits all subsets
in Gray-code order, updates the five affected odd degrees, and tracks the XOR
of selected original vertex labels at each odd vertex. At degree one this XOR
is the unique parent. It does not reuse the submitted neighbor-mask loop.
The empty case is handled separately and is included only to give 65,536
total Hall cases. Results are in [a4_factor_gray_audit_results.json](research/six_directions/a4_factor_gray_audit_results.json).

For sizes 0 through 16 both independent and submitted checks agree on:

`[0,2,3,3,2,2,1,1,1,3,4,3,3,3,2,1,0]`.

The submitted result uses null at size zero because GF5 is only asserted for
nonempty S. This is a presentation difference: Hall itself has slack zero
for the empty subset. The independent histogram has exactly two zero-slack
sets, the empty set and the entire even part. No negative slack exists.
Each nonempty cardinality has a concrete minimizing witness in both results.

The larger C++ checker was also inspected: its eligible b,t values are the
11 odd nonneighbors of 0, chosen unordered in 55 ways, and v is any of the
remaining 14 odd vertices. This gives 770 configurations. It loops all 65,536
subsets and correctly counts protected leaf parents. Its 50,462,720-case
reported result agrees with the stronger, hole-independent GF5 check. This
review did not independently rerun those 50 million cases because GF5 alone
already suffices and was independently verified.

##### Counterexample pass and boundaries

The following failure mechanisms were explicitly tested against the proof:

- Long or same-parity F edges: they remove no extra short edges, so they
  cannot invalidate the loss bound.
- Several leaf neighbors of one parent: F removes at most one of them;
  counting distinct parents is the correct upper bound.
- A subset containing only one clone of a: identical clone neighborhoods
  make Hall valid without requiring such subsets to be unions of clone pairs.
- Projecting a generic demand-clone matching can create parallel edges if
  an edge joins two doubled endpoints. The proof explicitly excludes exactly
  those a-b and a-t edges before using this projection; the adjacent branch
  is handled by N14 instead.
- S empty or all even vertices: both have Hall equality and are handled.
- A disconnected factor: this remains possible. No merging procedure or
  connected-factor claim is inferred from the Hall calculation.

No non-enumerative derivation of GF5 was obtained in this audit. GF5 remains
a complete finite computer-assisted lemma rather than an asymptotic or
experimental assertion. The universal conclusion quantifies over all F by
the analytic loss estimate; it does not enumerate only sampled matchings.

No proof text or root state file was modified by this audit. Deterministic
verification closes GF5; same-family reviewer agreement alone is not a
cross-family semantic acceptance overlay.

##### Exact scope and statement

For every matching F of the complete graph on the 32 vertices of Q5 with
exactly six unmatched vertices, of parity counts 2 and 4, and for each specified
hole v of the four-hole class, there exists a simple cycle with vertex set
Q5 minus v containing every edge of F; every edge of the cycle outside F is a
Q5 edge. F is permitted arbitrary long and same-parity edges. This review
establishes this A6 statement modulo the listed previous extension theorems
and certified finite inputs. It does not establish full Q6 P6 or close the
R8-covered residual or any higher hole level.

##### Definitions and global invariants

E/O denote global minority/majority parity, not local parity coordinates in
each face. Every coordinate identification with Q4 preserves equality and
opposition of parity, which is sufficient for every imported theorem. The
mirror bar(t) is the short neighbor across the cut and is never silently
identified with the required partner. Ports are covered by original crossing
edges and cannot be original holes or internal-matching endpoints.

All artificial edges are temporary matching edges. Every one is deleted,
suppressed, or expanded. The interiors expanded in the final B cycle are
pairwise disjoint, and absent from that B cycle. In particular a bridge vertex
that becomes an interior is explicitly avoided on the B side. Original crossing
edges can be long; they are retained required edges. All genuinely new bridges
and optional edges are short. These facts establish both simplicity and the
required-edge/new-edge distinction of the final cycle.

Deleting a nonempty matching D from a simple cycle produces a path forest.
Restoring a proper subset of D by pairwise internally disjoint replacement
paths preserves a path forest: contraction yields a proper subgraph of the
original cycle. If xy is one deleted D edge and at least one other D edge is
deleted, x and y lie in different resulting components. These are exactly the
separation facts used in the port cases. For a spanning path, deleting any
nonempty set of its edges separates its two original endpoints.

parity, there is a Hamilton u--v path containing M. It also proves all covered
targets satisfying that reduction's preliminary augmentation or nine-row cut
criterion. No stronger consequence is inferred from the previous PASS.

The full eight-hole endpoint theorem still requires **R8-covered**. Its
explicit all-six-directions short-matching witness survives, so this is a
nonempty remaining domain for the present scheme. Full P6 and the 10,12,14,16,18
hole levels remain open. These consequences add no proof dependency cycle:
A6 was proved from Q4 inputs and Q5 A4 before it was substituted downstream.
Their semantic assurance is the same **same-family/provisional** assurance.

<details id="review-a6-finite-inputs-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>A6_FINITE_INPUTS_REVIEW.md — A6 finite Q4 inputs: independent review</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/A6_FINITE_INPUTS_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`223fe1eec3f659dd1c844d81c45f904cf5ea7e009b8b8acc2cd31d5bda48da18`。

#### A6 finite Q4 inputs: independent review

Review date: 2026-11-01. Requested reviewer: GPT-6.1-sol, high.
`review_independence: same-family`; `acceptance_status: provisional`.

**Result:** the two finite inputs pass independent deterministic verification,
including complete arbitrary matching coverage and the required geometric orbit
coverage. The old two-hole spectrum dependencies were also reverified. This
report does not establish A6 or P6, and does not change their status.

The machine-readable evidence is [A6_FINITE_INPUTS_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/A6_FINITE_INPUTS_REVIEW.json). The independent
checker is [a6_finite_inputs_independent_check.py](research/six_directions/a6_finite_inputs_independent_check.py). All paths here are relative
to this report's directory. Existing producers, certificates, checkers and main
proof state were left untouched. The existing producer PASS logs were not used
as evidence for validity or completeness.

##### Precise statements audited

Write Q4 on vertices 0,...,15 with short edges joining vertices whose XOR has
Hamming weight one. KQ4 here means the complete graph on these vertices:
the prescribed matching can contain arbitrary long or same-parity edges.
Four distinct holes mean exactly the unmatched vertices, so the matching has
six edges. All paths and cycles below contain every prescribed matching edge.

1. For every matching with holes {v,b,z,d}, with v,b of one parity, z,d of the
   other parity, and z not adjacent to b, there is a simple 15-vertex path
   covering exactly Q4 minus v, starting at d and ending at a vertex e with
   parity(e)=parity(d) and e != z. Every edge outside the matching is short.
2. For every four-hole matching with a 1:3 parity split, and for **each specified
   hole h in the majority class**, consider all simple cycles covering exactly
   Q4 minus h with every new edge short. The union of their new edges contains
   at least 15 distinct short edges. For a 2:2 split, take cycles covering all
   16 vertices; the analogous union contains at least 18 short edges.

The second statement is a **spectrum/union** bound. It does not say that a
single cycle has 15 or 18 new edges. In the four-hole setting each such cycle
has respectively nine or ten new edges, so that reading would be false.
Likewise, a witnessed minimum union of 15/18 need not be the exact full spectrum.

##### Independent verification method

The checker imports no producer or supplied-checker code. It reconstructs
matchings as unordered pair partitions. A separate recursive enumerator builds
the entire expected set on the covered vertex set, and the set of parsed
matchings must equal that expected set, with duplicates forbidden. This avoids
reusing the supplied checkers' mixed-radix rank mechanism. It independently
confirms 12-vertex matching counts 11!!=10395 and 14-vertex counts 13!!=135135.

For each record it checks exact holes, no fixed points, a symmetric matching
involution, distinct path/cycle vertices and exact required vertex set,
inclusion of all six (or seven for old two-hole inputs) matching edges, and
Hamming distance one for every remaining edge. Paths additionally satisfy
the prescribed root and endpoint restrictions. Cycles explicitly include the
closing edge. Each spectrum union is reconstructed from actual edges with
the matching edges removed, record by record. Parsing must consume the file
exactly, and counts and full matching sets must agree.

It constructs all 16*24=384 cube automorphisms explicitly and checks adjacency
preservation. Coordinate permutations fix 0; translations reduce any v to 0
and preserve parity equality/opposition as well as short edges. Relabeling also
preserves arbitrary complete-graph matching edges.

##### Path input and orbit cover

After translating v to 0 there are 196 eligible ordered triples (b,z,d):
seven nonzero even b, four odd z at distance three from b, and seven distinct
odd choices of d. Their 13 orbits under the 24 coordinate permutations have
the following representatives and multiplicities:

| b | z | d | Orbit size |
|---|---|---|---|
|3|4|1|24|
|3|4|7|12|
|3|4|8|12|
|3|4|11|12|
|3|4|13|24|
|3|13|1|12|
|3|13|2|12|
|3|13|4|24|
|3|13|7|24|
|3|13|14|12|
|15|1|2|12|
|15|1|7|12|
|15|1|14|4|

Both [q4_balanced_avoid_path_configs.txt](research/six_directions/q4_balanced_avoid_path_configs.txt) and every entry and multiplicity in
[q4_balanced_avoid_path_orbits.json](research/six_directions/q4_balanced_avoid_path_orbits.json) agree with the independently computed
orbits. Every representative file covers all 10395 matchings and supplies
one valid path per matching: 135135 path records total. By equivariance,
these witnesses establish statement 1 for every allowed configuration.

##### Four-hole spectrum orbit cover and adjacent-hole reduction

Let M have holes H and let e=ab be a short edge joining two holes. Then
M'=M union {e} is an arbitrary matching with two holes. Any legal completion
of M' is a legal completion of M with the same avoided vertex, if any:
it contains M, and its newly added edges relative to M are the new edges
relative to M' together with e. Consequently the old spectrum is a subset
of the spectrum for M; no distinct optional edges are lost in this reduction.

For the 1:3 case, fix the avoided majority hole h. If the minority hole has a
short edge to either of the other two majority holes, choose it as e. The two
remaining holes are h and another majority vertex, at distance two or four.
The old L15 two-hole result applies, avoiding exactly h. Translation maps h
to 0, and coordinate permutation maps the other hole to 3 or 15, respectively.
Its seven-edge matching is arbitrary, as required by the old certificates.

If no such e exists, normalize the minority hole to 0. The other two majority
holes are distinct weight-three vertices, and coordinate permutation carries
their unordered pair to {7,11}. The three residual marked-hole orbits have
representatives (H,h)=({0,7,11,t},t) with t=1,4,13. Explicit complete
automorphism enumeration verifies this classification, including both choices
of majority parity: there are 2688 marked configurations in total, 2112
handled by the adjacent reduction and 576 residual configurations, exactly
192 in each of the three orbits. The residual condition concerns adjacency
between the minority hole and the **other two** majority holes; adjacency to
the avoided hole does not permit the old avoided-hole reduction.

For the 2:2 case, any short hole-hole edge e leaves two opposite-parity holes,
at distance one or three. The old L18 two-hole result applies after translation
and coordinate permutation to the representative other hole 1 or 7. Among
all binomial(8,2)^2=784 balanced four-hole sets, 760 admit this reduction.
The remaining 24 sets form exactly the automorphism orbit of {0,3,13,14}.
The independent enumeration checks equality with that orbit, rather than only
checking a list of selected examples.

##### Numerical evidence

| New spectrum input | Matchings | Cycle witnesses | Minimum witnessed union |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|q4_four_spectrum_A_1.bin|10395|37204|15|
|q4_four_spectrum_A_4.bin|10395|37600|15|
|q4_four_spectrum_A_13.bin|10395|37153|15|
|q4_four_spectrum_balanced.bin|10395|48592|18|

These are 41580 new spectrum records and 160549 cycle witnesses. The old
inputs [q4_spectrum_A_3.bin](research/six_directions/q4_spectrum_A_3.bin), [q4_spectrum_A_15.bin](research/six_directions/q4_spectrum_A_15.bin),
[q4_spectrum_B_1.bin](research/six_directions/q4_spectrum_B_1.bin), and [q4_spectrum_B_7.bin](research/six_directions/q4_spectrum_B_7.bin) were also parsed and checked
independently: all 540540 matching records and 2448249 cycle witnesses pass,
with witnessed union minima 15,15,18,18. Thus the adjacent-hole reductions
do not rest on unexamined producer declarations.

The complete independent run checked **717255 matching records and 2743933
positive path/cycle witnesses across 21 certificate files**. The JSON report
records each input's SHA-256, source-checker hashes, per-file counts, minima,
and geometry counts.

Reproduction from the workspace root:

```powershell
D:\anaconda\python.exe research/six_directions/a6_finite_inputs_independent_check.py
```

No counterexample exists within these finite quantified statements, as
witnesses have been checked for every matching in each complete orbit cover.
No FATAL, CRITICAL or MAJOR issue was found for these scoped inputs. The supplied
checkers' record format and conclusions agree with the independent checks;
the independent audit additionally checks the orbit JSON and the complete
four-hole-to-two-hole geometric reduction. Producer algorithms need not be
assumed complete or correct for this conclusion: complete coverage and
positive witnesses were verified directly from their output artifacts.

The remaining A6/P6 proof obligations and any use of these bounds in a
higher-dimensional argument are outside this report. Mathematical semantic
acceptance remains same-family/provisional pending a cross-family overlay.

<details id="review-a8-bridge-inputs-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW.md — A8 bridge inputs: fresh independent review</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`cb40069fc1493c748a3f5789d11544165f86e436cc7c94e26344b24926831ae6`。

#### A8 bridge inputs: fresh independent review

Date: 2026-11-01. Review agent: `/root/a8_bridge_inputs_audit`.
Requested reviewer setting: GPT-6.1-sol, high. Method: ARIS proof-checker,
with the user-authorized scope and named outputs. Assurance:
`review_independence: same-family`; `acceptance_status: provisional`.

##### Verdict and scope

**PASS for the exact Q4 T63 classification. PASS for both stated sufficient
bridge criteria, relative to their explicitly imported Q4 theorems.** No
mathematical gap was found within these statements. Full A8 and the original
full Q6 question remain OPEN. This report neither audits nor promotes a
universal residual-orbit closure.

| Audited obligation | Verdict | Qualification |
|---|---|---|
| T63 marked-geometry normalization | PASS | Seven disjoint orbits cover all 560 even-parity geometries; odd parity follows by translation |
| T63 arbitrary matching domain | PASS | All 945 matchings per representative checked exactly once |
| T63 positive sufficiency | PASS | 6405 explicit simple 13-cycles checked independently |
| T63 negative necessity and completeness | PASS | All 210 negatives satisfy the proved degree obstruction; no search-failure premise |
| General bridge graph and proper-subset argument | PASS | Explicit path/endpoint and multigraph reasoning below |
| Double-bridge criterion | PASS relative to imports | GQ4-avoid and Q4 T15; fixed original obstruction remains excluded |
| Three-bridge criterion | PASS relative to imports | GQ4-avoid and the independently checked T63 |
| Fourth residual geometry, two-cut reduction | PASS | At least one cut has no fixed obstruction; the remaining small-crossing cases stay open |
| Every residual arbitrary matching satisfies some criterion | OPEN / not claimed | No exhaustive matching coverage for these Q5 criteria |
| Full A8 / full Q6 | OPEN / not proved | Neither follows from these local results |

The reviewed theorem-bearing sources are [A8_Q4_T63_CLASSIFICATION.md](#proof-a8-q4-t63-classification),
[A8_DOUBLE_BRIDGE_SUFFICIENT.md](#proof-a8-double-bridge-sufficient), and [A8_THREE_BRIDGE_SUFFICIENT.md](#proof-a8-three-bridge-sufficient).
The report JSON pins SHA-256 hashes for these, the source definitions/import
statements actually read, the producer verifier/output inspected, manifest,
and all seven binary certificates. No production file or main ledger was
modified. The new independent checker writes only review evidence.

##### Dependency and assumption ledger

The new dependency DAG is acyclic:

* T63: degree argument + complete marked-geometry coverage + positive cycle
  witnesses; it uses no Q5 extension theorem and no T15 theorem.
* Double bridge: residual assumption (I) + graph/forest lemma + GQ4-avoid +
  Q4 T15 classification.
* Three bridges: residual assumption (I) + graph/forest lemma + GQ4-avoid +
  T63. The two-cut reduction uses only this sufficient theorem and the
  incompatibility of two edges sharing vertex 24 in a matching.

The imported statements were read in [Q4_GENERAL_AUGMENTATION.md](#proof-q4-general-augmentation) and
[Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION.md](#proof-q4-t15-classification). Their base certificate packages are not re-audited
here. Thus the bridge verdicts are expressly relative to these imports,
not fresh certification of all their transitive dependencies.

Symbols have consistent types: `F_A,F_B,C` are disjoint parts of the original
matching; `X_A,X_B` are its crossing endpoint sets; `H_A,H_B` are original
holes; `T` is a set of distinct A vertices; `P,J,D,S` are matchings on T,
with D perfect; `G` is the uncompressed graph; L is the final matching on B.
S and D must be treated as separately labelled edges when their endpoints
coincide. In particular the two-edge cycle at d=1 is a multigraph cycle.
No probabilistic, asymptotic, or interchange obligations arise.

##### Independent finite verification of T63

The new checker [A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW_check.py) does not import the
producer or execute its search/verifier. It independently generates all
perfect matchings of the ten covered vertices and checks each decoded
matching for membership and uniqueness. Its orbit implementation permutes
bits and then translates, separately from the producer's transform code.
The exact union is compared with directly generated pairs (H,U).

| H | U | Orbit | Positive | Analytic negative |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 0,3,5,6,9,10 | 0,3,5 | 96 | 945 | 0 |
| 0,3,5,6,9,10 | 0,5,6 | 96 | 840 | 105 |
| 0,3,5,6,9,10 | 0,5,9 | 96 | 945 | 0 |
| 0,3,5,6,9,10 | 0,5,10 | 96 | 945 | 0 |
| 0,3,5,6,9,10 | 5,6,9 | 96 | 945 | 0 |
| 0,3,5,10,12,15 | 0,3,5 | 32 | 840 | 105 |
| 0,3,5,10,12,15 | 0,3,12 | 48 | 945 | 0 |

The output is [A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW_check.json](research/six_directions/A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW_check.json): 560 even geometries,
560 translated odd geometries, 6615 representative matching records,
6405 positive cycles, 210 analytic negatives. Every binary is exactly
945*29 bytes. No records are duplicated or omitted. For each positive record
the checker verifies 13 distinct vertices equal to Q4 minus U, the two
cyclic neighbors at every vertex, preservation of every required edge,
and shortness of every edge outside the required matching. Long edges and
same-parity required edges are permitted throughout.

For each negative, an opposite-parity covered vertex a has exactly one
short neighbor b outside U and the matching contains ab. The second cycle
edge incident to a would have to be a new short edge, but no distinct such
edge exists. This proves impossibility analytically. The only obstruction
edges in the two negative-bearing files are 4--12 and 1--9 respectively;
each occurs for exactly 7!!=105 matchings. Positive records have no such
obstruction. The necessity argument and the positive certificate cover
together establish the iff, independently of search completeness.

The parity-preserving group has 8*24 automorphisms. Its seven disjoint
orbits have sizes 96,96,96,96,96,32,48 summing to 560. Translation by an odd
vertex handles the opposite parity without changing adjacency, arbitrary
required edges, U, or the obstruction. This discharges the WLOG and
quantifier obligations for every arbitrary matching and every marked U.

##### Bridge graph, compression, and obstruction control

For k=2 or 3 bridges let W be their distinct B mirrors. The added bridges
are new short edges: their A endpoints are distinct original holes. They
cannot duplicate edges of the original matching, even when a mirror is a
crossing port. Every vertex of T has degree one in G; each mirror has
degree two (one original required edge and its bridge); all other covered
B vertices have degree one. Original B holes are isolated. A cycle of G
would have to pass through a mirror, hence through its adjacent A leaf,
which is impossible. This proof does not assume original crossings are
short, that the two mirrors are unpaired, or that mirrors are internal
rather than ports.

A nontrivial G component has either two T endpoints, one T endpoint and
one B terminal, or two B endpoints. The first components define a matching
P on T; each contains a mirror, so |P|<=k. Terminal components have unique,
distinct roots, disjoint from endpoints of P. A two-B-endpoint component
is a single edge of F_B: a longer path would require an internal mirror,
whose bridge goes to an A leaf. This also settles the case where both
potential obstruction endpoints lie in the same G component: then their
edge is already an original F_B edge and is excluded by the fixed-edge
condition. Roots are never ambiguously assigned to a component with two
terminals and a T endpoint.

Since J is a matching on T, it extends to a perfect matching D. The strict
inequality d>|J| makes J a proper subset. Delete D from the GQ4-avoid
cycle K on A-v. Since D is a nonempty matching, all remaining components
are nonempty paths with endpoint set T; their contraction is S. S+D is
one alternating cycle, including the parallel-edge d=1 case. Restoring
any proper subset of its D edges cannot create a cycle. Hence S+J, and
in particular S+P, are forests.

Expanding S and attaching G therefore produces disjoint paths with
endpoints precisely the covered nonmirror vertices of B. Every A-v
vertex and every mirror is an interior vertex of exactly one such path;
every required edge belongs to exactly one path (or is a single-edge
path). Compression gives a genuine loop-free matching L. Its holes are
exactly H_B union W. There are no duplicated endpoints, lost components,
or suppressed original holes.

If two covered candidate obstruction endpoints are both terminals, their
distinct roots u,r are unused by P. Adding ur to J is therefore legal.
If compression paired those endpoints, S+P would contain a u--r path.
Together with the separately labelled ur edge it would form a cycle in
S+J, contradicting the proper-subset argument. This remains valid if the
path is one edge, when the forbidden cycle has two parallel edges. If
one endpoint is not a terminal, its component is a single original
F_B edge, so excluding the fixed obstruction suffices. These are all
possibilities; original edges may be arbitrary long edges.

The final B cycle contains L and omits exactly W. Replace each compressed
edge by its stored path, including single-edge paths when appropriate.
The paths have disjoint interiors and endpoints, and the omitted mirrors
occur only inside them. Thus the result is one simple cycle with exactly
Q5-v as vertex set, containing all F_A,F_B,C. Artificial D edges have
been removed, compressed edges have been expanded, original long edges
are retained, and every other introduced edge is short.

##### Double-bridge hypothesis discharge

The hypotheses imply |H_B|=4 and |H_A|=4. The two mirrors have the same
parity by assumption 3; t,s have the opposite parity. If t,s are minority
holes, the A counts are (majority,minority)=(2,2), hence delta=0. If t,s
are majority holes, the counts are (4,0), hence delta=4. In both cases
removing t,s leaves precisely two majority holes including v. Consequently
F_A+D satisfies GQ4-avoid, c is even, and d=(c+2)/2. This T15 criterion
does not assert all possible delta-four cuts have its 1+5 B-hole pattern.

The singleton B hole a is original: mirrors belong to the five-hole
parity class. If both mirrors neighbor a, its other neighbors p,q are
not original holes. They have the mirrors' parity; residual (I) excludes
their being original holes, since a is in B and therefore is not v.
They are also distinct from the mirrors. Q4 T15's obstruction is exactly
pq in L. If a mirror is not adjacent to a, the obstruction is already
geometrically impossible. Otherwise pq not in F_B is explicitly required;
it cannot be dropped even for large c. The root-pair argument above
excludes newly compressed pq. All T15 hypotheses are now discharged.
Here |P|<=2, |J|<=3, so c>=6 implies d>=4>|J|, subject to the fixed-edge
condition. Smaller c are included whenever the actual strict criterion
holds; no claim is made when it fails.

##### Three-bridge hypothesis discharge and fourth-orbit boundary

For delta=-1 as stated, A has two majority and three minority holes;
B has three majority holes. Each minority bridge mirror has majority
parity and is covered by residual (I). Then c is odd, d=(c+3)/2, and
F_A+D has exactly the two majority holes in A, including v. The GQ4-avoid
application is valid. L has six majority holes, with W the three avoided
holes, so T63 applies.

An opposite-parity vertex has a unique remaining neighbor outside W
exactly when it neighbors all three mirrors. There is at most one such
vertex: two distinct Q4 vertices have at most two common neighbors.
If it exists, a is a covered nonmirror vertex; its fourth neighbor b is
not a mirror. If b is an original hole, ab cannot lie in L. Otherwise
both endpoints are covered nonmirror vertices, the explicit fixed-edge
exclusion and root-pair argument eliminate ab. Thus every possible T63
obstruction, including one introduced by compression, is excluded.
Here |J|<=4; c>=7 yields d>=5>|J| whenever the required original-edge
exclusion holds. The criterion also covers any smaller-c instance that
actually satisfies the strict inequality.

The independent checker verifies the fourth residual geometry directly:
at bit 8 the mirrors are 9,10,12 with a=8,b=24; at bit 16 they are
17,18,20 with a=16,b=24. Both A faces have the stated 2+3 hole counts.
The two fixed edges 8--24 and 16--24 cannot both belong to a matching.
Therefore at least one cut has no fixed obstruction. If such a cut has
c>=7, the theorem applies. If both sufficient tests fail, at least one
cut has no fixed obstruction and c<=5 (c is odd). This does not imply
the other cut has no fixed obstruction, or that the small-c cut satisfies
d>|J|, or that the full orbit is closed. Those cases remain OPEN.

##### Adversarial edge cases and reproduction

Checked structurally: arbitrary long original edges; mirror ports;
two mirrors paired by an original edge; obstruction endpoints in one
G component; obstruction endpoints in distinct terminal components;
an obstruction endpoint that is an original hole; no common neighbor;
d=1 and parallel contracted edges; and equality |J|=d. No counterexample
to a stated criterion was found. Equality was deliberately not accepted:
restoring all deleted edges can close a component. A fixed original
obstruction edge cannot be removed through root prescriptions.

Run `D:\anaconda\python.exe research\six_directions\A8_BRIDGE_INPUTS_REVIEW_check.py`
from the workspace. It is deterministic and verifies that all input
hashes stay unchanged during the run. Its output and this audit JSON
record the exact reviewed input bytes. Semantic acceptance remains
same-family/provisional; the deterministic certificate checks passed.


</details>


<details id="review-a8-delta4-first-orbit-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.md — Independent review: the first A8 residual orbit</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`fa1e255b92d22fd0c405066de1ea286d496141ad3ba17384fd17bf83ed48cb14`。

#### Independent review: the first A8 residual orbit

2026-11-01. Reviewer `/root/ten_hole_free_closure_audit`, user-selected
`gpt-6.1-sol / high` rather than the ARIS skill default. Semantic assurance
is **same-family / provisional**.

**PASS relative to the explicit GQ4-avoid and Q4 T44 imports.** The stated
delta-four branch works for every arbitrary K(Q5) matching and specified
majority forbidden hole under its exact hole geometry. It closes all60
marked configurations in the first residual orbit of the separately accepted
partial A8 package. Combining the two reports proves2600 of the2700 residual
after-augmentation geometries;100 in four orbits remain open. Neither this
report nor that arithmetic proves full A8 or any complete higher-hole P6
layer. The original partial package and its160-residual accounting are unchanged.

The audited [A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT.md](#proof-a8-delta4-first-orbit) SHA256 is
`296d483e95fa6b5d07b5d35f9562fce0a798b1b0876898ea4bc5a5013d947a3f`.

##### Exact theorem and imports

Let F be any matching on the32 Q5 vertices with three minority and five
majority holes, and let v be any specified majority hole. Suppose no minority
hole is short-adjacent to a majority hole other than v. Suppose a coordinate
face A containing v contains all five majority holes and exactly one minority
hole. Then a simple cycle on exactly Q5−v contains every edge of F and has
only short edges outside F. All required edges may be long or same-parity.

The nonadjacency hypothesis is the after-augmentation hypothesis. It does
not prohibit adjacency to v, and does not restrict F's required edges.
GQ4-avoid is read in [Q4_GENERAL_AUGMENTATION.md](#proof-q4-general-augmentation) and accepted in the final
A6 audit; it applies to all imbalance-two hole counts and arbitrary required
edges. Q4 T44 is the explicit four-same-parity-hole, any-two-prescribed-
omissions theorem in [Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_TRANSFER.md](#proof-q4-two-avoided-transfer), with its accepted whole
matching-quantifier review. The earlier exhaustive matching certificates are
imported rather than rerun. Thirteen relevant recorded hashes match current
sources/reports. No Q5 T15, Q4 T15, unrestricted A8, or double-bridge theorem
under investigation is imported.

The dependency DAG is Q4 N14/A4 and the already accepted local consequences
→ GQ4-avoid; separately certified Q4 T44 → B completion. These plus the new
two-bridge forest proof imply this geometric branch. The partial-A8 review
is used only to identify and combine the disjoint residual sets, not to
establish the new two-bridge transfer itself.

##### Obligation ledger and adversarial review

| ID | Obligation and discharge |
|---|---|
| D01 | A has six original holes, so2|F_A|+c=10 and c is even,0≤c≤10. The four non-v majority holes have distinct B mirrors of minority parity. Since the only original B holes are minority and cannot be adjacent to these sources, every mirror is covered, either by F_B or a crossing. |
| D02 | If both mirror types occur, select one port and one internal mirror. A crossing exists and even c≥2, so p=1 and d=(c+2)/2≥2. If all internal, select a pair not joined by F_B; at most two of their six pairs can be matching edges. Then p=0,d≥1. If all ports, c≥4; choose any two, p=2,d≥3. These cover every classification, including exactly two candidate ports at c=2 by the mixed choice. Always p<d. |
| D03 | D pairs X_A plus the two source holes t,s. For each selected port mirror, prescribe the edge from its source to its actual original A crossing partner. Those partners are distinct covered A ports, never original holes; prescriptions are pairwise disjoint. The remaining even number of vertices can be paired arbitrarily. D is disjoint from F_A. |
| D04 | F_A+D has exactly one minority and three majority holes in A, including v. GQ4-avoid therefore gives an A−v cycle containing all of F_A and D, permitting all artificial long edges. This local input is valid also at c=0,D={ts}. |
| D05 | Removing D leaves d path components. Each selected port mirror restores exactly its prescribed removed gap through a fresh B vertex. Since only p<d gaps are restored, no circle forms. All other crossing attachments are at distinct endpoints. The resulting forest covers A−v and selected port mirrors internally, with endpoints all unselected B ports and the selected internal mirrors. |
| D06 | Its compressed matching R meets F_B only at selected internal mirrors. With one such mirror a cycle is impossible, since every other vertex has degree at most one. With two such mirrors the only possible closed component would use the edge wz in both matchings. The chosen pair is not an F_B edge, excluding that case. Equivalently, each selected internal mirror's F_B mate is distinct from the other mirror and from every crossing port; the two mates are distinct. Simultaneous suppression therefore yields a genuine matching, no loop or closed component. |
| D07 | Suppression of internal mirrors and consumption of port mirrors leave exactly the two original B holes plus w,z as holes of L. These are four distinct minority-parity vertices. Coordinate permutations transport the complete arbitrary matching and forbidden vertex, so all60 marked configurations in its orbit satisfy the theorem. |
