#### Fourth A8 residual orbit: independent full-closure review

2026-11-01. Fresh reviewer `/root/a8_bridge_inputs_audit`, requested
GPT-6.1-sol/high. ARIS proof-checker method within the authorized scope.
`review_independence: same-family`; `acceptance_status: provisional`.

The proof establishes the exact theorem for holes
`{0,1,2,4,15,23,27,29}`, omitted vertex `0`, and every arbitrary matching
of the other 24 vertices. The coordinate-permutation orbit has exactly
30 marked hole geometries. No new mathematical gap was found. Full A8,
full P6 and the original full Q6 question remain OPEN.

##### Scope and dependencies

The reviewed assembly is [A8_ORBIT4_FULL_CLOSURE.md](#proof-a8-orbit4-full-closure). Its dependency DAG is
GQ4-avoid + exact Q4 T15/T63 classifications -> previously audited bridge
sufficient criteria -> four-cut coverage condition; independently, finite
allowed graphs -> complete matching domain -> explicit positive cycles.
These two branches jointly imply this orbit theorem. The earlier bridge
review and the exact current bytes of its theorem sources are pinned in

No Q5 A8 conclusion or higher-layer theorem is imported.

The new independent checker is [A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW_check.py), with evidence
in [A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW_check.json](research/six_directions/A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW_check.json). It imports neither the producer nor
the existing verifier. It reconstructs templates from the holes, rebuilds
all 16 allowed graphs, recursively enumerates matchings without memoized
producer counts, checks exact input-set equality and all positive cycles,
and generates the coordinate orbit. Both the semantic statements and the
binary input bytes have SHA-256 pins in the review JSON. Source hashes
were checked unchanged at the end. Production sources and the main state
were not modified.

| Obligation | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Four valid face templates and actual marked Q4 obstructions | PASS | Direct reconstruction from H and face neighbors |
| Every uncovered input lies in the restricted graph family | PASS | Even terminal count and a terminal outside the OB pair |
| Sixteen disjoint mask domains | PASS | Exact mask, required-edge disjointness, explicit unset-edge absence |
| All empty domains | PASS | Four fixed-edge conflicts; nine odd-component obstructions |
| Complete finite domain | PASS | Independent set enumeration; 200475 distinct full matchings |
| Positive witnesses | PASS | All 200475 simple 31-cycles checked directly |
| Coordinate transfer | PASS | 30 images under all 120 coordinate permutations, all fixing 0 |
| Full A8 / P6 / original full Q6 | OPEN | Outside this theorem's scope |

##### Four-cut hypotheses and exact Q4 obstruction identities

All holes have the required 5-even/3-odd pattern. Each nonzero even hole
15,23,27,29 has no short edge to any of 1,2,4, so the residual
nonadjacency hypothesis holds. Face A is the zero face and always contains
0. The following facts were independently derived rather than accepted
from the typed signatures:

| Bit | Minority A bridge sources | B mirrors Y | Singleton/common B vertex | Other neighbor(s) | Fixed OB edge |
|---:|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 2 | 1,4 | 3,6 | 2 | 10,18 | 10--18 |
| 4 | 1,2 | 5,6 | 4 | 12,20 | 12--20 |
| 8 | 1,2,4 | 9,10,12 | 8 | 24 | 8--24 |
| 16 | 1,2,4 | 17,18,20 | 16 | 24 | 16--24 |

For bits 2 and 4, A has two majority and two minority holes. Removing the
two chosen minority sources leaves two majority holes including 0. B has
one minority and three majority original holes; the two covered mirrors
produce the required 1+5 T15 pattern. The singleton's four in-face
neighbors are exactly the two omitted mirrors and the displayed pair.
For bits 8 and 16, A has two majority and three minority holes; deleting
the three sources again leaves two majority holes including 0. B has
three majority holes and the covered mirrors make the T63 six-hole
pattern. The displayed common neighbor is unique and its fourth neighbor
is 24. Thus these are the actual marked Q4 obstruction edges, not merely
unmarked geometric types. Every mirror and every obstruction endpoint
is originally covered. Original matching edges remain arbitrary.

##### Coverage necessity without the diagnostic spectrum

Fix a template and suppose its fixed obstruction edge pq is absent from
the original matching. Put S=Y union {p,q}. If an original crossing edge
has its B endpoint outside S, that endpoint is a covered nonmirror
degree-one vertex of G and is a terminal rooted in T. If an internal
mirror's original mate lies outside S, that mate is a covered nonmirror
degree-one vertex of G, again a terminal rooted through the mirror's
bridge. In either case it is a terminal outside {p,q}. This uses no
assumption that an original edge is short.

The graph lemma gives R=|T|-2|P| rooted terminals. Here |T| is even:
the two double-bridge cuts have even c and |T|=c+2, while the triple-bridge
cuts have odd c and |T|=c+3. Thus R is even. Let e be 1 if both p and q
are rooted terminals, and 0 otherwise. For e=0 the additional terminal
gives R>=2>0; for e=1 it gives R>=4>2. Consequently
|T|/2>|P|+e, exactly the audited strict sufficient criterion. The root
edge, when needed, is a matching edge disjoint from P. The original fixed
edge is absent by the explicit premise, so its exclusion hypothesis also
holds. Therefore violation of either restricted condition proves this
matching extendable by that template.

Taking the contrapositive for all four templates proves that every input
not already covered satisfies each required restricted condition unless
its fixed edge is present. This is a necessary coverage condition only;
no converse is needed. In particular the restricted finite family may
contain inputs also solvable by a template. Certifying the entire family
still completes the proof. No Hamilton-search failure or diagnostic
classification is used to infer coverage.

##### Exact 16-domain enumeration and empty-domain certificates

An input's mask is determined uniquely by which four actual fixed edges
it contains. For a set bit its edge is required. For an unset bit that
edge is explicitly forbidden, crossing B endpoints must lie in S, and
internal B edges meeting Y must remain inside S. All other edges are
allowed, including long and same-parity edges. These are exactly the
graph conditions used by the independent reconstruction. Every required
edge is also checked against all other applicable restrictions before its
endpoints are removed. Domains cannot overlap because their actual fixed
edge masks differ.

Masks 12,13,14,15 require both 8--24 and 16--24, contradicting that F is
a matching. For every other empty branch the rebuilt residual graph has
an odd connected component with no allowed outgoing edge. A perfect
matching would have to match that odd component internally, which is
impossible. One small explicit component per empty branch is:

| Mask | Odd component |
|---:|---|
| 0 | {7} |
| 1 | {28,30,31} |
| 2 | {26,30,31} |
| 4 | {22,30,31} |
| 5 | {21,22,28,30,31} |
| 6 | {19,22,26,30,31} |
| 8 | {14,30,31} |
| 9 | {13,14,28,30,31} |
| 10 | {11,14,26,30,31} |

The checker records all odd components and checks closure under every
allowed adjacency. Thus these are analytic empty-domain certificates,
not unexplained zero search counts.

The other three domains are independently enumerated by taking the least
remaining vertex, pairing it with each allowed remaining neighbor and
recursing. Every perfect matching has exactly one branch at each step,
so the recursion is exhaustive and duplicate-free. It imports no producer
code and reuses no producer counting cache. At each leaf the canonical
24-byte full matching must occur in the input-record set and is removed;
the set must be empty at the end. Every initial input record is also
checked to be a distinct canonical matching covering precisely Q5-H.

| Mask | Full original arbitrary matchings |
|---:|---:|
| 3 | 2025 |
| 7 | 99225 |
| 11 | 99225 |
| Total | 200475 |

Input binary size is 200475*24=4811400 bytes. Exact set equality, fixed
presences and unset absences all passed. This is complete domain
verification, not sampling or acceptance of a reported producer count.

##### Positive cycle verification, expansion, and orbit transfer

The certificate binary has 200475*55=11026125 bytes. Every record's first
24 bytes equal the corresponding full matching input. Its remaining 31
bytes list each vertex 1 through 31 exactly once. The checker verifies
every required edge occurs between cyclic neighbors and every cyclic
edge outside the matching has XOR in {1,2,4,8,16}, including the closing
edge. Thus every record directly specifies one connected simple cycle
on Q5-0 containing all twelve original edges. Every finite-remainder
input has a positive witness; search exhaustion and producer unknown
counters play no role.

Inputs outside that remainder are covered by an audited bridge criterion,
whose forest/compression/expansion proof retains all original required
edges and restores every omitted mirror and every A-0 vertex. This closes
the logical union of the analytic and finite branches without assuming
that the finite branch is all possible arbitrary matchings.

All 120 coordinate permutations fix omitted vertex 0, preserve shortness,
and act on the entire arbitrary matching. Their images of H give exactly
30 distinct hole geometries. Hence the exact representative theorem
transports to the full fourth residual marked orbit. On the previously
reported accounting of 100 remaining geometries in four orbits, this
removes 30 and leaves 70 in three orbits. That accounting update is not a
proof of the other orbits or of full A8/P6/Q6.

##### Checks and limitations

Adversarial checks addressed overlapping fixed edges; original long and
same-parity edges; mirrors that are crossing ports or are paired to each
other; e=0 versus e=1 and the parity needed for a strict inequality;
obstructions created by compression; distinct roots; unchanged omitted
vertex; forbidden-edge absences in every unset mask; duplicate/missing
records; and cycle closing-edge shortness. No mathematical counterexample
or open obligation was found within the exact theorem and its explicit
imports. The transitive Q4 import packages are not all re-audited here.

Reproduce with `D:\anaconda\python.exe research\six_directions\A8_ORBIT4_FULL_REVIEW_check.py`.
Deterministic matching/cycle checks passed. Semantic acceptance remains
same-family/provisional relative to the declared imports. No production
proof, main state, or original task-scope theorem was changed by this review.

#### Fifth A8 residual orbit: independent full-closure review

2026-11-01. Fresh reviewer `/root/a8_bridge_inputs_audit`, requested

##### Exact scope and dependency ledger

The candidate theorem is for holes `{0,2,4,8,15,23,27,29}`, omitted vertex
`0`, and arbitrary twelve-edge matchings of the other 24 Q5 vertices.

##### Four actual marked Q4 inputs

Majority parity is even. The other four even holes are nonadjacent to all
three minority holes 2,4,8, so residual nonadjacency holds. With A the
zero face, every cut contains forbidden 0 in A. The exact templates are:

| Bit | Minority A sources | Covered B mirrors Y | Singleton/common B vertex | Remaining neighbor(s) | Fixed OB edge |

| 8 | 2,4 | 10,12 | 8 | 9,24 | 9--24 |

For bits 2,4,8 the original A holes have 2+2 parity counts. Removing
the two minority sources leaves two majority holes including 0, so

neighbor is 16 and its remaining neighbor is 17. All mirrors and displayed
obstruction endpoints are outside H. These facts can be derived directly
from H without any normalization or unreviewed type table.

##### Coverage necessity and strictness of the bridge criterion

Fix a row, put S=Y union {p,q}, and suppose pq is absent from F. A crossing
edge entering B outside S gives a covered nonmirror degree-one terminal
in G rooted at its A port. An internal mirror's mate outside S likewise
gives a covered nonmirror degree-one terminal rooted through its bridge.
Either violation therefore creates a rooted terminal outside {p,q}.
This is valid for arbitrary long original edges, including equal-parity
edges, and mirrors may themselves be crossing ports.

Let P pair the T-to-T components of G, and let e be the indicator that
both p and q are rooted terminals. The rooted-terminal count is
R=|T|-2|P|. It is even: the first three cuts have c even and |T|=c+2;
the last has c odd and |T|=c+3. If e=0, the additional terminal gives
R>=2>0. If e=1, both p,q plus the additional terminal give R>=4>2.
Thus d=|T|/2>|P|+e=|J|. The candidate root edge is disjoint from P,
the original obstruction edge is absent by premise, and every hypothesis
of the previously audited sufficient bridge criterion is satisfied.

In particular the artificial prescriptions are a proper subset of D;
they cannot close a component before compression, and cannot introduce
the OB edge in the final B matching. The audited expansion restores all
A-0 vertices, bridge mirrors, and arbitrary original required edges.
No claim about a producer's failure to find an A cycle is involved.

Taking the contrapositive, every input not already solved must, for each
row, either contain its fixed edge or obey both restricted conditions.
This is a necessary cover of the unconstructed inputs. A converse is not
needed: the finite graph family may also contain inputs already solved
by some construction. Certifying its entire domain is sufficient.

##### Sixteen domains and independent reconstruction

The actual occurrences of the four fixed edges determine a unique mask.
Set-bit edges are required; unset-bit edges are explicitly absent and
their restricted conditions are imposed. In each applicable graph,
crossings can enter B only at S and an internal B edge meeting Y must
remain in S. All other original complete-graph edges are permitted.
The required edges are checked against every applicable restriction
before their endpoints are removed. Distinct masks cannot share a full
input matching.

The four fixed edges are pairwise disjoint, so no empty branch here can
be justified by an edge-overlap argument from a different orbit. The
independent reconstruction instead checks actual connected components
of every residual allowed graph. Any odd component with no outgoing
allowed edges prevents a perfect matching. Exact odd-component witnesses
are recorded in the domain evidence for the eleven empty masks.

For every domain without such an obstruction, the checker recursively
chooses the least remaining vertex and each allowed partner. This
enumerates each perfect matching exactly once. At every leaf its full
canonical 24-byte input must occur in the independently parsed input
set and is removed. The initial set is checked to contain distinct
matchings covering exactly Q5-H, and must be empty after enumeration.
No producer memoized count or producer code is imported.

| 13 | 176400 |

Mask 15 leaves a complete graph on sixteen vertices and has the

##### Full positive-certificate gate

The completed certificate file has exactly 2732625*55=150294375

matching, followed by 31 distinct vertices exactly equal to {1,...,31}.

##### Orbit transfer, adversarial checks, and current status

##### Typed notation, quantifiers and dependency graph

F is any simple matching covering exactly Q5 minus H2 or H3; no shortness

#### Independent audit of the partial A8 proof package

2026-11-01. Fresh reviewer `/root/ten_hole_free_closure_audit`; user-directed

##### Canonical statement and imports

For every arbitrary complete-graph matching F on Q5 with three minority and
five majority holes and every specified majority hole v, if either there is
a short edge between minority and nonforbidden majority holes, or there is
a coordinate face A containing v with majority-minus-minority hole imbalance
in{1,2,3}, then a simple cycle on exactly Q5−v contains F and has only short
edges outside F. In the cut branch assume no augmenting hole edge remains;
otherwise the augmentation branch has already solved the instance.

The complete A6 theorem is an explicit accepted import. GQ4-avoid and
GQ4-cycle are the stated arbitrary-complete-graph-matching theorems in
[Q4_GENERAL_AUGMENTATION.md](#proof-q4-general-augmentation); their augmentation proofs were read together
with their exact N14_4, A4_4, N10_4, NC_4 and K4_4 base statements in
[Q4_CORE_AND_A4_SPLIT.md](#proof-q4-core-and-a4-split). Their ultimate perfect-matching extension theorem
is a declared external input. O15 and O18 are the exact four-hole optional
edge union bounds of [A6_CLOSURE_DRAFT.md](#proof-a6-closure-draft) Section2, with accepted independent
finite review. The full A6 review explicitly audits all these general Q4
inputs and optional-union consequences. Four relevant reports are PASS;
14 recorded source/artifact hashes agree with current inputs. Their large
finite matching certificates are imported, not rerun in this audit.

The acyclic dependency graph is Q4 base inputs and optional-union certificates
→ GQ4/O15/O18; separately accepted Q5 A6 → short-hole augmentation. The new
transfer proofs plus independently reconstructed geometry imply the stated
partial A8 theorem. No Q5 A8/A10, Q5 T15, higher-hole P6, or new double-bridge
mechanism is used to prove an upstream import.

##### Proof-obligation ledger

E,O denote global minority/majority parity, not necessarily numerical even/odd.
Crossings C may be arbitrary long edges: their B endpoint need not be the
mirror of their A endpoint. A mirror always means the short coordinate edge.
D is an arbitrary artificial matching on currently uncovered A ports and
selected original holes. Compressed edges encode internally disjoint paths.

<details id="review-canonical-completion-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW.md — Independent audit of canonical A4 completion and gluing</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`af7614bc4e2ce455129e7faab700360349c5e0b9540e4c9ef23568c5d6d5b49b`。

#### Independent audit of canonical A4 completion and gluing

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer requested: GPT-6.1-sol, high reasoning.
Review independence: same-family; semantic acceptance: provisional.
Final submission [CANONICAL_A4_CLOSURE.md](#proof-canonical-a4-closure) was read in full and checked
line by line. Deterministic finite checks: PASS. Mathematical gluing: PASS modulo the
explicit imported Q4 and hole-geometry results below. This does not prove
the full P6 statement at the 8--18-hole levels.

##### Scope and independence

The new self-contained checker [CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW_check.py)
imports no generator, primary checker, or stored exception JSON. It reads
the two binary tables directly. It validates every positive cycle, proves
matching coverage by unique valid involutions and exact cardinality, and
independently enumerates all short complementary perfect matchings for
each negative. It then scans **all 2027025** near-perfect A-side inputs
forward, and enumerates all completions of every candidate stalled partial
forward. Thus the decisive universal endpoint property is checked without
using the producer's inverse-enumeration reasoning.

The checker completed successfully; its detailed output is
[CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW_check.json](research/six_directions/CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW_check.json).

##### Explicit statement and symbols

Canonical input: an arbitrary complete-graph matching F on Q5, with holes
{0,1,14,22}; the desired simple circle covers every vertex except 1,
contains F, and uses only cube edges outside F. Cut the least significant
coordinate. Local labels x represent 2x+1 in A and 2x in B. Thus A has
hole 0 and B has holes 0,7,11. Write X_A,X_B for distinct crossing-port
sets and c for their common size. F_A,F_B are disjoint internal matchings.
Counting gives 2|F_A|+c=15, so c is positive odd.

For d in X_A, D pairs X_A minus d, and L=F_A+D has holes 0,d. For an
odd y different from d, put k=L(y) and T_y=L-yk+dk, a matching with
holes 0,y. A 14-cycle extending T_y avoids both holes. Delete dk and
append ky to obtain a spanning d--y path P in A minus 0 containing L.
The auxiliary edge dk cannot already be another edge of L: d was free.
Deleting its occurrence in the simple cycle yields a simple path, and y
was absent, so appending it introduces no repetition. This proves exactly
the path property used below.

The submission additionally asserts the converse. It is correct: since y
is an endpoint of a path containing L, its unique incident path edge must
be its prescribed L-edge yk. Remove y from the path and join its remaining
endpoints d,k by dk. These endpoints cannot already be adjacent in this
14-vertex simple path, so this gives a simple 14-cycle with every required
edge of T_y(L), and all other edges short.

##### Finite obligations

1. All 135135 matchings for holes 0,1 are covered once. There are 135084
   positive witnesses and 51 negatives, of which 15 contain a half-layer
   and 36 do not.
2. All 135135 matchings for holes 0,7 are covered once. There are 135082
   positive witnesses and 53 negatives, of which 45 contain a half-layer
   and 8 do not.
3. For a negative, every extending 14-cycle would be F plus a disjoint
   short perfect matching, since F already gives degree one everywhere.
   The independent recursive enumeration covers all such short matchings
   and all resulting 2-factors have at least two components. This proves
   negative status rather than trusting a failed Hamilton search.
4. Coordinate permutations take holes 0,1 or 0,7 to 0,y for every odd y.
   The independent checker explicitly transports the mate involutions.
5. There are 15*13!!=2027025 near-perfect inputs (d,L). A direct forward
   scan finds exactly 256 for which neither y=7 nor y=11 works; the option
   y=d is declared unavailable, as required by the construction.
6. A partial F_A with c ports has exactly T=c(c-2)!! completions (d,D).
   For every stalled near-perfect L it contains, count the occurrence of
   F_A as a subset. The partial stalls precisely when this count is T:
   each completion is unique and occurs once in the forward scan.
7. The exact stalled-partial counts for c=1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15 are
   256,210,42,2,0,0,0,0. Their completion counts T are
   1,3,15,105,945,10395,135135,2027025.
8. For c=1 the good-endpoint cardinality distribution is
   {4:210,5:6,6:40}; for c=3 all 210 stalls have four good odd endpoints.
9. Every c=5 or c=7 stall has exactly four good odd endpoints G, disjoint
   from X_A. For each y in G, **every** one of its T completions works.
   This stronger quantifier is essential in choosing d from a B port's
   actual original crossing partner.
10. The two c=7 partials are exactly
    H1={(2,3),(4,5),(8,9),(14,15)} and
    H2={(1,3),(4,6),(8,10),(13,15)}. Every c=5 partial contains exactly one
    of these cores. There are 21 choices of its extra edge per core.

All ten finite obligations PASS deterministically. No conclusion about
Q5 counterexamples is inferred from a Q4 negative.

Every candidate-partial count in the submission's table was independently
checked as well: 256,1372,3048,3596,2366,808,84,1, respectively.

##### Safe endpoint transfer: y outside X_B

Choose a good completion and its d--y path P. Delete D, attach every
original crossing edge and the short mirror bridge y_A y_B. Every new
B endpoint is in X_B union {y}, a set of c+1 distinct vertices. The
result is a family of disjoint B-to-B paths whose internal vertices
partition A minus 0. If y belongs to X_A, its D edge was the final edge
of P, and deleting D leaves y isolated. Its original crossing edge and
the new bridge give a two-edge segment through y with distinct endpoints
in B; this is valid and loses no original matching edge. Other deleted
D endpoints receive their original crossing edge; the root d receives
its original crossing edge; an internally covered y receives its bridge.
No component can close because B attachments are distinct degree-one
endpoints. Compression therefore gives a matching R on X_B union {y}.

If y is 7 or 11, F_B+R has holes 0 and the other of 7,11, hence opposite
parity. NC_4 gives a full B circle; expansion gives the required circle.

Otherwise y is an odd non-hole outside X_B and is internally matched by
F_B. Put k=F_B(y), r=R(y). The vertices y,k,r are distinct, k is not a
port and r is a port. Then
L_B=(F_B-yk)+(R-yr)+kr
is a matching with precisely the holes 0,7,11,y. Apply A4_4 avoiding y.
Expand kr into k--y followed by the transferred y--r path, and expand
all other compressed edges. This restores y, F_B's edge ky, and every
A vertex other than 0 exactly once. All retained auxiliary edges are
expanded; the only new crossing bridge is short.

##### Occupied endpoint transfer: y in X_B

This case is used only for c=5 or c=7 stalled partials. Pick y in G and
take d to be the actual A endpoint of F's crossing edge incident to y_B.
Because G is disjoint from X_A, y_A is internally covered by F_A, and
d differs from y_A. Pair X_A minus d arbitrarily to obtain D. Universal
availability in obligation 9 yields P for **this** d and D. Since c>=5,
D is nonempty, and no D edge touches either endpoint of P. Deleting D
separates d and y_A into different components: a path has a unique route
between its endpoints and every D edge lies on that route.

Attach the original crossing edges and the mirror bridge y_A y_B.
Only the original d--y_B crossing and the new y_A--y_B bridge share a
B vertex. Their two A segments were distinct, so joining them at y_B
concatenates paths instead of creating a cycle. All other B ends are
the distinct vertices X_B minus {y}. Thus compression is a matching R
on X_B minus {y}, and its disjoint interiors partition (A minus 0)
union {y_B}. F_B+R is a matching with exactly the holes 0,7,11,y. These
are distinct because X_B contains none of B's original holes. All three
nonzero holes are odd. A4_4 gives a B circle avoiding y, and expanding
R restores the internal y_B and all of A minus 0, proving the desired
31-vertex circle. Both edges at y_B are restored, including its original
F edge. The new mirror bridge is distinct from that original edge since
d differs from y_A.

##### Complete case partition and imports

If F_A is not stalled, choose y=7 or 11, both outside X_B, and apply
the safe transfer. A stalled c=1 or c=3 partial has at least four good
odd endpoints but at most three B ports, so one is outside X_B. A stalled
c=5 or c=7 partial either has y in G outside X_B, handled safely, or has
G contained in X_B, handled by the occupied transfer. There are no
stalled partials at larger c. The partition includes all positive odd c.

Consequently the canonical A4 family is proved modulo Q4 inputs NC_4,
A4_4 and the finite checks above. Importing R1A from
[A4_SINGLE_GEOMETRY_REDUCTION.md](#proof-a4-single-geometry-reduction) proves full Q5 A4, conditional only on
its already specified Q5 N14, Q4, and optional-edge-spectrum imports.
These imports were read as explicit inputs and were not silently replaced
by an assumption of A4. There is no circular dependency: the Q4 proofs
precede and do not use Q5 A4; R1A leaves this canonical case open.

The earlier full-six-hole reductions can now discharge their A4 hypothesis.
Their independent acceptance is an import, not a fresh audit of every
six-hole lemma here. The theorem still says nothing new about the
8--18-hole levels, so a conclusion of full P6 would remain unjustified.

The pre-gluing unresolved full-matching counts are independently confirmed
as 42*9*105*120=4762800 at c=5 and
2*binomial(9,3)*15*5040=12700800 at c=7. They are unnecessary for the
proof, since the occupied-endpoint construction covers these families
universally without enumerating all original matchings.

##### Final obligation ledger

The following application checks were made against the submitted proof:

| Obligation | Discharge |
|---|---|
| arbitrary original long/same-parity edges | all enumerations use arbitrary pairings; short restrictions apply only to new edges |
| every 3:1 four-hole geometry | imported R1A; canonical proof has no additional restriction on F |
| all crossing counts | counting gives exactly positive odd c<=13; all are covered |
| endpoint target y distinct from root | enforced in the table criterion and every enumerated completion |
| prescribed-root occupied transfer | universal availability, rather than existential availability, established directly |
| A4_4 hole parity and distinctness | holes 0,7,11,y; y odd and outside {0,7,11} in both uses |
| NC_4 hypothesis | exactly two opposite-parity B holes in its use |
| F edges restored | F_A retained in segments; C attached in full; F_B swap edge restored on expansion |
| all vertices once and connectivity | disjoint path interiors and expansion of one simple B circle |
| newly added edges short | local table and Q4 witnesses, plus one mirror bridge; all other auxiliary edges deleted or expanded |
| full six-hole consequence | C6-covered and C6-free explicitly have A4 as their remaining hypothesis, with prior inputs; their cases cover covered and free targets |
| full P6 scope | 8--18-hole obligations explicitly excluded |

The six-hole dependency audit read [SIX_HOLE_FOUR_AUX_REDUCTION.md](#proof-six-hole-four-aux-reduction),
[SIX_HOLE_MIXED_AND_GEOMETRY.md](#proof-six-hole-mixed-and-geometry), [SIX_HOLE_COVERED_REDUCTION.md](#proof-six-hole-covered-reduction), and
[SIX_HOLE_FREE_REDUCTION.md](#proof-six-hole-free-reduction). Their dependency arrows run from A4 to K4
and the six-hole transfer theorems; none is invoked to prove A4 here.
Thus the final consequence is a valid discharge of a previously conditional
result, modulo its stated earlier theorems, with no dependency cycle.

Adversarial checks specifically considered c=1 with D empty, a target
isolated by deletion of D, a long original crossing edge at the occupied
target, collisions between mirror bridge and original crossing edge,
and a possible closed component at the shared B port. The hypotheses
above exclude each failure. No fatal, critical, major, or minor issue was
found in the final submission. Verdict: **PASS modulo explicit imports**;
semantic acceptance remains same-family/provisional.


</details>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`5a1c88a65aa7bcbde3f667be1e59069deb5359c2bc9beb243f9b0123d414e8ee`。

#### Q5 abundance, EP0, and fifty exact eight-hole consequences

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-checker. Fresh reviewer `/root/ep0_neighbor_lifting_audit`; GPT-6.1-sol / high as requested. Same-family review; provisional acceptance.

Verdict: **PASS modulo explicit fixed imports**. Q5_NEIGHBOR_ABUNDANCE_AND_EP0.md proves the Q5 neighbor union bound and its stated EP0 consequence. Together with the directly checked geometry and the previously audited arbitrary-matching marked core1/core4 theorems and two-bridge transfer, it closes all fifty normalized geometries listed in the accompanying JSON. This is not a proof of complete T15, all eight-hole cases, or P6.

The Q5 statement quantifies over every arbitrary K(V(Q5)) matching with exactly two distinct equal-parity holes q,v. At least three distinct short neighbors of q occur over its valid thirty-one-cycles omitting v. Witness cycles may depend on the neighbor. The EP0 statement fixes the original short Q6 matching and cut first, and only then chooses q,D,path,s. The conclusion for each listed Q6 geometry quantifies over every realizing short matching, not merely a sampled matching. No extra assumption of short or bipartite artificial matchings is introduced.

The new finite inputs have a separate complete audit in Q4_NEIGHBOR_ABUNDANCE_REVIEW.md. It checks the exact contraction/inverse correspondences, Q4 neighbor unions, the stronger two-short-endpoint lower bound, the444 A-star matchings and positive unions, the complete16816-key B dictionary, and60316956 pair comparisons with zero residuals. Both underlying opposite-hole tables match their previous fixed audit hashes.

The semantic obligations are as follows.

| ID | Obligation and discharge |
|---|---|
| Q01 | Equal-parity distinct Q5 holes have distance2 or4; thus at least one common coordinate exists. Translation/permutation preserve arbitrary required edges and short new edges. |
| Q02 | A common-coordinate cut has even crossing count: both holes are in A and both faces have even covered-vertex count. Required cross edges may join arbitrary mirror labels; the argument uses only distinct ports. |
| Q03 | With positive crossings, pairing all A ports creates exactly a Q4 matching with holes q,v. Q4 abundance applies to that arbitrary completion. |
| Q04 | Deleting its nonempty artificial matching from a simple fifteen-cycle leaves only paths. No isolate arises because the removed edges form a matching and q is not incident to any. |
| Q05 | Attach original crossings and compress to a matching on distinct B ports. The compressed matching and original B internal matching form a perfect matching on sixteen B vertices. Fink applies in precisely this complete-graph scope. |
| Q06 | Expansion of a B Hamilton cycle replaces disjoint matching edges by internally disjoint paths; its support is exactly Q5 minus v, all original edges return, and every surviving new edge is short. Both original q neighbors survive. |
| Q07 | At distance2, failure of the positive-cut branch means all three common-coordinate cuts have zero crossings. In each cut the A neighbor union has size at least3 and the B optional root-neighbor set has size at least2 among the same four local labels. They intersect. |
| Q08 | Splicing copies of a common optional root edge opens two disjoint cycles and joins them with two vertical short edges. Required edges are retained. The three cuts yield three different realizable vertical neighbors, with separate witnesses allowed. |
| Q09 | At distance4 the single common-coordinate cut either has positive crossings or gives independent A/B matchings. The A omitted vertex normalizes to15. |
| Q10 | For its pair family F and B good set G, T is nonempty because union(F) has at least3 vertices and at most2 vertices lie outside G. If T={b}, b cannot lie in G, and every edge touching G contains b. Any edge disjoint from G also contains b, because at most two vertices lie outside G. Therefore all pairs share center b outside G. |
| Q11 | Outside the444-center exception, at least two nonvertical q neighbors survive root-edge splices; a root splice also realizes the vertical neighbor. The three options need not occur on the same cycle. |
| Q12 | For a center exception, every possible B with unavailable center is in the complete135849 universe. The finite common-nonroot-edge result supplies witnessing A/B cycles. Splicing there preserves both A neighbors at q; the separately obtained vertical neighbor supplies the third option. |
| Q13 | The positive/zero cases and distances2/4 partition the Q5 domain. No induction, uniformity assertion, limit interchange, or unproved Q5 prescribed-edge hypothesis is used. |
| E01 | In the stated (2,0) cut, the EP0 completion domain is disjoint from M_A and has even size. Choosing r as stated and removing q leaves exactly holes r,q after arbitrary pairing D. |
| E02 | The target v differs from q and is covered by L=M_A union D. If t=L(v), then r,q,v,t are pairwise distinct. Replacing vt by rt gives K with exactly the equal-parity holes v,q. |
| E03 | The abundance theorem gives at least3 q neighbors; the assumed S intersection has at least3 among five neighbors, so some valid cycle contains qs with s in S. This is an existential cycle choice after L is fixed. |
| E04 | Remove required rt from this cycle and append restored vt; this is exactly the stated expand-through-v and delete-rv construction. It is a spanning r-v path, preserves L, and all its other edges are short. |
| E05 | q differs from r,v,t, so qs cannot be the removed edge rt. Even s=r or s=t causes no conflict. The chosen q,D,path,s satisfy precisely the existing EP0 definition. |
| G01 | Direct bit reconstruction checks all allowed (2,0) cuts for seven representatives, all eligible odd covered q distinct from v, and all sufficient crossing edges with at least3 S neighbors. It reproduces the supplied edge lists exactly. |
| G02 | Removing the union of these sufficient crossing edges yields the saved Hall deficiency in every representative. The checker independently computes its neighbor set from all64 bit labels, without using the matching solver. Thus every realizing matching contains at least one sufficient crossing edge and obtains an EP0 cut. |
| G03 | For every resulting cut and every possible selected qs, translate B by its retained even root and delete the cut bit. All234 configurations directly match the marked avoided/retained theorem under an explicit Q5 coordinate permutation. Counts are174 core4 and60 core1. The free retained root0 is included in each comparison. |
| G04 | The original two-bridge transfer applies to every completed auxiliary matching, including its long edges. It restores original edges and leaves precisely the prescribed two B omitted vertices. No unknown T15 core is used by these234 choices. |
| G05 | All target-preserving Q6 coordinate permutations are enumerated. The seven disjoint image sets have sizes10,1,9,9,1,10,10 and total50. The exact list is stored in the review check JSON and final review JSON. |
| G06 | The two imported marked theorem source files match their prior formal review hashes. Those reviews supply arbitrary K(Q5) matching scope and every marked cube-automorphic image. Root-preserving permutations used here are a permitted subset. |

The independent geometry checker does not infer applicability from a numerical core label or an unmarked six-hole-set orbit. It explicitly compares the omitted pair and all four retained vertices, including the even root, with the concrete theorem seeds: omitted{1,2}, retained{0,7,11,19} for core1 and retained{0,7,11,31} for core4. The projection's remaining three vertices are all odd in the local B labeling. Its root translation has even global parity, as required. The checker also verifies disjointness of all seven target-preserving Q6 orbits.

The proof dependency DAG is acyclic: fixed Q4 opposite-hole tables -> Q4 neighbor/endpoint and exact optional masks -> finite star intersection -> Q5 abundance -> EP0. Separate marked T15 core1/core4 proofs and the existing conditional two-bridge transfer then produce the fifty Q6 consequences. Neither Q5 abundance nor these finite lemmas uses T15 or a Q6 eight-hole theorem. Existing theorem-import provenance is retained rather than silently promoted to a formal or cross-family result.

Counterexample-first checks cover the actual delicate cases: a missing Q4 root neighbor, a mandatory-center pair family with center unavailable in B, B containing the center edge, the714 other B obstructions, zero crossings in all common coordinates, s coinciding with r or t in the EP0 reconstruction, and every234 marked projection choices. The finite comparisons and explicit case reasoning discharge them; they do not rely on an unsuccessful Hamilton search. A claim of a universal fixed EP0 cut remains unsupported and is not made.

There are no open proof issues in this scoped package. Exact input hashes and imported review bindings are in EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json; raw coordinates, Hall certificates, orbit sizes and the exact fifty-geometry list are in EIGHT_ALL_EP0_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW_check.json. The exhaustive classification of all residual eight-hole geometries is an existing external census input: this review establishes the exact displayed fifty and does not assert they exhaust every open eight-hole configuration. Main ledgers and prior proof/review files were not changed. Full eight-hole and P6 remain unproved here.

#### 八孔已覆盖终点：双桥条件归约独立审计

在已导入 N10 下，`(2,1) + T15` 与 `(2,0) + EP0 + T15` 的归约有效；
未发现额外的未声明条件。T15 未证明；EP0 的合适切分选择未证明。
这不是无条件八孔证明，不能关闭 R8-covered 或完整 P6。
原证明、既有审计和研究主状态均未修改。

##### 输入及量词

这里只审正文的条件推理，不重审 N10 的外部定理基础，也不重跑完整几何 census。
[A6_AND_EIGHT_FREE_CLOSED.md](#proof-a6-and-eight-free-closed) 中 A6、K6、完整八孔自由终点的已审 PASS 为既有输入；
本归约不使用 A6，不能把 A6 当作 T15 的替代品。

固定任意短匹配 M，恰有八孔，偶根 u=0 自由，目标 v 奇且被覆盖；
其余偶孔 Z 大小为 3，奇孔 W 大小为 4，Z∪W 独立。
固定任意坐标切分，A 含 v，B 是另一面。整个正文的奇偶均为全局奇偶；
在将面识别为 Q5 时可能整体反转，N10 与 T15 都允许此反转。

通过的量词形式为：

1. 对所有上述 (M,u,v,i)，若 `(a,b)=(2,1)` 且 T15 成立，则所求路径存在。
2. 对所有上述 (M,u,v,i)，若 `(a,b)=(2,0)`、EP0(M,i) 与 T15 成立，则路径存在。
3. EP0(M,i) 中先固定 M 与 i，再存在选择 r（δ=0 时为 z1 或 z2）、
   q、D、P、s。没有要求任意 q、任意 D 或任意 N10 路径含 qs。
4. 单切分反例证明：对每个列出的代表及其每个 `(2,0)` 切分，存在一个实现匹配
   使该切分的 EP0 为假。各切分可使用不同匹配。
5. Hall 证书证明：对每个列出的七代表，对每个实现匹配，存在三个切分中的一个
   具有 eligible 邻接。它没有把“存在邻接”升级为“存在包含它的 N10 路径”。

条件 1、2 无需挑选特殊实现匹配、特殊偶交叉端口，或排除终端桥镜像。

| DB27 | L217–239 | 独立重构七个共同删边图及 Hall 邻集，全部为空。PASS。 |
| DB28 | L201–205,L247–262 | census 与低维负例有明确外部/诊断范围，没有当作 T15、EP0 或 R8 证明。PASS。 |

##### 容易误用的细节

**tag 与双冲突。** 不能先把某个被覆盖镜像当作自由终点套 N10。
正确顺序是先以 uv 连接全局终端片段，再把所有片段压成 T，
然后将 Y 上的全部冲突组件同时压缩。由于 kj 被 M_B 内部匹配，
它不可能是 X_B、Y、u 或 t 中的端点；因此它在并图中度数恰为 1。
这排除了冲突组件成圈的可能。y1,y2 在 T 中配成一边时必须压缩整条四点路径，
不能分别压缩两个重叠的三点片段。正文采取的整体压缩合法。

**孔数核算。** 记 H_B 为原 B 孔，则最终 L 的孔集合依次为：

| 行 | δ | 最终孔集合 | 偶、奇孔数 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| (2,1) | 1 | H_B∪Y | 1,5 |
| (2,1) | 0 | (H_B\{u})∪Y | 1,5 |
| (2,0) | 1 | (H_B\{t})∪Y | 1,5 |
| (2,0) | 0 | (H_B\{u,t})∪Y | 1,5 |

Y 的暴露没有意外暴露 k1,k2，它们成为压缩边的端点。T15 因而真的适用于
任意由该构造产生的 L；不需要 L 二部，也不要求压缩边短。

**没有偶交叉端口也能处理 (2,1),δ=0。** 此时 c 为奇数且至少 1，
以自由偶孔 z1 为起点，用任意完整图配对填满 X_A∪{z2}，
留下偶 z1 与奇 w 两孔。目标 v 奇且不同于 z1，N10 条件全部满足。
要求存在偶端口会额外缩小原量词，正文没有这样做。

**EP0 端点边界。** q=v 时删除 qs 可把 v 暂时变成孤立点，
其真实交叉边把它恢复成最终终点。s=u 时同理由 ut 恢复根终点。
两者均被正文接受，不能排除来简化转移。若同时 q=v、s=u，
则 EP0 要求一条遍历 A 全部 32 点的 u–v 路径含端点边 uv；
这在简单路径中不可能，所以这个交叉组合由 EP0 自身排除，
无需增加新假设。EP0 中 qs 不属于补配边，因为 q 是补后孔，
也不属于 M_A，因为 q 原为交叉端口；故删除它不会丢失原匹配。

##### 反例及有限证据复核

本审查阅读了原 probe、solver-free verifier 和相应 JSON，随后另写一次性 Python
重构全部短边、端口、S、单切分禁边和共同禁边；没有调用匹配求解器或复用原 verifier
作为判定黑盒，也没有重写其现有结果文件。21 个见证都逐边核验：
28 边、56 个不同端点、八个孔精确、短边、孔独立、目标被覆盖、正确 `(2,0)` 行、
所有奇端口对 S 均无短邻接。

七个共同删边图的 Hall 证书重核结果如下，邻集全为空：

| v | Z | Hall 偶点集 | 缺陷 |
|---:|---|---|---:|
| 1 | 3,5,9 | 15,30,46,63 | 4 |
| 7 | 3,5,6 | 24,40,48 | 3 |
| 7 | 3,5,15 | 9,24,40,57 | 4 |
| 7 | 3,15,23 | 24,27,57,58 | 4 |
| 7 | 15,23,39 | 57,58,60,63 | 4 |
| 31 | 15,23,27 | 3,33,34 | 3 |
| 31 | 15,23,63 | 33,34,36,39 | 4 |

删边图中这些原本应覆盖的偶顶点无法匹配，因此每个实现匹配都使用至少一条删除边，
其对应切分就有 eligible 邻接。这一论证是全称的匹配排除，
但只针对七代表及其对称像；不是所有 `(2,0)` 几何上的 EP0 定理。
Q4 的诊断负例 JSON 已阅读；没有重跑 Q4 的负搜索，也没有据此断言 Q5 T15 为假。

反例尝试覆盖：v 为交叉端口；q=v；s=u；二镜像同一 T 边；tag 所在片段遇镜像；
所有交叉端口为奇；最小允许 c；qs 与 D/原匹配重合；所有可选切分均无 exposure。
前七项由上述账本排除错误或直接处理；固定切分无 exposure 确有 21 个见证；
七例中同时所有切分无 exposure 则被 Hall 证书排除。

##### 精确保留的开放义务

* **T15：OPEN。** 对任意 K(Q5) 匹配、一偶五奇孔、任意指定两奇孔的 30 点避点圈。
  本文没有证明它；A6/K6 和 Q4 诊断均不能替代这个量词。
* **合适切分上的 EP0：OPEN。** 对需要 `(2,0)` 的每个原匹配，须选出一个切分及
  r,q,D,P,s，使 P 确实包含 qs。eligible 邻接只是必要条件，不是充分证书。

不存在需要修补的 FATAL/CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR 条件证明错误；上述 OPEN 是草稿
明确声明的假设与后续研究义务，未被计作已证明。审查结论仅允许登记条件归约已通过，

<details id="review-eight-hole-conditional-reduction-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW.md — Eight-hole conditional reduction: independent review</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`f420c2570d3efd1b580379a6e0b1dfce982c6b85d56b8038ba45dabffcf43a59`。

#### Eight-hole conditional reduction: independent review

Date: 2026-11-01. **PASS for the stated conditional reduction, relative to explicit imports.**
Reviewer route: ARIS proof-checker, user-selected GPT-6.1-sol / high.
`review_independence: same-family`; `acceptance_status: provisional`.
The reviewed draft, producer census and producer result are hashed in the accompanying JSON.
The draft and main research state were not changed by this review.

The checked conclusion is **A6 implies the complete Q6 eight-hole free-target theorem**,
and the stated nine-cut criterion handles the indicated covered targets. Conditional on A6,
full eight-hole P6 is equivalent to the additional R8-covered assertion. A6 and R8-covered
remain unproved here; full P6 remains unproved. No local FATAL, CRITICAL or MAJOR gap was found.

##### Imported assumptions and dependency boundary

This review imports the perfect-matching extension theorem for arbitrary matchings of
K(Q5); N10 from [GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT.md](#proof-general-near-perfect); N14 from the initial lemma of
[TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md](#proof-two-odd-holes-transfer); full A4 from [CANONICAL_A4_CLOSURE.md](#proof-canonical-a4-closure); K4 from
[SIX_HOLE_MIXED_AND_GEOMETRY.md](#proof-six-hole-mixed-and-geometry), with its A4 assumption discharged by that closure;
and full six-hole Q6 P6 from [SIX_HOLE_CLOSED.md](#proof-six-hole-closed). These inputs are not recursively
reproved or recertified in this audit. The full six-hole and A4 packages retain their
same-family/provisional assurance and finite-certificate dependencies.

The five-direction theorem is also imported: local [paper.txt](research/six_directions/paper.txt), Theorem 8, lines 189ff.
For c=0, the original short matching avoids a coordinate. Its free root excludes C1,
C2 and C3 (each requires covering the root), so its hypotheses hold. This audit does
not recertify that theorem's computer-assisted five-dimensional input.

A6 is an explicit additional universal hypothesis about arbitrary K(Q5) matchings,
not merely short or bipartite matchings, with hole parity counts 4 and 2 and any
prescribed majority hole omitted. All imported parity statements allow exchanging
the parity classes. Consequently global parity labels can be used on either face.

Dependency DAG: perfect/N10/K4 and N14/A4/A6 -> local endpoint lemma -> nine transfer
rows; full six-hole P6 -> preliminary augmentations; five-direction theorem -> c=0;
these reductions plus the geometry certificate and root-bridge argument -> all free
targets; nine-row complement -> R8-covered characterization. No use of eight-hole P6,
R8-covered, or a consequence of either occurs upstream. Historical open-A4 wording
in older imports does not supersede the explicitly selected closure dependency.

##### Proof-obligation ledger

| ID | Application and hypothesis discharge | Result |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | Section 1, free y: adding ry is a matching, consumes two holes with parity sum h, and leaves 0,2,4 balanced holes. Perfect/N10/K4 supply a full circle; remove ry. | Closed modulo imports |
| L2 | Section 1, covered y: k=F(y), replace yk by kr. The holes replace r by y, hence imbalance h-epsilon(r)+epsilon(y)=2epsilon(y), with 2t unchanged and y free. N14/A4/A6 omits precisely y. Opening kr and restoring original ky gives the requested full path. | Closed modulo imports/A6 |
| L3 | Balanced 2/4/6-hole circle corollary: choose a short neighbor of a free root as target. A 32-vertex Hamilton path cannot already contain its endpoint edge; closing adds a permitted short edge. | Closed |
| P1 | A nonroot adjacent hole pair can be adjoined without covering u. Exactly six holes remain, so full six-hole P6 applies to the original prescribed endpoints. | Closed modulo import |
| P2 | Free v adjacent to u: adjoin uv, close a six-hole Hamilton path from another free root to its short neighbor, then delete uv. The enlarged matching really contains uv. | Closed modulo import |
| F1 | D uses only crossports and, when needed, the chosen original hole x; it is disjoint from M_A. For delta=0 the root port p is even, so p differs from odd v. | Closed |
| F2 | Removing D from the A path gives a path forest. Each crossport receives a different B endpoint. A covered v in X_A can be isolated when its D edge is deleted; its real crossedge restores its terminal segment. | Closed |
| F3 | For delta=1, D is nonempty and its removal separates u and v even if a D edge touches v. Thus rs joins distinct terminals. For delta=0, ur joins the free B root to a crossport, so its endpoints differ. | Closed |
| F4 | Bridge mirror y is internally covered: it is neither a hole (by independence and the explicit root exclusion) nor a crossport (its unique opposite-face neighbor is the free x). A nonterminal y yields exactly one M_B/R conflict. | Closed |
| F5 | In the conflict repair k is internally covered, d a crossport, and k,d,y are distinct. Thus kd forms a matching after removing yk and yd. Expansion restores both originals and the omitted y exactly once. | Closed |
| T0 | b=a+1, a=0,1,2: port imbalance b-a-delta is 0 or 1; D completion leaves A holes (a+1,a+1); after terminal closure B holes are (3-a,3-a). Every local hole total is 2,4,6. | Closed |
| TE | b=a, a=1,2,3: choose an even nonroot hole x; its odd mirror y is internal. A holes (a,a). Nonterminal repair plus rs/ur leaves (3-a,5-a), with majority hole y; use A6/A4/N14 at a=1/2/3. | Closed modulo A6 |
| TO | b=a+2, a=0,1,2: choose an odd hole x distinct from free v and with mirror y not u; A holes (a+1,a+1). Nonterminal B holes are (4-a,2-a), with majority y; use A6/A4/N14 at a=0/1/2. | Closed modulo A6 |
| TY | Terminal mirrors: TE,delta=1 has holes (3-a,4-a) plus q, allowing q-y by L1/L2; TE,delta=0 is balanced (4-a,4-a), allowing u-y. TO,delta=1 has (3-a,2-a) plus q, allowing q-y; TO,delta=0 has (4-a,2-a), allowing u-y. Root is free and y covered in each call. Totals are 2,4,6. | Closed modulo local lemma |
| RB | Section 6's failed odd-hole choice forces a=0,b=2,delta=0 and W intersect A={v,x}, x mirror of u. Pair all ports; c is even and at least 2. N10 gives x-v with exactly two odd holes. After deletion/attachment, its distinct terminal segments are u-r and s-v. M_B+R+rs has (4,2) holes including u; A6 omits u, and the terminal bridge restores it exactly once. | Closed modulo A6 |
| G | The independently implemented exhaustive free-hole census covers every remaining geometry after normalization, with no matching realizability restriction. Both canonical targets have zero uncovered geometries. | Deterministically verified |
| RC | Nine good rows and the eleven displayed bad rows partition all 20 (a,b) pairs. The four sequential branches exhaust free/covered targets after augmentation. Full eight-hole P6 implies R8-covered by specialization; under A6 the converse follows from this partition. | Closed |

In every transfer, the compressed edges occur in the local extending path/circle as
required edges. They can therefore be expanded, while rs or ur is deleted. All
surviving new edges are short: local extension edges and the selected short bridge.
Expansion of a single local path, with disjoint terminal segments, yields one global
Hamilton path; the argument is stronger than checking degrees alone.

##### Independent finite check

Reviewer-owned [EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW_check.cpp](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW_check.cpp) uses set-bit
subset enumeration, 64-bit neighbor masks, and face-intersection masks. Its good-cut
test comes from the three algebraic transfer families, rather than the producer's
four-row predicate. [EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW_check.py) compiles and
runs it, checks agreement with the producer's claimed source hash/counts, independently
verifies the residual matching, and checks the finite row partition and hole totals.
Both checkers are standalone and do not invoke the producer's census implementation.

Run: `D:\anaconda\python.exe EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW_check.py` in this directory.
Compiler: `D:\mingw64\bin\g++.exe -O3 -std=c++17`. Exit code: 0.

| normalized target | geometries | no good cut | only root-bridge good cuts |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 7 | 1,300,674 | 0 | 31 |
| 31 | 1,287,690 | 0 | 30 |
| total | 2,588,364 | 0 | 61 |

The last column counts geometries, without asserting they are realizable matchings.
It shows why ignoring the root-bridge boundary would leave the geometry argument incomplete.

Coverage justification: translation sends the chosen free root to 0, flipping parity
if necessary. An opposite-parity free target then has distance 1,3,5. The distance-1
case was proved separately. Coordinate permutations normalize distances 3 and 5 to
7 and 31. Enumerating every nonzero even triple Z not neighboring v, followed by
every odd triple outside v and all neighborhoods of Z, gives exactly every remaining
independent Z union W. Same-parity adjacency is impossible. Root-to-other-hole
adjacency is deliberately allowed. Unordered subset enumeration has no repetitions,
and it omits no geometry satisfying the stated preprocessing. The transfer proof
works for every short matching with such holes; matchings need not be enumerated.

The concrete residual witness was independently checked as 28 disjoint short edges,
with exactly holes {0,6,17,53,11,35,41,47}, covered target 4, independent nonroot holes,
and all six directions present. Its cut rows are
(1,0),(2,1),(2,1),(3,1),(1,4),(2,1), all bad. Thus it survives even the optional
six-direction restriction. It obstructs universal coverage by the nine-cut scheme;
it is not a counterexample to Hamilton extension or to A6 sufficiency by another proof.

##### Adversarial edge cases and remaining limits

Checked candidates included an arbitrary long/same-parity required edge in each local
application; free versus covered y in the local lemma; a covered v whose partner crosses
the cut; empty D for delta=0; the smallest nonempty D for delta=1; either parity of the
other terminal q; y terminal versus nonterminal; root-other-hole adjacency; c=0; and
all 61 root-bridge-only geometries in the census. No contradiction to the claimed
conditional argument was found. These attempts support but do not replace the proofs
and finite coverage argument above.

There are no open local proof gaps in the stated conditional claims. The open obligations
are the assumed A6 and the separately identified universal R8-covered endpoint statement.
No claim that A6 is logically independent of R8-covered was established. Closing even
both would still leave the 10--18-hole levels needed for full P6.

#### Independent final eight-hole proof review

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer task `/root/eight_full_closure_audit`, fresh context,

**Verdict: PASS, relative to the explicit published and previously audited

The target may be covered or free. There are no open mathematical obligations
within that exact eight-hole statement. Full P6 and the 10–18-hole layers are

##### Evidence and independence

Read the complete assembly, complete Q5 neighbor-abundance/EP0 argument, old
two-bridge transfer, free-target/A6 closure scopes, six-hole closure, all 24
imported marked-core review scopes and the historical geometry-chain reports.
The finite certificates underlying the imported core theorems are not all
re-enumerated here. Their whole-matching scope, exact marked omissions, proof
inputs, and fixed SHA256 bindings are checked. This boundary is explicit:
imported semantic theorems, rather than certificate counts, supply the
universal matching quantifier.

这些是孔几何数量，不是实现短匹配的数量。没有在本轮判定各几何是否可实现。

##### 孔投影的语义与独立重建

固定一条 a2b1 切分 i，A 含目标 v。A 中恰有偶孔 z1,z2 和奇孔 w；
设 q 为 B 中唯一的非根偶孔，即 Z 中不在 A 的那个元素。
记 `Y={z1 xor e_i,z2 xor e_i}`。

由已审通过的双桥转移，若根 u 在 A，最终局部孔是 `H_B∪Y`；
若根在 B，tagged closure 消耗 u，最终孔是 `(H_B\{u})∪Y`。
两个分支的局部孔因而都精确等于

`{q} ∪ (W∩B) ∪ Y`，其中 q 偶、其余五孔奇，指定避点恰为 Y。

Y 不与 W 重合由 Z–W 独立性保证，且 q、五个奇孔都在同一 B 面。
把 B 中全部顶点先平移 q，再删除第 i 坐标，即得到标准 Q5，q 变为 0。
由于所有点原第 i 位相同，平移后该位为 0；q 全局为偶，
因此投影后的五孔确为奇点。独立验证器采用“按坐标列表重组位”的投影实现，
没有调用作者的移位掩码公式。

三个 included 奇孔来自 W∩B；它们不与 q 短邻接，所以规范重量都大于 1。
Y 中的 avoided 奇孔允许与 q 相邻，不能把这一自由度也错误排除。
这精确解释了 analytic geometry 域中“included 从非邻奇点选，avoided 从其余奇点选”的约束。
所有 165403 个切分均逐项通过上述条件。

本轮映射是孔几何的规范化匹配，不是对某一条原匹配 M 的采样，
也没有试图从孔几何还原压缩后的完整图匹配。每个待证核心必须对其固定孔几何的
**任意**完整图匹配成立，才能用于已审的条件归约。

##### T15 条件测试与轨道分类

在投影 Q5 上，每个坐标分别检查：

* 若指定两避点分处两面，含第一避点那面的“奇孔数−偶孔数”等于 2，
  即对应已证的两孔/1:3 分离避点切分。
* 若两避点同面，且该面不含少数孔 0、恰含四个奇孔，则为同面 good cut。
* 当分离避点条件不成立时，对全部同面 good cut 的坐标分区，检查是否有
  奇数个已覆盖顶点的 cell；这是强制某个 good cut 有正交叉数的 cell-parity 条件。

所有实际投影都没有任何 direct good cut，故 split 和 cell-parity 测试都失败。
因此此次 **0** 的计算不依赖尚需审查的同面正交叉转移是否已完整成立，
也不需要假设某个原匹配的交叉数为正。

独立枚举规范少数孔为 0 的完整相关孔域：
从 11 个重量大于 1 的奇点选 3 个 included，再从另外 13 个奇点选 2 个 avoided，
共 `C(11,3) C(13,2)=12870` 个带类型孔配置。
对每个没有 direct good cut 的配置，在全部 120 个坐标置换下求
`(sorted avoided, sorted included)` 的最小值。
所得 **54 个残余轨道**及各自 `count` 与输入 JSON 逐项一致。

随后以每个真实投影的独立 canonical 最小值匹配该 54 核表，
不使用作者预先构造的反向 lookup。全部投影均找到对应核心；
实际出现 **41 个不同核心轨道**。每条父几何的所有可选 core、每条切分见证、
各核的不同父几何频数及完整 `used_cores` 内容均与 JSON 一致。

##### 23 个 greedy 核心的覆盖证书

独立从所有未覆盖父几何重算每个核心的新增覆盖量，每步选择新增量最大者，
并按核心编号较小者打破平局。23 步与原 JSON 完全一致：

`10,23,26,4,0,8,13,15,31,32,14,24,44,2,7,5,19,49,35,27,50,1,53`。

这 23 步新增覆盖量之和为 **65920**，最后未覆盖集合为空。
本审计既逐步重算 greedy 选择，也检查每个父几何至少有一个已选核心和一个真实切分见证。
核心编号以本次输入 [t15_analytic_geometry.json](research/six_directions/t15_analytic_geometry.json) 的 SHA-256 和轨道顺序为准。
没有证明这组选择最小，也没有证明任意一个被选核心的数学延拓断言。

严格的条件结论是：若分别证明这 23 个固定孔几何/避点对上的全称 T15 核心，
则通过选择已记录切分、应用已审 a2b1 双桥转移，可覆盖这 65920 个父孔几何的
所有实现短匹配。该条件不解决另 207 个无 a2b1 几何。

#### Independent fourteen-hole cached-positive review

**PASS for the twenty explicit new local inputs and their actual application.** All38,912 forests,77,594,624 connectivity bits,20 independent full GF(2) ranks,278,524 actual all-hit witnesses and35,665 chosen witnesses pass. ##### Twenty local statements, not403 new rank premises

For each selected explicit marked geometry, every arbitrary perfect matching of the covered terminals has a cycle on Q5 minus exactly its marked omissions, containing that matching with only short new edges. Auxiliary required edges may be long or same-parity. The selected exact codes are1040,1007,1186,1156,1016,1248,1148,1041,1300,1132,1118,1069,1246,1006,1251,1252,1288,161,1205,318; code1000+i denotes EXTRA i, and a code below1000 denotes NEW i. Canonical marked sets and certificate prefixes are explicitly listed in JSON `accepted_marked_inputs`. This is not full T26, T17 or T28.

[FOURTEEN_CACHED_REVIEW_local_check.cpp](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_CACHED_REVIEW_local_check.cpp) adapts the earlier independent local checker. It takes the exact selected geometry table, checks sorted config hole sets and marked omissions, validates every short forest edge, rejects duplicates and cycles, checks degrees0/2/1 at omitted/included-hole/covered vertices, and derives the actual terminal path pairings by DSU. Every stored pair and column is independently checked as a perfect matching on precisely the covered terminal set. Every matrix bit is rebuilt by a fresh labeled matching-union connectivity computation. Low-pivot Gaussian elimination on rebuilt rows gives full rank independently of producer pivots/flags. All supplied combination equations and pivot-leading-position assertions also pass.

| Type | Exact inputs | Terminals | Rank each | Forests | Rebuilt bits |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|T26|10|24|2048|20480|41943040|
|T17 unconditional|8|24|2048|16384|33554432|
|T28 unconditional|2|22|1024|2048|2097152|
|Total|20|—|—|38912|77594624|

The mathematical rank import is the generic upper bound rank(H_t)<=2^(t/2-1) over GF(2) for all even t, on arbitrary complete-graph perfect matchings, from [Cygan, Kratsch and Nederlof](https://arxiv.org/abs/1211.1506). The primary source was independently reopened during this review; its abstract explicitly confirms the generic bound and complete-graph scope. Here the import is used at t=22 and t=24; the older A10 source note's original t=22-only application does not restrict the published generic theorem.

The verified submatrix has rank equal to that upper bound, so its selected endpoint-pairing rows span the entire matching-connectivity row space. For any arbitrary required matching F, a matching P that joins its oriented edges cyclically gives a nonzero H-column. Therefore a selected row must also be nonzero in that column. Its actual forest and F form one connected2-regular labeled graph on the included vertices and hence the required cycle. Any common forest/F edge would give a separate labeled two-edge component and fail connectivity because there are at least22 terminals. Thus all surviving added physical edges are short. This is a deterministic universal proof modulo the generic rank theorem, not a sampled-matching inference.

##### Actual application and exact unions

The source is the accepted first-stage48,211-record original-label domain. The independent application checker uses the k7 construction and completion/suppression/expansion proof in [FOURTEEN_REUSE_REVIEW.md](#review-fourteen-reuse-review). Every realizing original matching is short, the actual sources exclude free target/root mirror, and the synchronous actual marked B geometry is within the exact universal local input. No forced obstruction or unreviewed A theorem is used.

[FOURTEEN_REVIEW_prepare.py](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_REVIEW_prepare.py) independently expands all403 explicit geometry predicates and the20 selected predicates using common anchored translations/permutations. It does not use producer positive-rank flags as acceptance. `FOURTEEN_REVIEW_application_check.cpp . 2` enumerates actual legal cuts/source subsets for every record, verifies all278,524 record/orbit witnesses against their named exact geometry, and compares the complete recomputed orbit-hit set with the supplied all-hit set record by record. It checks that selected20 and all403 geometry predicates have exactly the same covered-record union. It replays every selected witness, requires its exact row among the20 accepted rows, and verifies the complete residual byte/order partition. The other383 local-rank claims are not premises and are not accepted by this report.

##### Direct Hall proof and finite gate

A short matching with fourteen holes has seven holes of each parity and
25 covered vertices of each parity. Let E,O be the actual covered even
and odd sets. Every vertex of E must be paired bijectively with a distinct
vertex of O at cube distance one. If a nonempty S subset E has its entire
covered odd neighborhood T=N(S) intersect O strictly smaller than S, the
partners of S would give an injection S into T, a contradiction. This is
a direct finite counting proof, independent of any matching solver.

The fresh [FOURTEEN_HALL_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_HALL_REVIEW_check.py) imports no producer module and
executes no producer checker or search. It validates all 18 manifest-bound
hashes and sizes, reads the six thirteen-byte source streams and validates
all 12,546 records: sorted unique Z6/W7, correct parity and range, root
exclusion, nonroot hole independence, exact covered/free target status,
and full hole independence for free-target records. It checks unique
records within each target/status domain and seven holes per parity.

Each of the 8,623 little-endian `<BBIQQ` records is independently parsed.
The target/status must identify an actual input stream, the source index
must be in range and unused, and the S mask must encode a nonempty subset
of the actual covered even vertices. The checker generates every one of
the six cube neighbors of every vertex of S, intersects with the actual
covered odd set, and requires exact equality with the stored T mask.
It then checks the strict deficiency. No omitted neighbor or diagnostic
solver verdict can certify an exclusion.

with (|S|,|T|)=(1,0), and 627 with (25,24). Indices are unique within each

##### Quantified statement and proof-obligation ledger

For every original short matching M realizing
Z={39,43,45,51,60,63}, W={1,2,4,8,14,16,32}, root0 and covered target31,
there is a Hamilton 0--31 path retaining every M edge and adding only short
edges. The statement transports under the actual common cube automorphisms
fixing0,31; its entire accepted application domain is the 60 checked images.
The following closes each nontrivial obligation.

1. **Actual induced A domain.** In the bit32 cut, A's original holes are
   {0} union J, J={1,2,4,8,14,16}. Hence G has 15 even and 10 odd vertices.
   T=mirror(Z)={7,11,13,19,28,31} consists of covered A vertices whose B
   mirrors are holes. Since M is short, these vertices cannot cross and
   are internally L=M|A covered. In particular31 has an internal even
   mate h, unchanged by extending L. All unmatched G vertices are exactly
   original crossing ports, not unfilled original holes.
2. **Maximalization and quantifiers.** Greedily add disjoint G edges to
   obtain any inclusion-maximal Lstar containing L. It still covers T,
   and has at most10 edges. No maximum-cardinality assumption is used.
   The independently enumerated whole maximal domain supplies a positive
   witness for this actual Lstar; witness selection may depend on M through
   Lstar. This proves a universal-in-M existence assertion.
3. **Finite witness soundness.** Each selected q is even and Lstar-unmatched;
   t is in T minus31 and adjacent to q; w,b are distinct units in J. The
   selected physical P is short on A minus{0,31}, has degrees2 exactly at
   q,b and degrees1 elsewhere, and contains q-t. Replace31-h in Lstar by
   w-h to obtain Lstarprime. This auxiliary edge may be long, which is
   permitted at this stage. Labelled P+Lstarprime is acyclic: duplicated
   edges are rejected as two-edge cycles rather than collapsed.
4. **Exact endpoints and completion.** Write Xstar=G minus V(Lstar) and
   S=J minus{w,b}. The endpoint set is exactly
   Qstar=(Xstar minus{q}) union S, with14-|Lstar| endpoints of each parity.
   Thus there are at least8 endpoints and at least4 path components.
   The numbers of even-even and odd-odd path components agree. If they
   are nonzero, cyclically alternate these types and insert all mixed
   components in one transition with orientations making every join
   opposite-parity. If all components are mixed, orient each even-to-odd
   and concatenate cyclically. These joins form a matching Dstar between
   distinct components, giving one simple30-cycle. There are at least4
   components, so no physical edge can coincide with an existing path
   edge. Dstar need not be short and later disappears.
5. **Lift to the arbitrary actual L.** Since31 is already covered in L,
   its mate h is unchanged and Lprime=L-31h+wh is a submatching of
   Lstarprime. Put D=Dstar union(Lstarprime minus Lprime). This is a
   matching: the added difference is a submatching of Lstarprime, whose
   covered vertices avoid Dstar. Its support is exactly
   (X minus{q}) union S, with X=G minus V(L), by taking the difference
   of the covered vertex sets. Consequently C_A=P+Lprime+D is the same
   simple30-cycle. This algebra proves the lift simultaneously for every
   submatching L covering T; enumeration of only favorable original M
   is not being substituted. Hole14 belongs to S for every option and
   is covered by Dstar, never by Lstar. The original extra hole is not
   silently counted as an original crossing port.
6. **Opening and attachment.** Both q and t avoid D: q is unmatched in
   Lstar and excluded from Qstar; t is originally internally L-covered
   and still covered by Lprime. Also q-t is not required by Lprime,
   since q was an actual crossing port. Delete D and q-t from C_A.
   These are disjoint edges and leave a path forest with endpoints
   exactly X union S union{t}. Attach all actual M crossings, the four
   short S bridges, and t--mirror(t). The latter consumes an original Z
   hole, so has no original B conflict. Every retained A vertex now has
   degree2, and every retained required A edge remains present.
7. **Simultaneous suppression is legal.** The B attachment set is the
   disjoint union of actual crossing endpoints, Y=mirror(S), and
   mirror(t). Every Y vertex was originally internally B-covered,
   because its A mirror was an original hole. Y is one parity, its
   original mates are distinct and opposite parity, and those mates
   lie outside all attachment endpoints by matching disjointness.
   Thus each conflict is a pendant original B edge. Even when an A
   transfer joins two Y vertices, suppressing both gives a path between
   their distinct mates, not a cycle. No internal A cycle is present,
   since a nonempty matching was removed from a simple A cycle.
8. **Actual compressed local domain.** After suppressing those paths the
   B matching has minority hole{32}, majority holes
   (Z minus{mirror(t)}) union Y, and omissions exactly Y. These are
   1,9,4 distinct vertices respectively. It is an arbitrary perfect
   matching on the22 covered B vertices. The local theorem permits
   arbitrary required matching edges, so the compression need not
   preserve shortness. All208 full finite options independently match
   an accepted minority/majority/omission/forced-hole/pair tuple under
   one common coordinate permutation, rather than separate set maps.
9. **Actual R obstruction, not original-only exclusion.** For each option
   its transported R has two same-parity endpoints outside holes and
   intersects {mirror(w),mirror(b)}. Either protected vertex is originally
   internally B-covered: its A mirror is an original hole. It is outside
   Y, consumed Z, and every original crossing port. Its actual short
   original B edge survives all compression unchanged: its mate has
   parity opposite Y and hence cannot be suppressed at Y. Since the
   other endpoint of R has the same parity as the protected vertex,
   that actual surviving edge is different from R. The actual compressed
   matching therefore cannot contain R. Checking only original M_B
   would have been insufficient; the unchanged-edge argument is essential.
10. **Invoke local theorem with every hypothesis.** The actual marked
    1:9:4 domain and arbitrary perfect matching satisfy the transported
    accepted T19 iff theorem; item9 discharges its only obstruction.
    It yields a cycle on B minus Y retaining the compressed matching,
    with all newly added edges short. Expand each compressed edge and
    suppressed original edge. Distinct interiors and the local single
    cycle give one62-cycle on Q6 minus{0,31}, containing all of
    F=M-31h+wh. All auxiliary D edges and placeholders have disappeared.
11. **Restore the original matching and endpoints.** The62-cycle contains
    the auxiliary wh. Delete it, prepend short0-w, and append the original
    short h-31. Since w was an original hole, wh was not an original
    required edge. The resulting Hamilton0--31 path preserves all original
    edges, including the restored31-h, and adds only short physical edges.
12. **Finite domain completeness.** A fresh recursion processes the actual
    ten odd G vertices, tries every currently unused short even partner,
    and also permits an unmatched choice exactly outside T. A leaf is
    inclusion-maximal iff every neighbor of each unmatched odd is used.
    This is necessary and sufficient because G is bipartite. Its exact
    set of partner words has 287,469 elements. Every legal certificate
    word occurs in that independent set exactly once, and the sets are
    equal. Hence no size8/9 maximal input, optional unmatched vertex,
    or boundary case can be omitted through a claimed cardinality alone.
13. **Exact application and inherited branch.** Independently applying all
    120 permutations of the low five coordinates gives exactly60 images
    of the full Z/W representative. All60 are in the accepted FORCED
    v31 residual. Every supplied actual transport is checked simultaneously
    against its actual source index and full record, fixing root0,target31.
    The positive streams and complementary streams agree byte-for-byte
    with the independent partition. There is no overlap with an earlier
    accepted subtraction. Free-target closure is inherited solely from
    the bound accepted FORCED source; this proof makes no new free claim.

##### Independent finite results and attempted failures

The exact domain count is 274,691 size10 +12,772 size9 +6 size8 =287,469.
Every selected record passed matching legality, T coverage, uniqueness,

Its exact support is the actual A crossing ports minus q, together with S=J minus w,b. Thus CA=P+Lprime+D is the same cycle for every original submatching. Therefore D and q-t are disjoint and neither deletion removes an original required Lprime edge. Deleting them from CA leaves paths with endpoints exactly actual ports union S union{t}. Every one of those120 images occurs once in the accepted source, with a checked simultaneous source-index transport, and all exact complements match. Inverting the transport restores original prescribed endpoints. |

##### Independent complete finite A gate

[FOURTEEN_STAR_EXPANDED_REVIEW_A.cpp](research/six_directions/FOURTEEN_STAR_EXPANDED_REVIEW_A.cpp) is a new checker. It does not invoke
or import the producer pilot, counts or option search. It partitions the

<details id="review-four-hole-sol-high-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.md — Z18 四孔全目标：独立 Sol high 审计</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`e6899b399a59837d154239741d6244e2486509f15c3e3cff9d9f3767d3852603`。

#### Z18 四孔全目标：独立 Sol high 审计

审计日期：2026-11-01。请求配置：`requested_model=gpt-6.1-sol`、`requested_effort=high`。reviewer 的请求配置由父代理 `spawn_agent` 指定，并非本代理对服务端实际型号的自测或证明；主执行器型号未取得运行时见证，记为 `runtime-not-attested`。本报告由新上下文审计代理从原证明重新推导；没有读取旧审计结论作为依据。没有派子代理，没有修改主证明。审计的语义保证为 `same-family / provisional`，不是跨模型族接受，也不是形式化验证。

##### Claim / Status

精确结论：对每个 $M\subseteq E(Q_6)$，若其自由集恰有四点，则对每个自由点 $u$ 和每个满足 $p(v)\ne p(u)$ 的顶点 $v$，存在遍历全部顶点并包含全部 $M$ 的 $u$—$v$ 路径。

**PROVABLE AS STATED（相对于明确列出的外部定理输入）；审计 PASS，provisional。** 本轮没有发现 FATAL、CRITICAL、MAJOR 缺口，也没有找到反例。下文补写几个容易压缩过度的推导；它们不增加假设。主结论仍限于四孔短匹配。`full_p6_proved=false`：一般六孔及更多孔没有由此获得证明。

##### Assumptions / Notation

$V(Q_n)=\{0,1\}^n$；$p$ 为坐标和模二；$e_i$ 为第 $i$ 坐标单位向量；短边的汉明距离为一。$K(Q_n)$ 允许任意不同端点，$B(Q_n)$ 只允许异奇偶端点。所谓延拓只允许新增短边，但输入中已有的长边必须保留。坐标面限制的奇偶与局部标准奇偶至多整体翻转，因而同/异奇偶关系不变。

对短匹配平移 $x\mapsto x\oplus u$ 后可令 $u=0$；该双射保持短边、不同顶点、Hamilton 性、方向数、同/异奇偶关系。孔于是为不同的偶点 $u,z$ 和奇点 $w,t$。被覆盖的奇目标 $v$ 有偶伙伴 $h=M(v)$，且 $h\ne u$。因此

$$M^*=(M\setminus\{vh\})\cup\{hu\}$$

为匹配，孔恰为 $v,z,w,t$；$hu$ 是同偶长边，确实不可能是短边。原文的“唯一可能的长边”是安全的宽松措辞。跨边在这里意为两端分处坐标面，不要求为该方向的短边。

##### External inputs and hypothesis discharge

独立读取 [Fink–Mütze 作者全文](https://tmuetze.de/papers/match.pdf) 第 1、3、4 页；只将其 Theorems 2、8、9、12 和 extension 的定义作为外部输入。其条件分别为完整图完美匹配、避指定点且满足半层条件 (H)、二部完美匹配端点压缩无半层、以及完整图删异奇偶两点后的完美匹配无半层。下列应用全部保持各自的完整图/二部图区别；所有避孔定理的维数均至少五。

独立读取本地 [paper.txt](research/six_directions/paper.txt) 中 Fink–Hotmar Theorem 8 及 C1/C2/C3（并核对本地 PDF 存在）。该输入要求 $n\ge5$、短匹配、使用至多五方向、端点异奇偶。Z14 零跨边和 Z17 第 4 节确实证明的是**原短匹配**完全不使用一个方向，根 $u$ 在原匹配中自由。C1 要求根被半层覆盖，C2 要求根 incident 的指定匹配边，C3 要求 $uv\in M$；自由根逐个排除三者。因此可用该定理，未把 $M^*$ 或任意长边匹配送入五方向输入。此输入和作者避点定理含其论文自己的计算辅助基例；本报告将定理作为引用输入，没有复现其整篇证明或基例程序。

##### Dependency DAG

$$\begin{aligned}
&\text{FM2,FM9}\to N6\to N7\to N8,\\
&\text{FM2,FM8}\to N10,\qquad \text{FM8}\to N14,\\
&\text{FM12}\to N11,\qquad\text{半层几何}\to N12,E2,\\
&N11,N10\to Z9,\quad N12\to\text{Z9 的充分条件},\\
&N14,N10,N8,\text{五方向输入}\to Z14,\\
&N14,N8,N10\to Z15,\quad N11,N12,N14\to Z16,\\
&Z9,N12,E2,Z16,\text{五方向输入}\to Z17,\\
&N8,N10,Z14,Z15,Z17\to Z18.
\end{aligned}$$

N14 直接从 FM8 证明，不反向依赖 Z14 或 N10；E2 独立于同文件 E3/Z11；没有以更早四孔全称结论作输入，无语义循环。无需假设 Z8、Z11 或完整 P6。
