##### Exact scope and imports

The quantified conclusion is: for every one of the eight marked geometries
13,14,19,31,32,35,37,38, for every complete-graph matching whose holes are
exactly that geometry, there exists a simple cycle with support exactly the
30 vertices outside the specified two omitted majority holes, containing
every prescribed edge and using only cube edges elsewhere. Prescribed
edges may cross the chosen cut arbitrarily, have any length, or have equal
endpoint parity. Cube automorphisms transport this conclusion to each whole
marked orbit; the omitted pair remains the omitted pair.

Explicitly imported, rather than reproved in this invocation:

1. The exact, previously audited Q4 two-opposite-hole negative tables for
   holes 0,1 and 0,7, including the positive complement of their 51 and 53
   exceptions. The actual exception edge sets, not status/count fields,
   are used as input. Coordinate permutations give all eight odd targets.
2. Q4 A4_4 for any arbitrary matching with four holes of parity type 1:3,
   omitting a specified majority hole; only this finite Q4 result from
   [Q4_CORE_AND_A4_SPLIT.md](#proof-q4-core-and-a4-split) is used.
3. The exact finite Q4 T15 classification in [Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION.md](#proof-q4-t15-classification):
   failure requires both omitted majority holes adjacent to the minority
   and a prescribed edge between the two other neighbors. Only its
   sufficient consequence when one omitted hole is nonadjacent is used.

Prior audit verdicts were not substituted for new checks on the candidate.
This audit does not newly revalidate the original Q4 binary tables or
certificates; that is the declared boundary of the imported results.

##### Obligation ledger and dependency DAG

Symbols: A,B are disjoint 16-vertex faces; local vertex labels lie in
0,...,15; 0 is the omitted A vertex; a is the even B minority; x is the
omitted odd B vertex; I is its three included odd holes. F_A,F_B are
matchings; C is a crossing matching of size c; X_A,X_B its distinct port
sets; d is a free A root; D pairs all A ports except d; L=F_A union D;
S is the eligible odd target set; good roots refer to existence of an
individual completion for that fixed root and target. R denotes a formal
matching of pairwise interior-disjoint paths, not actual new long edges.

The acyclic proof chain is Q4 exact tables -> exact A path test -> failure
states -> stalled partials -> good-root sets and Hall obstruction. Separately,
Q4 A4/T15 -> safe and occupied transfer. The previous two chains close every
case except four c=1 families. Independent A input coverage + exhaustive B
pairings + positive witnesses -> optional spectra -> pairwise intersection
-> two-cycle switch closes those final families. No node invokes Q5 T15,
P6, or a consequence requiring the candidate conclusion.

| MC25 | All crossing counts, partials, B matching choices, and crossing bijections are covered | MC03, MC09-13, MC21-24 |

No limit interchanges, probability-mode upgrades, asymptotic constants, or
uniformity assumptions arise: all quantifiers range over explicit finite sets.

##### Sensitive boundary arguments

**Exact path test (candidate lines 69-83).** In a d--z path containing L,
the z endpoint must use its sole prescribed incident edge zk. Removing z
therefore leaves a spanning d--k path on 14 vertices. Its endpoint edge dk
cannot already occur: a path with more than two vertices cannot contain its
endpoint-to-endpoint edge. Adding dk closes it. Conversely remove the
required dk from a 14-cycle and append the original kz. Even if dk is long,
it is removed in expansion; kz is prescribed. There is no unverified
shortness assumption. The impossible z=d case is handled explicitly.

**Safe forest (lines 93-115).** D is a matching contained in a simple path.
Its removal makes a path forest. Every nonendpoint port loses its D edge
and regains degree one after its original crossing is attached; d gains
its crossing; z gains its bridge. If z_A is a port, it loses its final D
edge and becomes isolated, then gains two distinct incident edges: its
original crossing and the new bridge to the safe B vertex. The B endpoints
are distinct because the bridge endpoint is outside X_B. This is still a
path, not a lost vertex or a closed component. All resulting interiors are
disjoint, which licenses compression and expansion.

**Occupied forest (lines 117-132).** Here the root is chosen *after the
actual crossing C is fixed*: d=C inverse(z_B). It is required to be good for
this z, which means existence of some D for this fixed root. Since c>=3,
D is nonempty. Removing even one D edge from the d--z path separates d
and z, including the case that the final D edge isolates z. The crossing
at d attaches z_B to the d component. The bridge then connects that
component to the different z component. It cannot close a cycle. If z_A
is another port, its original crossing has a B endpoint different from
z_B by injectivity of C. The final forest endpoints are exactly
X_B minus {z_B}, with interiors A minus {0} together with z_B. The excluded
c=1 case would lack this separation and is not incorrectly passed here.

**Hall quantifiers (lines 134-178).** If all available z are occupied and no
occupied transfer works, actual C gives an injection from available z into
A ports, assigning each z a bad root. Rejecting every such injection is
stronger than needed and covers every B port set and crossing bijection.
A good root need not use one globally common D: after selecting z and its
actual root, its own witnessing D can be chosen. Thus no forall/exists
exchange is hidden in the good-root argument.

**One-crossing cycle switch (lines 180-220).** Each individual pair may
choose a different common edge and different witnessing path/cycle.
Membership in both *unions* is sufficient: it supplies a witness on each
side for that selected edge; spectra need not be maximal. C_A uses
A minus {0} and h_B, while C_B uses B minus {x,h}, so their supports are
disjoint and total 30. A common optional edge avoids 0,x,h. Deleting one
edge from each cycle produces two paths; the two corresponding bridges
connect their four distinct endpoints into a single cycle. Neither deleted
edge is prescribed, and the sole prescribed crossing d_A h_B survives.
The independent checker checks degree two, connectedness, exact support,
prescribed-edge containment and new-edge shortness for every pair.

Adversarial cases examined: d=z; endpoint z carried by D rather than F_A;

#### T44_5 完整闭合证明：独立审计

日期：2026-11-01。ARIS proof-checker，用户指定 GPT-6.1-sol / high 路由。

##### 完整有限覆盖重新计算

新脚本直接读取两张 Q4 二进制避双孔圈表，不导入作者脚本，也不以其逆像
异常 JSON 作为坏状态的计算依据。对每份文件重新检查全部135135个有效、
互不重复的 mate involution；这一数目恰等于14点完整图的13!!个完美匹配，
故覆盖没有遗漏。所有正圈逐边核验：顶点恰为非避点、原边全在、新边全短。
51和53个负记录另行枚举全部不重叠短补完美匹配，所得318个2-factor
没有一个连通。每个可能扩圈必须由原匹配加这样一个短补匹配构成，故负判定
是穷尽证明。二进制负集合与作者 exception JSON 精确一致。

通过坐标置换把两类坏表传到全部8个奇目标。随后**正向遍历全部2027025个**
`(d,L)`：15种根，每根13!!种匹配；对两个目标族分别直接实行
`T_z=L−zk+dk`，并明确将 `z=d` 标为不可行。独立得到双目标失败状态
恰256和187个。此步骤不依赖作者“逆像并集穷尽”的计算推理，
同时语义核验了该逆像推理本身：任一失败且z≠d的正向状态都能从负表中
其人工边dk的方向唯一恢复；两个不同目标不可能同时等于d。

对双目标失败状态的所有所需大小子匹配计数。一个c端口局部匹配恰有
`c(c−2)!!`个不同的带根补全；计数达到该数当且仅当所有补全都双失败。
每一个stalled匹配集合都与作者JSON逐项相等，数量为：

| 目标 | c=1 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 9 | 11 | 13 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| (7,11) | 256 | 210 | 42 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| (2,14) | 187 | 110 | 21 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

进一步对这些stalled匹配，直接逐根枚举其所有配对D，对每个奇目标计算
实际失败补全数。所有 `bad_counts`、`good_roots` 和排除禁点1后的G
与作者JSON逐项精确相等；没有用逆像计数替代本步骤的正向补全验证。
好根含义严格是“对该指定根，存在一个D”，没有将存在根误用成任意根。

注入阻断另用 **Hall 子集检验**，没有复用作者的回溯注入DFS：
对每个非空S⊆G，计算所有坏根的并N(S)。若某S满足|N(S)|<|S|，
则不存在把每个z分配给坏根的注入。这正是所需的匹配阻断条件。

所有c=1输入均满足|G|>1。两族全部层的unresolved均为0。
因此实际B端口集及实际交叉边伙伴任意取值也被覆盖，而不是有限Q5样例检验。

##### 规范化与几何覆盖

平移一个指定孔为0保短，另一个同奇偶孔的距离只能2或4；置换分别变3或15。
同时切开指定孔对和另一孔对的坐标存在，当且仅当两差分支持相交。
若指定孔距4，另一差分非零且偶重，不能支持在唯一剩余坐标上，所以总有此切分。

距2时，独立枚举其余14个偶点的全部91个无序对，支持不交的恰18对。
保持{0,3}的群由平移0或3、前两坐标置换及后三坐标置换组成。
直接生成三代表(12,20)、(5,9)、(5,29)的群轨道，每轨道6对，彼此不交、
并集精确等于该18对。中间代表在共同坐标面；另外两代表按草稿所述
选择A的奇/偶面、删坐标0并在第一族同时平移局部标签1，确实分别得到
A唯一孔0、B三孔{1,7,11}或{1,2,14}；被禁孔确实为0_A与1_B。
同一局部标签在两面对应短桥。全局孔奇偶相同，而两面局部孔奇偶相反。

两孔各在一面的切分，正交叉用N14_4和片段压缩，零交叉用
[Q4_RICH_GLUING.md](#proof-q4-rich-gluing)；全孔同面，正交叉用T44_4及Fink，零交叉用
[T44_SAMEFACE_ZERO_CROSSING.md](#proof-t44-sameface-zero-crossing)。这两套切分再加上述两个规范族穷尽全部几何。
规范族计数 `2|F_A|+c=15` 强制c奇且正；B有三孔强制c≤13。

##### 局部路径与拼接的语义审计

令L=F_A∪D有孔0,d，奇z≠d必被L覆盖。k=L(z)，置换边zk到dk后得到
恰有孔0,z的T_z。其14圈删dk后成为d–k路径，再接原边kz，得到
A\0上的15点d–z路径P。反向删除端点z时必删其原L边zk，再闭人工dk，
确实得到所需14圈；长路径两端不可能已经是路径上的另一条端点连边。
故此处可用完整正负表作精确判定，并非仅有充分性。

删D时不能漏掉z本身为A端口的情形：若z∈X_A−{d}，它的L边属于D，
又因z是P端点，该边为唯一P边，删后z暂时孤立。它随即接自己的原交叉边
及新短桥，两条边恢复度2；同样不丢任何F_A边。D与F_A不交。

安全情形z∉X_B，所有附加B端点彼此不同，结果是路径森林，内部精确分割
A\0，端点为X_B∪{z}。孤立的z_A附接后给出一个有效两边路径；
不会产生零长度压缩边或圈。压缩成R后：

* z=f或g时，F_B∪R只剩两个奇孔，含禁点1，N14_4避1；
  15个B点加15个A点，正好30。
* 其他安全z不等于1、f、g且不为B端口，故内部原边zk存在。
  q=R(z)是B端口、k为F_B内点，二者不同。把zk,zq抑制成kq后，
  恰四个不同奇孔{1,f,g,z}。T44_4避1,z；展开恢复z_B及其原边，
  再恢复15个A点，计14+1+15=30。

占用情形z∈X_B时，选实际原交叉伙伴为d，并为**这个根**选一个成功D。
可行性保证d≠z；桥不是已存在原交叉边。c≥3保证D非空。
P端点d,z的唯一路径包含每条D边，所以删D后这两个端点属于不同分量；
即便z因删末边变孤立，此事实仍成立。原交叉附接只给各A端口添加不同的
B叶子，不能合并A分量。z_B此时只附着d分量，新桥把它接到另一个z分量，
不会形成圈。若z也是A端口，其原交叉的B端点与z_B不同，因为原交叉伙伴
是一一对应，且d≠z。这一孤点边界因此确实成立。

结果为端点X_B\{z}的路径森林，其内部精确分割(A\0)∪{z_B}。
压缩后F_B∪R是合法匹配，其四孔{1,f,g,z}全奇且互异：B端口不可能为
原孔1,f,g。T44_4避1,z，展开恢复z_B、15个A点及所有原交叉边，
再次得到30点简单圈。D已删、R或抑制边已展开，所有存留的非F边来自
Q4证书的短边或新增同标签短桥。原长边始终作为规定边保留。

c=1若使用占用步骤会在A侧形成一个闭分量；草稿明确排除，独立完整计数
证明每个此类stalled输入都有安全端点，故没有以非法边界代替证明。

等价的适用条件已检查：若 P(0)=y，任何含该边的0–y路径会只有两个顶点，
故该目标必坏。否则令 a=P(0)、b=P(y)，则0,y,a,b不同，
`T=P−{0a,yb}+{ab}` 恰有孔0,y。所需路径与包含 T 的14点避双孔圈相互转换，
人工 ab 只在中间存在，原匹配边在展开时全部恢复。

因此任何不在逆像候选中的完美匹配，至多有其奇数根伴点这个坏目标，

异奇偶可行端点；完整分类没有遗漏其他可能的多坏目标匹配。

由三个不同单位向量构成的两类集合
`{ei,ej,ek}`、`{ei,ej,ei xor ej xor ek}` 共16个。
独立程序直接生成这16个集合，并确认没有一个包含于任一精确异常坏集合。
候选外最多一个坏端点也不可能包含三元集合。故这些 triples 对所有任意完整图
完美匹配确实为 hitting sets，平移给出任意根版本。

##### 语义推理与量词

固定任意 A 中四孔同奇偶匹配 L、B 中任意完美匹配 P，以及指定避孔 x,y。
把 x 平移到0，置换令 y=3或15；四孔变偶，另两孔记 b<t。
同一个 Q4 自同构必须同时作用于两面，使短桥端点对应不变。
P 经变换仍是任意完整图完美匹配，未增加约束。

由完整正路径表，对 L 存在端点集合 S，且或者 |S|≥5，
或者 S xor b 含一个 hitting triple。P 的可行端点集合 G(P,b) 至少4个，
与 S 均位于同一个8点异奇偶类：

* |S|≥5 时，5+4>8，交集非空；
* 低集合情形，由平移后的 hitting-triple 定理，同样交集非空。

选交点 q 后，两条路径独立选择：A 路径精确覆盖14个非避点，
B 路径覆盖全部16个点；都从对应 b 到对应 q，q 与 b 异奇偶，因而不同。
添加 b–bar(b)、q–bar(q) 两条短桥得到一个圈。
两个端点都在 A 路径内，绝不等于被避开的 x,y。
两个路径的顶点支持在不同面而不交，圈共30点，原匹配边全保留。
没有原交叉边需要恢复，所以新增桥不会与任何原边冲突。

量词为“对每个 L、每个 P，存在 q 和两条路径”，
不需要同一个 q 对所有 P 有效，也未把 S 中所有端点同时处方给一条路径。

<details id="review-ten-covered-q5-endpoint-review" class="source-doc" markdown="1">
<summary>TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.md — Ten-hole row (4,5) and exact combined residual: independent review</summary>

原件：[打开文件](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.md)。SHA-256：`dac526f03f38b679384266f1c41eeeb817fee75d6674559c1fcd805522806781`。

#### Ten-hole row (4,5) and exact combined residual: independent review

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-checker `/root/a10_final_rank_review`; explicit
`gpt-6.1-sol / high`; **same-family / provisional**.

**PASS relative to the final accepted full Q5 endpoint and uniform transfer
imports.** Row (4,5) uniformly covers 70 additional ten-hole covered-target
geometries, 10/30/30 for targets1/7/31. These additions are disjoint from
the separately accepted marked-T63 additions of12916. The exact combined
remaining domain has12910/12696/15630 records, total **41236 OPEN**.
These are unresolved geometries, not counterexamples. Complete ten-hole
covered targets, remaining complete Q6 layers and full P6 remain OPEN.

##### Input gates and scope

The submission is [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_APPLICATION.md](#proof-ten-covered-q5-endpoint-application), with its filter
source, frozen output JSON and remaining files. [Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_A10_FULL_REVIEW.json)
is final PASS before this review: its accepted consequences include the
balanced five-plus-five-hole Q5 endpoint statement for every arbitrary
complete-graph matching, every free root and opposite-parity target.
[Q5_T63_COMPLETE_SPLIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/Q5_T63_COMPLETE_SPLIT_REVIEW.json) and
[TEN_COVERED_T63_SPLIT_REVIEW.json](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_T63_SPLIT_REVIEW.json) are also final PASS before the combined
gate. Their marked split scope, not unrestricted T63, is the only T63
result used. The uniform-transfer source/review and accepted preceding
54222-record domain are source-bound by current SHA256 comparisons.

The application quantifies over every short Q6 matching realizing each
accepted independent-hole geometry, with free even root u=0 and odd covered
target v. Its geometry test does not select or sample a favorable matching.

##### Semantic proof replay

The old transfer's stated b<=3 bound served its limited A-side endpoint
imports. It is not sufficient merely to cite that old numerical statement
for b=5. I replayed its construction with the newly accepted local theorem:

1. In the target-oriented coordinate face A assume (a,b)=(4,5), so every
   nonroot hole lies in A. In the even-consumption construction s=a+1−b=0;
   there are no bridge sources or marked B omissions.
2. For c>0 and u in A, shortness gives even c, hence c>=2. Pair all A
   crossing ports into arbitrary completion D and let r=u. The completed
   A matching has exactly five holes per global parity. D is nonempty.
3. For u in B, port imbalance p_even−p_odd=b−a=1 supplies an even port r.
   Pair all other ports into D, leaving r free. The completed A matching
   again has exactly five holes of each parity. The c=1,D=empty boundary
   is legal. An arbitrary D may create long/same-parity requirements;
   the new full Q5 endpoint theorem explicitly accepts them.
4. In either case the covered odd v is an allowed opposite-parity target.
   Take its Hamilton r–v A path, delete D and attach every original crossing
   edge. Add the labelled temporary tag uv. If u in A, deleting a nonempty
   D separates the two true endpoint segments before tagging. If u in B,
   tagging extends the terminal segment to the previously untouched u.
   Thus the tagged graph is a forest and compresses to a matching T on B.
5. There is no Y conflict set because s=0. T and the original internal B
   matching have disjoint covered endpoints: its ports and B-root were
   previously free. The complete B matching L has hole counts
   (k−a−1,k−b+s)=(0,0). Apply the imported arbitrary perfect-matching cycle
   extension theorem, expand each recorded transferred path, and delete
   the unique tag. Every original edge is restored. All surviving new
   physical edges are short; D and compressed edges do not survive.
6. For c=0 use the explicit established five-direction endpoint input as
   in the accepted transfer. No higher-hole Q6 theorem is used to obtain
   the new Q5 endpoint import or establish this cut application.

This proves the actual new row without extrapolating an unsupported bound.
The proof also includes v being a crossing port and the root-face boundary
cases covered by the accepted tagged-forest construction. There is no
hidden dependence on unproved unrestricted T63 or full ten-hole coverage.

##### Independent full scan and exact partition

New [TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW_check.py](research/six_directions/TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW_check.py) imports or executes no producer
code. It validates every input record's labels, parity, sorted halves,
distinct holes, free root, covered target and Z–W independence. For every
record it constructs all six actual target-oriented faces as vertex sets
and counts their Z and W intersections. Every qualifying real cut is
recognized. All70 stored producer witnesses agree with this independent
calculation, including their original record indices and minimum cut.

| Target | Accepted input | New Q5 row | New marked T63 | Combined remaining |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|1|16920|10|4000|12910|
|7|17022|30|4296|12696|

Conversely the checked selected forests have exactly that interface. Their endpoint pairing is a perfect matching P on24 covered terminals and always contains pq.

**MC4 — path suppression when pq is absent.** For arbitrary F not containing pq, put a=F(p), b=F(q). Matching disjointness and pq absence make a,b,p,q distinct. Delete pa,qb and replace them with ab, giving a valid arbitrary matching F' on K'=K minus {p,q}. For any selected P={pq} union P', replacing the labeled alternating path a--p--q--b by ab preserves every connected component. Consequently F+P is a single alternating cycle iff F'+P' is. This argument does not assume required edges are short or bipartite. It is also covered by the accepted single-pair rank-reduction criterion, whose hypotheses are explicitly discharged here.

**MC5 — rank import alignment.** The accepted primary Cygan–Kratsch–Nederlof matching-connectivity bound (Corollary3.5, recorded in the frozen primary-source note) applies over GF(2) on **all complete-graph perfect matchings** at every even terminal count, hence rank(H22)<=1024. The primary statement was checked by this reviewer in the preceding local audits. This is not a real-field or bipartite-only assertion. **MC6 — full row-space span.** Independent rank1024 on the selected column restriction makes the corresponding1024 complete H22 rows independent. The generic full-matrix upper bound then makes them span the full row space. A dependence in complete rows would remain after restricting columns, so no hidden converse is assumed.

**MC7 — every arbitrary F' is connected by a selected row.** Each F' column is nonzero in the complete matrix: cyclically connect its eleven oriented matching edges to form another perfect matching with one alternating cycle. If all selected rows vanished at F', their full row span would vanish, contradiction. Some selected P' therefore connects with this arbitrary F'. **MC8 — expansion gives the claimed simple physical cycle.** Undo MC4 and expand every endpoint pair through its vertex-disjoint full forest path. The resulting connected2-regular graph covers exactly29 retained vertices and contains every original F edge. Required edges, shortness, exact omissions and actual forbidden pair are all preserved. The covered status of consumed t was checked separately and prevents silently applying a theorem to the wrong matching domain.
